You must stop their ritual at once.
english.completion: You continue to exceed my expectations, $C. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 进入墓穴
text.objectives: 在至尊殿使用古拉的咒语，然后击败重生的古拉。
text.description: 神圣遗物学会在这里真是如鱼得水，我是说真的！$B$B每一天，我们的研究员都会带回更多可供研究和归档的遗物。$B$B最近，我们的一位探险者在白骨庭院中发现了这个卷轴。$B$B我相信这个咒语能够唤起坟墓中的死者。如果我的魔古知识没错，那你应该到至尊殿最深处的那个房间里使用它。$B$B你愿意去验证一下我的理论吗？
text.completion: Ah yes, you've just confirmed my theory! Thank you, $C.
text.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Into the Crypts
english.objectives: Use the Incantation of Gura in the Hall of the Exalted, then defeat Gura the Reclaimed.
english.description: The Reliquary is having a field day out here, literally!$B$BEvery day, the researchers find more relics to study and catalog.$B$BRecently, one of our adventurers found this scroll at the Court of Bones.$B$BI believe that this incantation can be used to call beyond the grave. And if my Mogu is up to date, I'd say you should use it in the last room in the Hall of the Exalted.$B$BWould you be willing to test out my theory?
english.completion: Ah yes, you've just confirmed my theory! Thank you, $C.
english.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Preventing a Future Threat
text.objectives: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.
text.description:
The creatures the Zandalari ride don't start out so big, nor do they start out the vicious and loyal creatures they become.

If you can frighten some of the hatchling skyscreamers away from the beach, perhaps they will have a chance at a real life.
text.completion: You have returned, $R. It is my hope that these young skyscreamers have the lives they deserve without dealing with the harsh treatment of the trolls.
text.completed: Return to Kethiel Sunlance at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Preventing a Future Threat
english.objectives: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.
english.description:
The creatures the Zandalari ride don't start out so big, nor do they start out the vicious and loyal creatures they become.

If you can frighten some of the hatchling skyscreamers away from the beach, perhaps they will have a chance at a real life.
english.completion: You have returned, $R. It is my hope that these young skyscreamers have the lives they deserve without dealing with the harsh treatment of the trolls.
english.completed: Return to Kethiel Sunlance at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 战栗的沼泽
text.objectives: 消灭强大的魔暴龙。
text.description: 在这片沼泽里有一只巨大的野兽。它目前还没对我们发起攻击，但我可不敢保证，我们是否会一直这么幸运下去。$B$B在它还没饿到要来突破我们的防线前，赶快将它消灭。
text.completion: You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.$B$BCome back to me in a day's time, $C.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: The Shuddering Moor
english.objectives: Kill the Mighty Devilsaur.
english.description: There is an immense beast in the swamp. It has not yet marched upon us, but I place no stock that we will continue to be so fortunate.$B$BStrike it down before it grows hungry enough to brave our defenses.
english.completion: You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.$B$BCome back to me in a day's time, $C.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 赞达拉巨神像
text.objectives: 消灭赞达拉巨神像。
text.description: 巨魔已将一个巨大的构造体部署在南边的路上，阻碍了我们岛屿四周的通行。去帮我们除掉障碍，$c。
text.completion: When I give you a task, it gets handled.$B$BWell done, $C.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: The Zandalari Colossus
english.objectives: Destroy the Zandalari Colossus.
english.description: The trolls have dispatched one of their immense constructs on the southern road, blocking our passage around the island. See to it that the road is cleared, $c.
english.completion: When I give you a task, it gets handled.$B$BWell done, $C.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
text.objectives: Relight 8 torches within the Diremoor.
text.description: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promitory.

english.objectives: Relight 8 torches within the Diremoor.

Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promitory.

text.title: What's Inside Counts
text.objectives: Destroy Guardian Tak'u in Conqueror's Terrace.
text.description: I noticed something strange on my last scouting mission. A group of Zandalari are performing a ritual on what appears to be a very large sentry. They may be trying to re-animate it.$b$bWe need that ritual stopped and the sentry destroyed. Anything that large can't be good.$b$bI've sent a scout ahead to observe their actions. Meet with her and figure out how to stop them.
text.completion: So I was correct to be concerned. It's a good thing you were there to stop them before that guardian was fully infused.$B$BGood work, $C.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Very Disarming
text.objectives: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.
text.description: Look around you, $c. What do you see? I see an opportunity.$b$bThe casters here work to imbue the Zandalari weapons with powerful magic. As if a sharp blade isn't enough to cut even the strongest foe down to size.$b$bIn my scouting I've noticed the weapons are not very well guarded. This is where you come in...$b$bIf we can steal a few of these weapons we may be able to use them. At the very least they are out of enemy hands.
text.progress: So? What did you find?
text.completion: Excellent work, $C!$B$BThese weapons are terrifying on their own, nevermind the magic they are infused with.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Knowledge Is Power
text.objectives: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.
text.description: The Zandalari here practice a different kind of magic. We must understand it before we can defeat it, $c.$b$bTheir control over the arcane and shadow is impressive. I wish to learn how they have achieved what so many others have not.$b$bI believe their ritual artifacts may hold the answers I seek. Bring me a sampling of the artifacts you find, and I will ensure you are rewarded properly.
text.progress: Did you find the artifacts?
text.completion: These will do nicely, $C. Excellent work.
text.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 点火！哇啊啊！
text.objectives: 使用锈水燃烧瓶摧毁6架天火号旋翼机X2型。
text.description: 侏儒带来了他们的飞行器。我要肃清我的领空！$b$b快爬上你的坐骑，摧毁那些破烂装置。$b$b你可以用我从地精盟友那里“弄来”的烈酒。相比灌进那些绿皮小鬼的喉咙，它们更适合用来炸毁旋翼机。
text.completion: Ha! Simple mechanical toys are no match for a well aimed bottle of grog.
text.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Gro'tash at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Flash! Aaaaaahhhh!
english.objectives: Use the Bilgewater Molotovs to destroy 6 Skyfire Gyrocopter X2s.
english.description: The gnomes have brought their flying contraptions. I want my skies CLEAR!$b$bGet up there on whatever mount you have with you and destroy those paltry devices.$b$bYou may use this grog I "acquired" from our goblin allies. It would be better served blasting down gyrocopters than in the gullet of those little green fiends.
english.completion: Ha! Simple mechanical toys are no match for a well aimed bottle of grog.
english.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Gro'tash at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: Bug Off!
text.objectives: Spray 5 Agitated Shale Spiders with the Bug Off Sprayer and eradicate 12 Shale Shards.
text.description: This cave is crawlin' with nasty shale spiders! How's a girl supposed to get any work done with them gobbling up the miners AND the ore?!$b$bThis seemed like a good opportunity to use my newest invention, Bug Off. See, all you have to do is spray this stuff all over the shale spiders. They hate it and it doesn't seem to have many long term side-effects for the miners!$b$bWhat could possibly go wrong?$b$bTake this handy sprayer and get to work!
text.completion: Now that's what I like to hear! I bet those spiders will think twice before messing with a Bilgewater operation again!
text.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Oregrind's Dig.

english.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Oregrind's Dig.

text.title: Precious Resource
text.objectives: Tighten 8 Faulty Valves in and around Gearslip's Gusher.
text.description: What we have here is too much of a good thing, $n!$b$bOur rig just can't handle the amount of oil we're pumping out of the ground. It's literally bursting at the seams! To be more accurate, it's bursting at the valves.$b$bI've been working double-time to get the valves repaired, but every time I finish the rounds, they're all broken again.$b$bIt's as if someone is following me... That's ridiculous though....$b$bMaybe you'll have better luck. Try getting as many of those valves tightened as you can.
text.completion: So I was being followed! Those dirty rotten sneaks!$B$BI'm going to have to start planting some real nice surprises for those cowards. Surprises that will really knock 'em out!
text.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Bilgewater Beach.

english.objectives: Tighten 8 Faulty Valves in and around Gearslip's Gusher.

english.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Bilgewater Beach.

text.title: Universal Remote-Explode
text.objectives: Destroy 9 Shieldwall Mecha-Pounders in and around Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
text.description: The Mecha-Pounders are really making things difficult down here, but I think I may have the solution!$b$bI made this universal remote for myself, but it looks like I hit a specific frequency that has an useful result!$b$bApparently this frequency weakens their armor!$b$bUse the remote to take them down a few notches then punch 'em in the face!
text.completion: Good work, $n! I saw the fireworks from here!$B$BWho knew being a genius was this easy? I don't even have to try anymore.
text.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

english.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

text.title: 埋藏的秘密
text.objectives: 去锦绣谷的祖宗高地和法利尔·银棘谈一谈。
text.description: 我听过魔古族曾经拥有数百座秘密武器库，里面堆满了威力惊人的武器。$B$B当一支魔古族部队开始备战时，他们会将恐惧和敬畏植入敌人内心深处。$B$B这正是我来潘达利亚想要找到的秘密！$B$B我派了一支探险队去西边的废墟调查，可他们的进度跟那些没脑子的劳工一样慢！$B$B去跟他们的首领法利尔·银棘谈谈。告诉他，我要立刻看到成果。
text.completion: The Warchief sent you? What does he say?

english.title: Buried Secrets
english.objectives: Speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Ancestral Rise in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: I am told that the mogu once possessed hundreds of hidden armories full of earth-shattering weapons.$B$BWhen a mogu army prepared for war, they struck fear and terror into the hearts of their enemies.$B$BTHIS is the knowledge I seek here on Pandaria!$B$BI have sent an expedition to study some ruins to the west, but they work as slowly as dim-witted peons!$B$BGo speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn, their leader. Tell him that I want to see results immediately.
english.completion: The Warchief sent you? What does he say?

text.title: 寇茹力量之源
text.objectives: 从寇茹织法者身上获取一个染煞之爪。
text.description: 噢，你好啊！你有见过和这些雕像类似的东西吗？这真是太奇妙了！$B$B我先前探查这片废墟时，在高地顶上发现了一些有趣的东西。$B$B我没法靠得太近，可我想那应该也是一个魔古雕像。可是，它却会动！$B$B我没法闯过那些该死的血精灵的封锁线，但你看上去有这个能力。$B$B你能上去帮我搞点特别的东西下来吗？
text.progress: Did ya find anything up there?
text.completion: Oh my, look at this thing!
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Source of Korune Power
english.objectives: Collect a Sha-Touched Claw from the Korune Spellweaver.
english.description: Why hullo there! Have ya ever seen tha like o' these statues? Fascinatin'!$B$BI was scouting up along the ruins earlier, and I spotted somethin' innerestin' up on the highest rise.$B$BI couldn't get close enough, but I think it might be one o' these mogu statues, 'cept it was movin'!$B$BI can't get through all those nasty blood elves, but you look like you could.$B$BWould you mind going up there and bringing me back anything of interest?
english.progress: Did ya find anything up there?
english.completion: Oh my, look at this thing!
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 寇茹魔古
text.objectives: 从寇茹织法者身上获取一份寇茹抄本。
text.description: 这些陶俑守卫很恐怖，可他们和我们在废墟顶上发现的那个生物完全没法比。$B$B我们幸存下来的一些斥候报告说，在北边最高的那片高地上看见了某种魔古织法者。$B$B他使用着某种我们从未见过的魔法。$B$B我们必须尽力了解这个生物。快去干掉他，并把你找到的任何东西带回来给我。
text.progress: What did you discover?
text.completion: Yes, this is remarkable! This is just the kind of artifact that we came here to find!
text.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Korune
english.objectives: Collect a Korune Codex from the Korune Spellweaver.
english.description: These terracotta wardens are fearsome, but not nearly as horrifying as the creature that we found at the top of the ruins.$B$BSome of our surviving scouts reported seeing some kind of mogu spellweaver on the highest rise to the north.$B$BHe practices a type of magic unlike any other we have seen.$B$BWe must learn whatever we can from this creature. Slay him, and bring me anything you find.
english.progress: What did you discover?
english.completion: Yes, this is remarkable! This is just the kind of artifact that we came here to find!
english.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 会见斥候
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的卡桑琅海湾与斥候琳娜谈一谈。
text.description: 迷雾已经散去两个月了。我们派去为舰队寻找合适登陆点的联盟斥候在卡桑琅丛林的一片海滩上遭遇了部落。$B$B我要你去找斥候琳娜并帮她确保登陆点的安全。
text.completion: You have impeccable timing, $C. King Wrynn is just about to land, and the full might of our fleet will follow soon after.
text.completed: 去卡桑琅丛林的卡桑琅海湾与斥候琳娜谈一谈。

english.title: Meet the Scout
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Lynna at Krasarang Cove in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: It has been two months since the parting of the mists. Alliance scouts, seeking a suitable landing site for the fleet, have engaged Horde forces on a beach in Krasarang Wilds.$B$BMeet with Scout Lynna and help secure the landing site.
english.completion: You have impeccable timing, $C. King Wrynn is just about to land, and the full might of our fleet will follow soon after.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Lynna at Krasarang Cove in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 人民的国王
text.objectives: 陪伴瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王找到托德曼元帅和希尔达·盘角并击败25名部落成员。
text.description: 不能再浪费时间了，我们得找到托德曼，守住海滩。$B$B我们还得去看看那些矮人——探险者协会的成员很顽强，但他们不是军人。他们应该就在北边的悬崖那里。$B$B上马吧，$c。为了我们的朋友。为了联盟。
text.completion: I'm satisfied with this site, it's time to bring in our fleet.
text.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Krasarang Cove.

english.title: A King Among Men
english.objectives: Accompany King Varian Wrynn to find Marshal Troteman, Hilda Hornswaggle, and slay 25 Horde.
english.description: There's no time to waste, we need to find Troteman and secure the beach.$B$BWe should check on the dwarves, too - the Explorer's League is tough, but they're no army. They should be along the cliff just north of here.$B$BLet us ride, $c. For our friends. For the Alliance.
english.completion: I'm satisfied with this site, it's time to bring in our fleet.
english.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Krasarang Cove.

text.title: 王者的耐心
text.objectives: 进入场景战役“王者的耐心”并向瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王报到。
text.description: 瓦里安国王正在召集果敢的冒险者前去协助他处理泰兰德·语风与一支固守朱鹤寺的部落小分队间的决战。$B$B立刻去向他报到吧！
text.completion: Good to see you again, $n.$B$BWe have a delicate situation on our hands here. We need to plan our next moves carefully.
text.completed: 进入场景战役“王者的耐心”并向瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王报到。

english.title: A Little Patience
english.objectives: Enter the "A Little Patience" scenario and report to King Varian Wrynn.
english.description: King Varian needs decisive adventurers to help him resolve a showdown between Tyrande Whisperwind and a detachment of Horde warriors holed up in the Temple of the Red Crane.$B$BReport to him immediately!
english.completion: Good to see you again, $n.$B$BWe have a delicate situation on our hands here. We need to plan our next moves carefully.
english.completed: Enter the "A Little Patience" scenario and report to King Varian Wrynn.

text.title: 寻找斥候
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的部落登陆点和斥候罗克拉谈一谈。
text.description: 迷雾散去已经有两个月了。部落斥候一直在为舰队寻找一个合适的登陆点，结果在卡桑琅丛林海岸附近的一座小岛上遭遇了联盟部队。$B$B快去找到斥候罗克拉并帮忙包围登陆点。
text.completion: You are just in time. The Warchief is about to land. Once this site passes his inspection, the fleet will follow.
text.completed: 去卡桑琅丛林的部落登陆点与斥候罗克拉谈一谈。

english.title: Meet the Scout
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Rokla at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: It has been two months since the parting of the mists. Horde scouts, seeking a suitable landing site for the fleet, have engaged Alliance forces on a small island off the coast of Krasarang Wilds.$B$BMeet with Scout Rokla and help secure the landing site.
english.completion: You are just in time. The Warchief is about to land. Once this site passes his inspection, the fleet will follow.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Rokla at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 酋长的力量
text.objectives: 陪伴加尔鲁什找到血卫士高塔什和格里兹尔·轮滑并击败25名联盟成员。
text.description: 来吧，$c！我要视察这座岛，并确认我的登陆部队已经开始工作。$B$B血卫士高塔什应该就在这座岛的北边寻找建造堡垒的合适地点。地精勘测队则应该在东部海滩上探测石油。$B$B让我们碾碎这些臭虫，为部落夺取这片土地吧！
text.completion: Well done. Our presence here will not be denied!
text.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Might of the Warchief
english.objectives: Accompany Garrosh Hellscream to find Blood Guard Gro'tash, Grizzle Gearslip, and slay 25 Alliance.
english.description: Come, $c! I want to inspect this island and ensure that my landing team has done their job.$B$BBlood Guard Gro'tash should be somewhere on the northern side of the island looking for a suitable place to build our keep. The goblin survey team will have gone up the eastern coast in search of oil.$B$BLet us crush this pitiful display and claim this land for the Horde!
english.completion: Well done. Our presence here will not be denied!
english.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 黑暗中的匕首
text.objectives: 进入场景战役“黑暗中的匕首”并向沃金报到。
text.description: 暗影猎手沃金将与一队库卡隆斥候一同出发，前去完成酋长交予的重要任务。$B$B像你这样光荣的部落成员当然也能一同前往，但你要小心——真相可能十分丑恶。
text.completion: Good ta see ya, mon. I be needin' true allies at my side for dis mission.
text.completed: 进入场景战役“黑暗中的匕首”并向沃金报到。

english.title: Dagger in the Dark
english.objectives: Enter the "Dagger in the Dark" scenario and report to Vol'jin.
english.description: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin has joined a group of Kor'kron scouts on an important mission for the warchief.$B$BOf course a proud member of the Horde such as yourself is welcome to go along, but be warned - it could get ugly.
english.completion: Good ta see ya, mon. I be needin' true allies at my side for dis mission.
english.completed: Enter the "Dagger in the Dark" scenario and report to Vol'jin.

text.title: Harbingers of the Loa
text.objectives: Slay 2 Harbingers of the Loa.
text.description:
Have you heard of the loa? We do not understand all of what it is, but it seems to be a dark magic with some degree of sentience.

We do not know what power the loa might possess, but I must ask you to put a stop to their rituals, $c.
text.completion: I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed, $n. Your bravery was put to the test this day, and you did not fail the Horde in your task.
text.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

english.objectives: Slay 2 Harbingers of the Loa.

english.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 掌控蜥蜴人
text.objectives: 向魔导师奥尔兰、魔导师萨雷恩和魔导师维莎拉报到。
text.description: 我向伊瓜鲁克峭壁派出了三名魔导师，以便监视这些不友好的蜥蜴人邻居，顺便看看能不能策反他们对抗魔古。我要你去找到他们，看看他们是否需要补给或帮助。$b$b他们都是隐身的。你只要找蜥蜴人村子里那些闪烁的光柱就行了。
text.completion: <The archmage listens carefully to your report.>$B$BI understand. Thank you for your aid, $C.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Manipulating the Saurok
english.objectives: Check in with Magister Arlan, Magister Sarien, and Magistrix Vesara.
english.description: I have three magisters entrenched in Ihgaluk Crag, monitoring the saurok and - where they can - turning them against the mogu. I need you to find them and see if they need any supplies or assistance.$b$bThey will be concealed from view. Look for shimmering columns of light within the saurok village.
english.completion: <The archmage listens carefully to your report.>$B$BI understand. Thank you for your aid, $C.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 解体
text.objectives: 夺回4个被偷走的夺日者构造体。
text.description: 蜥蜴人一直在袭扰我们的边界，而我们的构造体通常都能击退他们。可是，有一些构造体却被他们击败并拖回了伊瓜鲁克峭壁。$b$b我想把这些构造体弄回来。那些滑溜溜的蜥蜴人休想从我眼皮底下偷走夺日者的任何财产。
text.completion: That's more like it.$B$BThank you, $C.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: De-Constructed
english.objectives: Recover the four stolen Sunreaver Constructs.
english.description: Saurok consistently test our borders, and our constructs usually fend them off. Some constructs, however, have been defeated and dragged back to Ihgaluk Crag.$b$bI want those constructs back. No slithering lizard will steal Sunreaver property under my watch.
english.completion: That's more like it.$B$BThank you, $C.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 帝国的崛起
text.objectives: 去双月殿找加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮酋长带着一队最精锐的士兵到北边去了。$B$B把我们对联盟的辉煌战绩报告给他吧。$B$B你可以去找泰克泰克，让他送你一程。
text.completion: What do you have to report?
text.completed: Speak to Warchief Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Rise Of An Empire
english.objectives: Find Warchief Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: Warchief Garrosh Hellscream travels north with a squad of his most elite soldiers.$B$BReport to him with news of our continued victory against the Alliance.$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak for transportation.
english.completion: What do you have to report?
english.completed: Speak to Warchief Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 众神之声
text.objectives: 调查水银守护者，获得古代寇茹石板。
text.description: 太慢！？我们已经在尽力为酋长卖命了！$B$B发掘工作必须小心谨慎，所有的发现都得编列目录，当然还要走必要的安全流程。他必须明白这一点！$B$B好吧，我们很快就能向他展示一些成果了。你看到西边那个石雕了吗？$B$B我们怀疑那是一个古代的石头容器。现在，我们只需要想办法打开它就行了。$B$B如果你愿意帮助我们的话，就请帮我们小心地打开它吧。
text.progress: We are quite capable of handling this excavation. I understand the Warchief sent you, but he will get faster results if he leaves us to our work.
text.completion: Hmm... very interesting. This tablet will yield many secrets, indeed.
text.completed: Speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn at the Ancestral Rise in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Voice of the Gods
english.objectives: Investigate the Mercurial Guardian and obtain the Ancient Korune Tablet.
english.description: Too slowly!? We are working as quickly as possible for the Warchief!$B$BWe must excavate carefully, catalogue each find, and of course follow safety procedures. He must understand!$B$BWell, we may have something to show him soon. Do you see that stone statue to the west?$B$BWe suspect it is an ancient stone storage vessel. Now we just have to find a way to open it.$B$BIf you would care to help us with our excavation, please go about it carefully.
english.progress: We are quite capable of handling this excavation. I understand the Warchief sent you, but he will get faster results if he leaves us to our work.
english.completion: Hmm... very interesting. This tablet will yield many secrets, indeed.
english.completed: Speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn at the Ancestral Rise in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Captive Audience
text.objectives: Free 5 Sunreaver Captives around Violet Rise.
text.description: The Kirin Tor have gone too far! Now they hold our fellow Sunreavers as war prisoners!$b$bThere will be no discussion of prisoner exchange. We will handle this ourselves.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and free as many prisoners as you can. Do not get captured yourself. We cannot afford to lose you too.
text.completion: Those you have rescued today would no doubt thank you, if they had the strength.$B$BOur task here will be ongoing. I refuse to leave anyone behind!
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

We will handle this ourselves.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and free as many prisoners as you can. Do not get captured yourself. We cannot afford to lose you too.
english.completion: Those you have rescued today would no doubt thank you, if they had the strength.$B$BOur task here will be ongoing. I refuse to leave anyone behind!
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Spellbound
text.objectives: Retrieve Jaina's Weathered Spellbook from Violet Rise.
text.description: Jaina possesses several very powerful magic artifacts. These items travel with her at all times, and are never far from her grasp. I have an interest in one of these items.$b$bA tome, filled with knowledge, passed from one archmage to another. I have only ever seen glimpses of it.$b$bNow that we fight on opposite sides I see no issue in removing the tome from her possession.
text.progress: Do you have it? Do you have the book?!
text.completion: I have desired this book for many years, $R. It's power is too immense to describe. You have done me a great service.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 充能绿柱石
text.objectives: 找到一块充能绿柱石，并将它带给高阶奥术师西瓦。
text.description: 我们每天都派间谍深入肯瑞托行动基地。有些肩负着从敌人手中找到充能绿柱石并将其带回的使命。$b$b他们还没回来，而且我能确定，他们已经离开了肯瑞托基地。$b$b在位于两地之间的丛林中展开搜寻，寻找任何有可能遗失在运输途中的充能绿柱石。把它带回来交给我，这会对我们大有用处。
text.completion: Well done, champion. This artifact will be put to better use in our hands than in the hands of the Kirin Tor.
text.completed: Speak with High Arcanist Savor in Dawnseeker Promontory at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Charged Moganite
english.objectives: Recover a Charged Moganite and bring it to High Arcanist Savor.
english.description: We have been dispatching spies into the Kirin Tor base of operations on a daily basis. Some had orders to recover charged moganite from the enemy and bring it here.$b$bThey have not returned, and I can confirm they have left the Kirin Tor base.$b$bSearch the jungle between here and there and find any of the charged moganite that might have been lost in transit. Bring it to me and we will put it to good use.
english.completion: Well done, champion. This artifact will be put to better use in our hands than in the hands of the Kirin Tor.
english.completed: Speak with High Arcanist Savor in Dawnseeker Promontory at the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 将充能绿柱石送回寻晨者海角

text.title: Mana Manifestations
text.objectives: Kill 9 Kirin Tor Manafiends.
text.description: Manafiends are nasty creatures. Small and easy to underestimate, but deadly to our magic casters. The Kirin Tor have these pests crawling all over Violet Rise.$b$bWe will need to handle them carefully. Alone they are easily managed, but in groups they become a different challenge altogether.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and cut down their numbers.
text.completion: This task will be ongoing, but you have done as a great service, $R.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.objectives: Kill 9 Kirin Tor Manafiends.

text.title: Tactical Mana Bombs
text.objectives: Plant a Tactical Mana Bomb on an Alliance Ship, Alliance Supply Shipment, and on the Construct Ritual.
text.description: Ah, $p, just the $r I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Violet Rise to the southeast.$b$bHere, take these. I do not trust our standard soldiers with such firepower. Oh... and don't shake them, whatever you do.$b$bPlant one of the Kirin Tor ships, another one near their supplies, and the last on the construct they are building.
text.completion: I am sure the use of even these smaller mana bombs has Jaina squirming with rage. Serves her right.$B$BDalaran was my home before her grandparents were born. What right did she have to expel me from my home?
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
text.objectives: Destroy 6 Kirin Tor Perimeter Wards.
text.description: We need to keep a close watch on the Kirin Tor and their day-to-day activities. Normally this would be easy. We would sneak in a spy and have them report back to us.$b$bHowever, we've run into a slight problem I believe you can help us with.$b$bThe Kirin Tor perimeter wards have increased in power. It's next to impossible to get someone past their lines. If they were disabled we might be able to sneak in before they can be repaired.
text.completion: Good work, $C. With your help we were able to successfully sneak several spies behind enemy lines.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 伊瓜鲁克的住民
text.objectives: 击败1个邪刃蛮兵、1个邪刃蜥首牧师和1个邪刃海龙战士。
text.description: 邪刃部族威胁到了我们的人，可报之以毫不留情的消灭未免也太反应过度了。$b$b去干掉他们的部族首领或许是更加理性的回应方式。这样不仅能少一些流血冲突，也可以让他们尊重我们划下的边界。
text.completion: I know the true price of bloodshed. I know the cost of war.$B$BIt would be simpler to blindly massacre our attackers until they yield. But is it right?
text.completed: Return to Sunwalker Dezco on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Residents of Ihgaluk
english.objectives: Slay a Skumblade Brute, a Skumblade Saur-Priest, and a Skumblade Seadragon.
english.description: The Skumblade threaten our people, but responding with all-out slaughter would be an overreaction.$b$bA more reasonable response to their threat would be to slay some of their tribal leaders. There will be less bloodshed, and they will still respect our perimeter.
english.completion: I know the true price of bloodshed. I know the cost of war.$B$BIt would be simpler to blindly massacre our attackers until they yield. But is it right?
english.completed: Return to Sunwalker Dezco on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 手术式死亡
text.objectives: 击败3名赞达拉缚灵者、3名赞达拉驭兽师和3名赞达拉丛林豹战士。
text.description:
赞达拉巨魔的奴兽师将啸天龙训练成翱翔于天际的凶残野兽。缚灵者不知满足地要把我的族人全都变成祭品。而丛林豹战士则更加逼近我们的营地中心。

去赞图尔找到他们，从而消除威胁。
text.completion: I shall continue my unrest until the threat is subdued, but your aid brings us closer to that goal. I thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Surgical Death
english.objectives: Slay 3 Zandalari Spiritbinders, 3 Zandalari Beastcallers, and 3 Zandalari Jaguar Warriors.
english.description:
The Zandalari train skyscreamers to become ferocious beasts in the skies. The spiritbinders require endless sacrifices - of our people - to be brought to them. And, the jaguar warriors venture ever closer toward the heart of our camp.

Find them in Za'Tual and remove the threat.
english.completion: I shall continue my unrest until the threat is subdued, but your aid brings us closer to that goal. I thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 摧毁城墙！
text.objectives: 与洛瑟玛·塞隆交谈，然后攻入城市下层，为部落夺取它。
text.description: 时机终于到了。我们的大军已在这里稳住阵脚，现在可以冒险突进，前往雷电之王的老巢了。不幸的是，他好像一时半会还没有打开大门的意思。$b$b那我们就只好自己弄出一道门来了。等你做好准备就来找我，$n。
text.completion: With your help, we're one giant step closer to our goal.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Tear Down This Wall!
english.objectives: Speak with Lor'themar Theron, then break into the lower city and secure it for the Horde.
english.description: The time has come. Our forces are well-enough entrenched here that we can risk pressing forward, into the Thunder King's lair. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like he'll be opening that gate anytime soon.$b$bI suppose we'll have to make a gate of our own then. Let me know when you're ready, $n.
english.completion: With your help, we're one giant step closer to our goal.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 与洛瑟玛·塞隆交谈以开始你的任务

text.title: 直冲云霄！
text.objectives: 进入闪电矿脉。
text.description:
我们可以用你找到的飞翼龙，对魔古族发起致命打击。

他们的采矿作业在空袭面前显得十分脆弱，而你的飞翼龙是眼下唯一能飞到那里的野兽。

等你准备好就来找我吧！
text.completion: Incredible work. This presents us with a monumental opportunity.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: To the Skies!
english.objectives: Gain access to the Lightning Vein Mine.
english.description:
We can use the pterrorwing that you found to strike a decisive blow against the mogu. 

Their mining operation is vulnerable to attack from the air, and your pterrorwing is the only beast we have capable of flying out there.

Let me know when you are ready!
english.completion: Incredible work. This presents us with a monumental opportunity.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

objectiveDetails.description: 与洛瑟玛·塞隆交谈以开始你的任务

text.title: 果断行动
text.objectives: 渗透进风暴之海码头并从里面打开庭院大门。与陶矢交谈来开始任务。
text.description: 赞达拉战船在这座岛屿四周的海域上大肆掠夺。他们不断地从赞达拉运送士兵和作战野兽，来壮大雷神的军队。$B$B要是我们能夺取宫殿的船坞，雷电之王的补给线就会被截断，而你在这里的据点也会变得越发稳固。$B$B我有个计划可以实现这一目标，而且用不着劳烦整支大军出动。
text.completion: Excellent work! With that blasted warship out of commission, the bombardments on our forces along the coast will cease.$B$BTaran Zhu has informed me that the Shado-Pan will keep vigil over Stormsea Landing, freeing up Sunreaver resources to press the siege elsewhere. Taoshi will be there. I am sure she will be glad to work with you again.$B$BWe are all grateful for your contributions, $n. Thank you.
text.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Decisive Action
english.objectives: Infiltrate Stormsea Landing and open the courtyard gate from within. Speak with Taoshi to begin the mission.
english.description: Zandalari warships plunder the seas around this island. They ferry in soldiers and war beasts from Zandalar to bolster Lei Shen's army.$B$BIf we can capture the palace shipyard, the Thunder King's supply line will be cut off, and your foothold here will be secure.$B$BI have a plan to do just that, and it won't take an entire army.
english.completion: Excellent work! With that blasted warship out of commission, the bombardments on our forces along the coast will cease.$B$BTaran Zhu has informed me that the Shado-Pan will keep vigil over Stormsea Landing, freeing up Sunreaver resources to press the siege elsewhere. Taoshi will be there. I am sure she will be glad to work with you again.$B$BWe are all grateful for your contributions, $n. Thank you.
english.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 山怖之死
text.objectives: 击败山怖。
text.description:
很久以前，雷神找到了几枚罕见的风暴龙蛋。从其中一枚龙蛋中孵化出的纳拉克，尤为残忍，雷神将它据为己有。

雷电之王的仆从山怖正致力于让雷神的巨龙纳拉克起死回生。

我们必须击败山怖，而且如果可以的话，还要阻止他复活巨龙。
text.completion: Well done, $n. Shan Bu's fall will weaken the Mogu and your heroism will surely be remembered.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory

english.title: The Fall of Shan Bu
english.objectives: Defeat Shan Bu.
english.description:
Long ago, Lei Shen found a rare clutch of storm dragon eggs. One of these creatures - Nalak - was particularly brutal, and Lei Shen took it for his own.

The Thunder King's servant, Shan Bu, works to resurrect Lei Shen's dragon, Nalak.

We must defeat Shan Bu and, if we are able, prevent him from resurrecting the dragon.
english.completion: Well done, $n. Shan Bu's fall will weaken the Mogu and your heroism will surely be remembered.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory

text.title: Metalocalypse
text.objectives: Kill Metal Lord Mono-Han outside the Ghost Iron Mine on the Isle of the Thunder King.
text.description:
You've made a good start, but now it's time to really make a dent in their operations.

Take out Metal Lord Mono-Han,  of the mines.

english.title: Metalocalypse
english.objectives: Kill Metal Lord Mono-Han outside the Ghost Iron Mine on the Isle of the Thunder King.
english.description:
You've made a good start, but now it's time to really make a dent in their operations.

Take out Metal Lord Mono-Han,  of the mines.

text.title: Fleshcrafter's End
text.objectives: Kill Fleshcrafter Goju outside the Ghost Iron Mines on the Isle of the Thunder King.
text.description:
The mogu responsible for the torture of the agents, Fleshcrafter Goju, stands outside the mine.

Killing him would be the only justice for what he's done to your agents.

english.title: Fleshcrafter's End
english.objectives: Kill Fleshcrafter Goju outside the Ghost Iron Mines on the Isle of the Thunder King.
english.description:
The mogu responsible for the torture of the agents, Fleshcrafter Goju, stands outside the mine.

Killing him would be the only justice for what he's done to your agents.

text.title: Compy Stomp
text.objectives: Kill 5 Raptors and 10 Trained Compies in the Beast Pens.
text.description: The raptors and compies of the Zandalari represent a substantial threat to our forces here. They are superb hunting beasts that can track prey over great distances and are often lethal to encounter when caught unawares.$b$bI need you to head into the Beast Pens and cull their numbers. We need to make sure to slay them before they are fully trained.
text.completion: We lost three good soldiers when we first arrived on this island. Killed in their sleep by compies that had snuck into their tent. Some nights I still hear the screams.
text.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

We need to make sure to slay them before they are fully trained.
english.completion: We lost three good soldiers when we first arrived on this island. Killed in their sleep by compies that had snuck into their tent. Some nights I still hear the screams.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Loa-saur
text.objectives: Defeat a Loa Speaker.
text.description: The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.$b$bWe need to put a stop to this.$b$bSearch the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.$b$bWe must not allow these atrocities to continue.
text.completion: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?
text.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.$b$bWe must not allow these atrocities to continue.
english.completion: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?
english.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 必须见的人
text.objectives: 去滨岸村找陈·风暴烈酒。可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: $p？能找到你真是太走运了。$b$b陈·风暴烈酒让我把这个交给你，并要你去昆莱山的滨岸村见他。$b$b他遇见了你的一个朋友。不过那家伙能不能活下去就得看运气了。$b$b陈说，你可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
text.completion: Ah! You received my note. Very good. Vol'jin is near death, and I will need your help healing his wounds.
text.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Someone You Should See
english.objectives: Find Chen Stormstout at Binan Village. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: $p? It is good fortune I find you.$b$bChen Stormstout says to give this to you and ask you to meet him at Binan Village of the Kun-Lai Summit.$b$bHe found a friend of yours who needs much luck to get healthy.$B$BChen say speak to Tak-Tak for fast travels.
english.completion: Ah! You received my note. Very good. Vol'jin is near death, and I will need your help healing his wounds.
english.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 去滨岸村找陈·风暴烈酒

text.title: 无眠军团
text.objectives: 消灭6个复活的战士。
text.description: 山泽正在岛中央将雕像集结成一支大军，日夜不休地滋扰我们的防线。将你看到的会走路的雕像全都消灭。我们的防御者会对你感激不尽的。
text.completion: Your efforts are appreciated.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: The Sleepless Legion
english.objectives: Kill 6 Animated Warriors.
english.description: The Shan'ze are animating an army from the statues in the center of the isle, an army that batters our defenses day and night. Destroy any of the walking statues you see. Our defenders will greatly appreciate it.
english.completion: Your efforts are appreciated.
english.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Kill Mogu Blood-seekers (Roaming pairs, actively fighting scouts, and performing rituals on corpses)

english.title: Kill Mogu Blood-seekers (Roaming pairs, actively fighting scouts, and performing rituals on corpses)

text.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
text.objectives: Kill 7 Shan'ze mogu in the Diremoor.
text.description: There are mogu in the Diremoor animating the army of statues near the tower. Lor'themar wants them dead. I think you're the one to do it.
text.completion: Well done, $C. Thank you for the help.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
english.objectives: Kill 7 Shan'ze mogu in the Diremoor.
english.description: There are mogu in the Diremoor animating the army of statues near the tower. Lor'themar wants them dead. I think you're the one to do it.
english.completion: Well done, $C. Thank you for the help.
english.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Bolstering the Defenses
text.objectives: Empower 6 Sunreaver Perimeter Wards.
text.description: This island holds many dangers for us. Threats loom from every side. We must defend our hold on these shores at all costs.$b$bPerimeter wards have been placed around Dawnseeker Promontory. By default they will inflict damage, but are not fatal in their attack.$b$bNow is not the time to be merciful, $r. The perimeter wards need to be deadly!$b$bGo and empower the perimeter wards surrounding our camp.
text.completion: Now that the wards have been fully armed, we can focus our attention elsewhere. Nothing will be slipping past us now!
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.description: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Description]

english.objectives: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Log Description]
english.description: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Description]
english.completed: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Completion Text]

text.title: 近在眼前！
text.objectives: 击败锻造大师，并从雷神岛的塑肌者霍古身上取得一块法典碎片。
text.description:
熔炉就在你面前了，还有魔古族锻造武器的核心机密。

在它的后面，就是魔古族的守门者，他掌握着开启下一个城区的钥匙。

该我们行动了！
text.progress: Well?
text.completion: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia.

english.title: Forge Ahead!
english.objectives: Kill the Master of the Forge and collect a Codex Fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku in the Isle of Thunder.
english.description:
The forge lies ahead of you, and with it the heart of the mogu's weaponsmithing ability.

And beyond that, the mogu gatekeeper, who holds the key to unlocking the gate to the next part of the city.

It's time to move out!
english.progress: Well?
english.completion: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia.

text.title: 白骨之间
text.objectives: 消灭锻骨者祖尔查卡。
text.description: 我的探子们在伊瓜鲁克峭壁西边的白骨间发现了一个危险的赞达拉巨魔。我需要有人解决掉他。你能完成这项任务吗？
text.completion: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Among the Bones
english.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
english.description: My scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari among the bones west of Ihgaluk Crag. I need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
english.completion: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Raining Bones
text.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
text.description: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?
text.completion: You're a good $C to have around, that's for certain. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

english.title: Raining Bones
english.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
english.description: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?
english.completion: You're a good $C to have around, that's for certain. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

text.title: 与众不同的书
text.objectives: 与你的恶魔仆从对话，找出这本书的来源。
text.description: 这本书是用一种华丽而夸张的文字写成的，每一个词都仿佛要从书页上跳出来一般。它有一点像恶魔语，可却比你见过的任何一种恶魔语都要复杂。$B$B或许你的某个恶魔伙伴能告诉你更多信息。
text.completion: Этот кодекс – книга невероятной силы, написанная на древнем, прадемоническом языке. У вас возникла мысль показать ее одному из наставников чернокнижников в ближайшей столице.
text.completed: The codex appears to be a powerful tome written in an ancient, pre-demonic tongue. You strongly suspect this should be brought to the attention of the Warlock trainers in your capital city.

english.title: An Unusual Tome
english.objectives: Speak with your demonic minion to determine the origins of the tome.
english.description: The tome appears to be written in an ornate, sprawling script that seems to rise off the pages. It vaguely resembles Demonic, but the symbols are far more elaborate than any you've ever seen.$B$BPerhaps one of your demonic companions can tell you more.
english.completion: Этот кодекс – книга невероятной силы, написанная на древнем, прадемоническом языке. У вас возникла мысль показать ее одному из наставников чернокнижников в ближайшей столице.
english.completed: The codex appears to be a powerful tome written in an ancient, pre-demonic tongue. You strongly suspect this should be brought to the attention of the Warlock trainers in your capital city.

text.title: 雷电之王的宝藏
text.objectives: 与陶矢交谈来进入雷电堡。在里面，把雷神宫殿钥匙交给她，来开始对雷神宝藏护卫的计时突袭。
text.description: 据斥候们回报，有更多从雷神墓中挖出的财宝被运送到雷电堡里了。我们发现了一个秘密的下水道入口，但途中却隔着一道门，使我们无法顺利拦截他们的运送。要是我们想赢得这场奇袭，就要找到一把钥匙，它就在雷神大军最有威望的成员身上。$B$B要是你找到了这把钥匙，赶快带来交给我。$B$B不管你在这场奇袭中窃得什么战利品，全都归你所有。我只要确保没有任何物资被运送给雷神。
text.completion: Not entirely unsuccessful. Still, we'll do better next time.$B$BThanks for providing us with that key. The raid would not have gone off without you.
text.completed: Speak to Taoshi on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Treasures of the Thunder King
english.objectives: Speak to Taoshi to enter the Thunder King's Citadel.  Inside, provide her with a Key to the Palace of Lei Shen to begin the timed raid on his treasure convoy.
english.description: My scouts have returned with word that more of the treasures from Lei Shen's tomb are being brought up into the citadel. We have access to a secret sewer entrance, but a door bars us from intercepting the shipment. If we're going to succeed in this raid, we will need a key that only the most trusted of Lei Shen's forces carry.$B$BIf you get your hands on such a key, bring it to me.$B$BYou can keep whatever spoils you steal from our raid. I simply want to see that this shipment never makes it to Lei Shen.
english.completion: Not entirely unsuccessful. Still, we'll do better next time.$B$BThanks for providing us with that key. The raid would not have gone off without you.
english.completed: Speak to Taoshi on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 与阴冷洞窟的陶矢交谈

text.title: 恐角龙或魔暴龙
text.objectives: 击败傲慢的恐角龙或傲慢的魔暴龙身边的所有NPC以扰乱束缚仪式。
text.description: 眼下，我们有了一个干扰赞达拉战争机器的机会，还能顺便给自己找点乐子。$b$b在这片兽栏中，有一头魔暴龙和一头恐角龙，它们都是全副武装，并且心智被赞达拉符咒所奴役。$b$b我要你潜入营地并干扰那里的任意一个束缚仪式。没有特定目标。你只要解决掉那些想要束缚这些野兽的家伙就行了。这能够让这些武装到牙齿的野兽发狂并肆虐赞达拉的营地。然后，我们只要坐着看热闹就行了。
text.completion: Few things in this world and beyond are more entertaining than watching a rampaging ancient beast tearing through an enemy's settlement.$B$BIf times were not so dire I would consider selling tickets to such an event.
text.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Direhorn or Devilsaur
english.objectives: Disrupt a binding ritual by killing all ritual NPCs around either a Defiant Direhorn or a Defiant Devilsaur.
english.description: We have an opportunity to disrupt the Zandalari war machine as well as have a little fun in the process.$b$bWithin these beast pens, a devilsaur and a direhorn are being outfitted with armor, their minds being enslaved to the Zandalari charms.$b$bGo into the camp and disrupt one of these binding rituals. It doesn't matter which one. Just kill those who are trying to bind the creature. This should let the fully armored beast run mad through the Zandalari camp. Then sit back and watch the hilarity ensue.
english.completion: Few things in this world and beyond are more entertaining than watching a rampaging ancient beast tearing through an enemy's settlement.$B$BIf times were not so dire I would consider selling tickets to such an event.
english.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 史前巨兽
text.objectives: 找到并对兽栏中的5只迅猛龙、掠食龙、啸天龙或恐角龙使用恐龙神像。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔使用了一系列的神像和符咒来维持他们对兽栏的控制。$b$b不妨以其人之道还治其人之身。$b$b我想让你找些这种神像来，然后在兽栏中的各种野兽身上试试效果。$b$b把每只野兽对神像的反应都认真记录下来。然后向我汇报。$b$b也许这能使我们取得对抗赞达拉的优势。
text.completion: Very interesting results. I am sure there is a mage somewhere that cares about the specifics. I, on the other hand, am just glad to hear the sound of trolls being assaulted by their own beasts.
text.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Dino Might
english.objectives: Find and use Saur Fetishes on 5 raptors, compies, skyscreamers or direhorns in the Beast Pens.
english.description: The Zandalari use a series of fetishes and charms to maintain their control over their menagerie of beasts.$b$bTwo can play at that game.$b$bI want you to find some of these fetishes and try them out on the various beasts in the Beast Pens.$b$bTake careful note of how each beast responds to each fetish. Then report your results to me.$b$bMaybe this will give us the edge we need against the Zandalari.
english.completion: Very interesting results. I am sure there is a mage somewhere that cares about the specifics. I, on the other hand, am just glad to hear the sound of trolls being assaulted by their own beasts.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Just Some Light Clean-Up Work
text.objectives: Disperse 75 pieces of filth by killing Quivering Filth in Ihgaluk Crag.
text.description: This is not a glamorous job. Let me put it to you bluntly.$b$bThe Skumblade saurok pile all of their filth into a pool in the middle of their village. This filth is so concentrated and so rancid that it has congealed into moving, animate matter.$b$bThe saurok can keep their filth-pool, but once it starts spreading outside of the village, I'd say it's time to intervene.
text.completion: Jobs like this make me glad that I left most of my nose in the tomb.
text.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

english.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Disarming Irony
text.objectives: Disarm the Tactical Mana Bombs at the Horde Ships, the Scrying Crystals, and the Bridge within Dawnseeker Promontory.
text.description: Well, it would seem the Lady Proudmoore has decided to use our own weaponry against us. Our perimeter wards reported several spies slipping through our defenses carrying tactical mana bombs.$b$bI would enjoy the irony if these bombs were less dangerous.$b$bSearch for these bombs and disarm them. Our wards reported one near the horde ships to the north, one on a bridge to the main isle, and one near our scrying crystals on the eastern side of the Promontory.
text.completion: Good work. The real irony is had these been normal bombs we would have had a much harder time detecting them. Some gnomish devilry could have spelled the end of our operation here.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 宿敌
text.objectives: 在雷神岛上击败10名夺日者密探或玩家。
text.description: 想想看，我们曾经是并肩作战的盟友！夺日者的背叛让我们措手不及。决不会再发生这种事！$b$b他们向我们展露了自己的本性。与加尔鲁什和他的疯狂为伍，他们全都难逃一死。$b$b消灭你所能找到的任何夺日者密探。我们决不会手下留情。
text.completion: You have put a good dent in the Sunreaver forces here. Like vermin, there will always be more. We must be at the ready at all times.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Old Enemies
english.objectives: Kill 10 Sunreaver agents or players on the Isle of Thunder.
english.description: To think, we were once on the same side! The Sunreavers' treachery caught us all off guard. Never again!$b$bThey have shown their true natures to us. Siding with Garrosh and his madness has marked them all for death.$b$bKill any agent of the Sunreavers that you find. We will show them no mercy here.
english.completion: You have put a good dent in the Sunreaver forces here. Like vermin, there will always be more. We must be at the ready at all times.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner at the Violet Rise.

text.title: Desconstruction
text.objectives: Destroy 3 Kirin Tor Constructs around Violet Rise.
text.description: The Kirin Tor constructs are primitive at best. Nevertheless, they pose a threat.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and dismantle Jaina's pitiful war machines. Show the Kirin Tor how easily they can be defeated!$b$bThis will be a message the Kirin Tor cannot easily ignore.
text.completion: So the constructs have fallen? Good!$B$BWe will remind Jaina and the Kirin Tor at every turn that the Sunreavers are not to be taken lightly.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Made for War
text.objectives: Kill the Arcane Destroyer.
text.description: Jaina thinks this battle will be easily won. I intend to show her how wrong she is!$b$bThe Kirin Tor brought a weapon with them that must be destroyed. The Arcane Destroyer is a large construct capable of turning the tides of war in their favor.$b$bDestroying this monstrosity would send a very clear message to Proudmoore.
text.completion: I wish I could be there to see the look on Proudmoore's face as she mourns the loss of her death machine!$B$BWe can be certain she will build another, but we have at least set her back.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Overpowered
text.objectives: Destroy 7 Mana Foci around Violet Rise.
text.description: The Kirin Tor are using mana foci to empower their forces. We cannot allow this to continue.$b$bYou'll find these foci scattered around the outskirts of Violet Rise. Use this mana crystal to destroy as many as you can.$b$bEach mana focus we destroy is another small victory for our cause.
text.completion: Excellent work, $C! It will take them days to rebuild those foci.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 死物开口
text.objectives: 将抄本交给你的主城中的术士训练师。
text.description: 返回你的主城寻找术士训练师，对方或许知道更多有关这个抄本的情况。
text.completion: What... where in the great dark did you find this?

english.title: Reader for the Dead Tongue
english.objectives: Bring the codex to a Warlock trainer in your capital city.
english.description: Return to your capital city and seek out a warlock trainer who may know more about the codex.
english.completion: Garon is still in shock, but she's with us now. She wants revenge on her former lord. I'm going to forgive her for hitting me.

text.title: 大师传说
text.objectives: 阅读大师遗训第一章。
text.description: 这本书或许正是我们孜孜以求的东西……$B$B你对黑暗收割议会了解多少，$n？$B$B在死亡之翼被击败后，六位最伟大的术士聚集到了一起，向所有术士传授从落败的敌人处偷学到的进阶魔法。$B$B去看看我身后的书吧……
text.completion: You are ready to learn more...
text.completed: Return to your trainer.

english.title: A Tale of Six Masters
english.objectives: Read the first chapter of the Legacy of the Masters.
english.description: This book may be just the leverage we've been seeking... $B$BHow familiar are you with the Council of the Black Harvest, $n?$B$BAfter Deathwing was defeated, six of the greatest Warlocks gathered together to teach all Warlocks advanced forms of magic stolen from our defeated foes.$B$BTake a look at the tome beside me...
english.completion: You are ready to learn more...
english.completed: Return to your trainer.

text.title: 大师传说
text.objectives: 阅读大师遗训第一章。
text.description: 这本书或许正是我们孜孜以求的东西……$B$B你对黑暗收割议会了解多少，$n？$B$B在死亡之翼被击败后，六位最伟大的术士聚集到了一起，向所有术士传授从落败的敌人处偷学到的进阶魔法。$B$B去看看我身后的书吧……
text.completion: You are now ready to learn more...
text.completed: Return to your trainer.

english.title: A Tale of Six Masters
english.objectives: Read the first chapter of the Legacy of the Masters.
english.description: This book may be just the leverage we've been seeking... $B$BHow familiar are you with the Council of the Black Harvest, $n?$B$BAfter Deathwing was defeated, six of the greatest Warlocks gathered together to teach all Warlocks advanced forms of magic stolen from our defeated foes.$B$BTake a look at the tome beside me...
english.completion: Теперь тебе пора узнать кое-что еще...
english.completed: Return to your trainer.

text.title: Slaughter Selenora
text.objectives: Obtain the second chapter of Legacy of the Masters from Shadowmancer Selenora in Domination Point.
text.description: $n... You've heard correctly. King Varian tasked me with tracking down this Council of the Black Harvest.$B$BUnfortunately, the Horde is seeking them out as well. One of my spies recently sent word that Shadowmancer Selenora has the second piece of their journal.$B$BHead to Domination Point, slaughter Selenora and bring back whatever you find on her rotting cadaver.
text.completed: Return to Admiral Taylor at Lion's Landing

One of my spies recently sent word that Shadowmancer Selenora has the second piece of their journal.$B$BHead to Domination Point, slaughter Selenora and bring back whatever you find on her rotting cadaver.

text.title: 安度因的求援
text.objectives: 去七星殿找安度因。你可以与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 啊，你正是我要找的$c。我收到一封来自年轻的安度因王子的急信。$B$B他正在锦绣谷的七星殿招待他父亲瓦里安国王，以及一些联盟高层。$B$B按照他最近传来的消息，城里发生了一些糟糕的事情。$B$B请立刻去找他谈谈。我必须留在雄狮港处理一些事务，但我很快就会来跟你汇合的。$B$B如果有需要，你可以让范妮送你一程。
text.completion: Well met, $C. We have much work to do here.
text.completed: Speak to Anduin Wrynn in The Imperial Exchange at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Anduin's Plea
english.objectives: Find Anduin at the Shrine of Seven Stars. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Ah, just the $c I was looking for. I have received an urgent letter from the young Prince Anduin.$B$BHe is playing host to his father, King Wrynn, and several other Alliance dignitaries at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.$B$BAccording to his most recent correspondence, something bad is happening at the city.$B$BPlease go at once and speak with him. I must settle some affairs here at Lion's Landing, but I will join you soon.$B$BSpeak to Fennie if you'd like a ride to the Vale.
english.completion: Well met, $C. We have much work to do here.
english.completed: Speak to Anduin Wrynn in The Imperial Exchange at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 联盟之心
text.objectives: 对抗6名染煞步兵。要是你和安度因王子走散了，可以去帝皇商站找他。
text.description: 我简直不敢相信会发生这种事，$n。在潘达利亚经历了这么多事情之后，难道我们的人就永远不会从过去的错误中汲取一丁点的教训吗？$B$B布莱恩的探险队刚从魔古岬回来没多久，带回了一份煞魔样本准备用作研究。$B$B我从一开始就对他们的做法持保留意见，并且我最担心的事情现在成真了。$B$B煞魔逃脱了束缚，而我也不想再解释煞魔会给这片山谷带来什么样的恐惧了。$B$B我们必须清除我们能找到的任何煞魔，而且要快！
text.completion: I see that you and my son have been hard at work. Thank you for taking the initiative to aid our cause here in the Vale.
text.completed: Speak to King Varian Wrynn at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Heart Of The Alliance
english.objectives: Confront 6 Sha-Touched Footmen. Should you lose Prince Anduin, speak to him at The Imperial Exchange.
english.description: I can't believe this has happened, $n. After all we have been through here on Pandaria, will our people never learn from their past mistakes?$B$BBrann's expedition returned recently from Mogujia, bearing a sample of sha for study.$B$BI had my reservations about this endeavor in the first place, and my worst fears have been realized.$B$BThe sha has escaped containment. I do not need to explain the horror of bringing the sha into the heart of the Vale.$B$BWe must dispel any sha we can find, and quickly!
english.completion: I see that you and my son have been hard at work. Thank you for taking the initiative to aid our cause here in the Vale.
english.completed: Speak to King Varian Wrynn at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 寻找灵魂石
text.objectives: 阅读裘碧卡的日志并利用其中的线索找到四块灵魂石碎片的下落。
text.description: $n，拿上这个——裘碧卡·碎影的日志。$B$B我要你研读这本日志并利用其中的信息找出她去了哪里。$B$B然后再找回裘碧卡的灵魂石并用它来找到她的位置。
text.completion: Тебе удалось найти все четыре фрагмента камня души… Теперь осталось лишь соединить их…
text.completed: Return to the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley

english.title: Seeking the Soulstones
english.objectives: Read Jubeka's Journal and use the clues within to locate the four soulstone fragments.
english.description: $n, take this - the journal of Jubeka Shadowbreaker.$B$BRead the journal and use the information contained within to track down where she went.$B$BFind her soulstones and use them to locate her.
english.completion: Тебе удалось найти все четыре фрагмента камня души… Теперь осталось лишь соединить их…
english.completed: Return to the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley

text.title: Regeneration Takes Time
text.objectives: Collect 10 Sturdy Needles.
text.description: Vol'jin would be dead if he were any race other than a troll. His regeneration is impressive, but it is being blocked by a poison.$b$bWe need to cleanse this poison so that he can regenerate the damage.$b$bTake to the skies and travel southeast. Across the mountain tops of the Secret Aerie you will find needle sprites. Bring me some of the hardest needles from them you can find.$b$bWith them I can attempt an acupuncture technique that should purge the poison from his body and accelerate his regeneration.
text.progress: My herbs are the only thing keeping Vol'jin from death. I dare not leave his side.
text.completion: Very good. These should work nicely.
text.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout in Binan Village of Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 寻找萨尔！
text.objectives: 使用沃金的炉石找到萨尔。
text.description: <沃金半张着一只眼睛，嘴唇翕动，仿佛在说话。虽然听不到声音，可你还是辨认出了几个词。>$b$b去找萨尔。$b$b<沃金挣扎着将一块炉石塞进你手中，然后晕了过去。>
text.progress: You have come a long way to see me, $R. Speak.
text.completion: <Thrall stares at the stone you have handed him.>$B$BVol'jin's hearthstone? My friend, has it come to this?
text.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Find Thrall!
english.objectives: Find Thrall by using Vol'jin's Hearthstone.
english.description: <Vol'jin half opens an eye and begins to move his lips as if to speak.  Though no sound comes, you decipher two words.>$b$bFind Thrall.$b$b<With an effort, Vol'jin thrusts a hearthstone into your hands and then passes out.>
english.progress: You have come a long way to see me, $R. Speak.
english.completion: <Thrall stares at the stone you have handed him.>$B$BVol'jin's hearthstone? My friend, has it come to this?
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: The Horde Is Family
text.objectives: Escort Thrall to the Echo Isles.
text.description: This hearthstone was part of a conversation Vol'jin and I shared a long time ago.$b$bHe believes his people are in danger. I don't know what all has transpired in my absence, but I can at least do this for my friend.$b$bCome, $p, travel with me to the Echo Isles. We must make sure that the Darkspear are safe.
text.completion: Vol'jin has saved my life many times in the past. To see my own Kor'kron used against his people cuts deeper than I can put into words.
text.completed: Speak with Thrall in the Echo Isles of Durotar.

english.objectives: Escort Thrall to the Echo Isles.

I don't know what all has transpired in my absence, but I can at least do this for my friend.$b$bCome, $p, travel with me to the Echo Isles. We must make sure that the Darkspear are safe.
english.completion: Vol'jin has saved my life many times in the past. To see my own Kor'kron used against his people cuts deeper than I can put into words.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall in the Echo Isles of Durotar.

text.title: The Monkey King
text.objectives: Help Anduin Wrynn find the Monkey King in the Valley of Emperors.
text.description: Ever since the Horde captured the Divine Bell I have been searching for a means to counter its power.$b$bMy research got as far as this tomb. I am going inside. If you follow me, I will share the rest as we go.$b$bIf we get separated, meet me back here at the entrance to the tomb. Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.
text.completion: You come asking for the Monkey King?$B$BLet us see how well you ookin' sing.$B$BWho are you, so tiny and boring?$B$BYour cause is silly! You leave me snoring.$B$BThree riddles I will ask,$B$BThese riddles are a task,$B$BFinish each without pause,$B$BAnd we shall see if I help your cause.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at the Tomb of Conquerers in Kun-Lai Summit.
text.giverWindow: Sometimes the only way to beat a legend is with another legend.

english.objectives: Help Anduin Wrynn find the Monkey King in the Valley of Emperors.

If you follow me, I will share the rest as we go.$b$bIf we get separated, meet me back here at the entrance to the tomb. Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

text.title: 寻找信息
text.objectives: 跟随灵魂石的指引前往黑暗神殿。
text.description: 你手中的灵魂石碎片轻易地融合到了一起。$B$B奇怪的是，里面并没有储存灵魂。相反，它似乎还在不断地从影月谷的某处抽取能量。向东望去，你感觉到那股能量来自群山的另一边，一直到黑暗神殿的大门前。
text.completion: Камень души Джубеки привел вас к Черному храму. Осталось только найти путь внутрь...
text.completed: Take the Soulstone to the gates of Black Temple.

english.title: Seek the Signal
english.objectives: Follow the soulstone to the gates of the Black Temple.
english.description: The soulstone shards fuse together easily in your hands.$B$BStrangely, no soul is stored within the stone. Instead, the stone seems to be drawing power from somewhere in Shadowmoon Valley. Looking east, you feel the power linked beyond the mountains, to the very gates of the Black Temple.
english.completion: Камень души Джубеки привел вас к Черному храму. Осталось только найти путь внутрь...
english.completed: Take the Soulstone to the gates of Black Temple.

text.title: 潜入黑暗神殿
text.objectives: 在黑暗神殿的主入口处寻找裘碧卡的印记。进去之后，在神殿之巅与裘碧卡交谈。
text.description: 显然裘碧卡的灵魂石把你带到了黑暗神殿。$B$B可问题是……为什么？$B$B现在你唯一能做的，就是进去找出原因。
text.completion: You have done more for this world than you can know, $C. It is... something of a shame Kanrethad met this end. A shame, but inevitable.

english.title: Infiltrating the Black Temple
english.objectives: Look for Jubeka's mark on the main entrance of the Black Temple.  Once inside, speak to Jubeka at the Temple Summit.
english.description: It's clear that Jubeka's soulstone has lead you here to the Black Temple. $B$BThe question remains... why?$B$BThe only remaining option is to head inside and figure out why they were here.
english.completion: Ты $gсделал:сделала; для этого мира больше, чем можешь себе представить, $gчернокнижник:чернокнижница;. Даже немного жаль, что Канретад закончил таким образом. С другой стороны, это было неизбежно.

text.title: 潜伏
text.objectives: 使用统御岗哨的夺日者传送门潜入达纳苏斯。
text.description: $n！你就是最合适的人选。$b$b我们已经知道联盟把圣钟藏在哪儿了。我们已经在敌方的势力范围内安插了一名密探，只需要你去帮助他执行任务即可。$b$b赶快收拾行装吧，$n。你得去一趟达纳苏斯。
text.completion: $n! So glad Nazgrim selected you.$B$BIt's taken a great deal of the Horde's effort to get you here through Jaina's traps. Maintaining our illusion this close to Darnassus is considerably expensive.$B$BFurthermore, the Sunreavers of Dalaran are risking their neutrality by assisting the Horde with this operation.$B$BIn other words, we expect only the best from you.
text.completed: Report to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

english.title: Insertion
english.objectives: Use the Sunreaver Portal in Domination Point to secure a teleport to Darnassus.
english.description: $n! You'll do perfectly.$b$bWe know where the Alliance have hidden the Divine Bell. We've already inserted an agent into enemy territory, we just need you to help him execute his mission.$b$bPack up, $n. You're headed to Darnassus.
english.completion: $n! So glad Nazgrim selected you.$B$BIt's taken a great deal of the Horde's effort to get you here through Jaina's traps. Maintaining our illusion this close to Darnassus is considerably expensive.$B$BFurthermore, the Sunreavers of Dalaran are risking their neutrality by assisting the Horde with this operation.$B$BIn other words, we expect only the best from you.
english.completed: Report to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往达纳苏斯

text.title: 达纳苏斯行动
text.objectives: 拿到圣钟。$b$b如果陷入困境，你可以使用银月护符返回法利尔身边。
text.description: 圣钟就在城里。我们只想要那个神器，并不打算引发骚乱。我要你设法潜入城中，而且绝不能被抓住。也就是说，你不能用坐骑，也不能飞行，更不能一路杀进去。$b$b我可以协助你，用魔法遮蔽你的身形，让你进入潜行状态。我还会给你一个小护符。万一你陷入麻烦，可以用它脱身。$b$b现在就动身吧，$n，把圣钟一起带回来。
text.completion: Well executed, $R! I knew we could count on you.$B$BNow to get off this wretched tree.
text.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

english.title: The Darnassus Mission
english.objectives: Locate the Divine Bell.$b$bYou may use the Silvermoon Charm to return to Fanlyr if you get in trouble.
english.description: The Divine Bell is in the city. We don't want to cause a scene, we just want the artifact. I need you to find a way in, WITHOUT getting caught. That means no mounts, no flying, no fighting.$b$bI can provide aid. I will magically cloak you, so you may move with stealth. I will also give you a small charm that you may use to return to safety, should you get in trouble.$b$bNow go, $n. Go, locate the bell, and tag it to be teleported back with you.
english.completion: Well executed, $R! I knew we could count on you.$B$BNow to get off this wretched tree.
english.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

text.title: Victorious Return
text.objectives: Report your success to Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
text.description: The portal by my side will return you safely to Domination Point. I will return behind you; I must clean up our tracks a bit before we leave, so that Proudmoore doesn't discover our involvement.
text.completion: You found the bell! And Fanlyr teleported it to Silvermoon for study, as instructed? The Horde will put this to good use.$B$BYou have done the Horde a great service today. Lok'tar, friend!

english.title: Victorious Return
english.objectives: Report your success to Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: The portal by my side will return you safely to Domination Point. I will return behind you; I must clean up our tracks a bit before we leave, so that Proudmoore doesn't discover our involvement.
english.completion: You found the bell! And Fanlyr teleported it to Silvermoon for study, as instructed? The Horde will put this to good use.$B$BYou have done the Horde a great service today. Lok'tar, friend!

text.title: 我要成果！
text.objectives: 去银月城与洛瑟玛·塞隆谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，$p。酋长让我派你去银月城。$b$b他对洛瑟玛的研究进度很不满意，并认为你……对魔古族……的特殊认识或许会对他们有帮助。$b$b所以请你去一趟银月城，命令洛瑟玛加快研究速度。
text.completion: The Warchief "demands" progress? His impatience is growing more destructive with each command.$B$BAs it stands, we could use your expertise.
text.completed: 去银月城与洛瑟玛·塞隆谈一谈。

english.title: Get My Results!
english.objectives: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.
english.description: Ah, $p. The Warchief has instructed me to dispatch you to Silvermoon.$b$bHe grows impatient with the progress of Lor'themar's research and feels they might benefit from your... unique... experiences with the mogu.$b$bGo to Silvermoon and demand that Lor'themar increase the speed of his research.
english.completion: The Warchief "demands" progress? His impatience is growing more destructive with each command.$B$BAs it stands, we could use your expertise.
english.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

text.title: 里面有什么？
text.objectives: 帮助艾萨斯和罗曼斯做实验。
text.description: 我们正在尝试揭开加尔鲁什让我们研究的一个魔古神器的奥秘。但这非常困难，因为所有使用魔法探查它的人，都会受到一股强烈的负面情绪的影响。$b$b我已经请求夺日者的大法师艾萨斯来帮忙，希望他和罗曼斯能够解开这个谜团。他们特别指名要你前去帮忙——你似乎有过类似的经验？$b$b就请你到东边远行者广场下的大厅里去看看能不能帮上忙吧。
text.completion: This reckless use of my people by Garrosh is becoming intolerable. If you had not been here to assist I dread to think what might have happened.
text.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

english.title: What's in the Box?
english.objectives: Assist with Aethas and Rommath's experiment.
english.description: We are trying to uncover the secrets of one of the mogu artifacts Garrosh insisted we investigate. It is proving most difficult, as anyone who probes it magically is greatly affected by raw, negative emotions.$b$bI called in the assistance of Arch-mage Aethas of the Sunreavers in the hopes that he and Rommath could crack this puzzle. They asked for you specifically - apparently you have some relevant experience?$b$bGo to the chamber below Farstrider Square east of here and see if you can assist them.
english.completion: This reckless use of my people by Garrosh is becoming intolerable. If you had not been here to assist I dread to think what might have happened.
english.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

objectiveDetails.description: 与大法师艾萨斯·夺日者交谈

text.title: 肯瑞托
text.objectives: 使用雄狮港通往紫色天台的传送门，与安度因王子见面。
text.description: $p，瓦里安国王让我派你跟随他的儿子一起前往达拉然。他相信你能帮忙说服对方驱逐那里的血精灵。$b$b这些“夺日者”忠于部落，对我们的战局是个重大威胁。$b$b肯瑞托现在的领袖吉安娜·普罗德摩尔是我们自己人，要说服她赶走城市中的部落势力应该不难。$b$b你可以使用雄狮港的传送门前往紫色天台，并助安度因王子一臂之力。
text.completion: I am glad to see you friend. While I have learned much about diplomacy I think Jaina is too familiar with my tactics.$B$BI could use a friendly hand in resolving this conflict.
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Purple Parlor in Dalaran.

english.title: The Kirin Tor
english.objectives: Use the Portal to the Purple Parlor in Lion's Landing and meet with Anduin Wrynn.
english.description: $p, King Varian has asked that I send you after his son to Dalaran. He believes you can help negotiate the withdrawal of blood elves there.$b$bThese "Sunreavers" claim fealty to the Horde and represent a major threat to the war effort.$b$bNow that our very own Jaina Proudmoore is in charge of the Kirin Tor it should be easy to convince her to remove this Horde threat to her city.$b$bUse the portal here in Lion's Landing to go to the Purple Parlor and lend what aid you can to Prince Anduin.
english.completion: I am glad to see you friend. While I have learned much about diplomacy I think Jaina is too familiar with my tactics.$B$BI could use a friendly hand in resolving this conflict.
english.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Purple Parlor in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往紫色天台

text.title: 谜题一：仁慈
text.objectives: 找到美猴王的谜题所描述的东西。
text.description: 如此说来，你是为了一柄钟杵而吵醒了美猴王的，嗯？那就先解答我的三个谜题，然后你才能见到钟杵。$b$b第一个！$b$b“身如磐石，灵性天成。$b$b长于纷争之境，$b$b远在长城之南。$b$b茕茕蛰伏，静待相召。”$b$b把谜底带来给我。
text.progress: Ah, the wise-ish thing returns. Have you my amber?
text.completion: Ah! Amber! Fresh and untamed. Did you kill to get it? But of course.$B$BThough free, the untamed amber is a dangerous thing, and many might die because of it.$B$BMercy comes in many forms, like spikes and mantid and really ookin' spooky storms.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The First Riddle: Mercy
english.objectives: Find the object the Monkey King described in his riddle.
english.description: So, you wake up the Monkey King for a mallet hmmm? Answer first, these riddles three, and then the mallet you shall see.$b$bFirst riddle!$b$b  "Softly singing a song of pain$b$b    There is a creature tortured and lame.$b$b    Way down south and beyond the wall,$b$b    It hides from its wikket masters' call.$b$b    Seek out the creature sad and somber,$b$b    And free it from its untamed amber."$b$bBring me the untamed amber.
english.progress: Ah, the wise-ish thing returns. Have you my amber?
english.completion: Ah! Amber! Fresh and untamed. Did you kill to get it? But of course.$B$BThough free, the untamed amber is a dangerous thing, and many might die because of it.$B$BMercy comes in many forms, like spikes and mantid and really ookin' spooky storms.
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: The Second Riddle: Fellowship
text.objectives: Obtain Metal Brew.
text.description: You want to stop the Divine Bell? We need the mallet first.$b$bYou want the mallet? We need to be friends first.$b$bYou want to be friends? We need a Metal brew first. $b$bYou want a Metal brew? You need to go to the Shrine of Fellowship first. $b$bYou want to go to the Shrine of Fellowship? Great! It's in the Jade Forest southeast of the Tian Monastery.$b$bRing the bell and get the Monkey King some brew while there. Oh... you may have to fight for it.
text.progress: You have the Metal Brew?
text.completion: The Metal Brew is strong and lasting, a brew to be shared with friends after a battle.$B$BEmperor Shaohao and his Monkey King had many a round in our day. Many battles, and many good friends.
text.completed: Speak with The Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.
