text.title: 谜题三：力量
text.objectives: 击败白虎寺的挑战者。
text.description: 你要找的钟杵可不是孩子的玩具。$b$b它就像女妖的歌声一样会招来麻烦。$b$b美猴王要考验你的力量。$b$b然后你才能得到要找的东西。$b$b你要去白虎寺。$b$b让挑战者看看你有多能打。$b$b穿过大门后走右边的斜坡。$b$b像个勇士那样，去挑战等着你的家伙吧！
text.completion: Why engage in duelery? Why engage in foolery?$B$BYou ask the Monkey King for an artifact of power, I have to make sure when the time comes you will not cower. One tough dooker you think you might ookin be, but against mogu, many will turn and flee.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Third Riddle: Strength
english.objectives: Defeat the Challenger at the Tiger Temple.
english.description: The mallet you seek is not a toy for children,$b$bIt calls trouble like the song of a siren.$b$bA test of strength the Monkey King will require,$b$bBefore you receive this tool of your desire.$b$bAt the Temple of the White Tiger you will find$b$bA challenger to test how well you are resigned$b$bStep through the main door and then turn right down the ramp$b$bChallenge the ook waiting for you there like a champ!
english.completion: Why engage in duelery? Why engage in foolery?$B$BYou ask the Monkey King for an artifact of power, I have to make sure when the time comes you will not cower. One tough dooker you think you might ookin be, but against mogu, many will turn and flee.
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: The Greatest Prank
text.objectives: Listen to the Monkey King's story.
text.description: So riddles three you answered me. Good good. The Monkey King is not so old that he tells just anyone his tricks.$b$bIt was the greatest prank ever!$b$bYou want to hear story of the Mallet and the Monkey? Too bad! No choice!
text.completion: It looks like it is going to take us a few days to track all of these "minions" down.$B$BThank you for your help, $n. Meet me in Lion's Landing in a few days and we will embark to track down these objects.
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: The Handle
text.objectives: Recover the Mallet Handle.
text.description: There once was a Chief named Ingoo Ingoo,$b$bWho beat me in a drink drink boogaloo.$b$bHe took the mallet's handle for winning,$b$bNot knowing you can't beat the King in drinking.$b$bMonkey King had to hide the mallet from the bell,$b$bBut Ingoo's children do not use the handle well.$b$bOver the years they have used the handle to do harm,$b$bNow we must find the current chief so we can disarm.$b$bGo south to Unga Ingoo, Monkey King meet you there.$b$bOnly wikkets show to a party with hands bare.
text.progress: Ingoo was a great hozen. Good leader, nice parties, and good booze.
text.completion: Artifacts not make people great. Artifacts allow people to be more of themselves. Good becomes gooder. Bad becomes badder. And Chief Ingoo Ingoo became worser.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: The Head
text.objectives: Recover the Mallet Head.
text.description: Monkey King receive word on where to find the head,$b$bThe hozen who got it has long since been dead. $b$bKunzen chiefs pass the relic from father to son, $b$bBut then virmen Skiggit came and the head it won. $b$bNow the wikket worships it in a hollow. $b$bSince it was too ookin' big for him to swallow. $b$bI sent a royal finder north to find him and stand. $b$bLook for finder in mountains west of the Heartland.
text.progress: You got head?
text.completion: What virmen do not understand, they worship, fight or flee.$B$BI should send them a few statues of me.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King in Lion's Landing of the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: The Harmonic Ointment
text.objectives: Recover the Harmonic Ointment.
text.description: Legends are not born, they are made.$b$BMuch like your next target, a mogu named "The Blade." $b$BIn his bags you will find,$b$bAn ointment whose sound plays with the mind.$b$bBring this nibby ointment to the Monkey King!$b$bAnd with it, he shall make the mallet sing!$b$bTravel north along the wall, and when you reach the end, turn left.
text.progress: How the mogu found the ointment is a wonder.$B$BBut a lot has happened since the world tore assunder.
text.completion: Woot woot!
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.
text.giverWindow: This mogu assassin uses an ointment of dark, harmonic power to slay his opponents.

text.title: 劫掠黑暗神殿
text.objectives: 在到达欢愉之园的尽头之前尽量多拾取一些遗物。
text.description: 当阿卡玛和他的人忙着对付恶魔时，就没人能阻止你窃取一两件遗物了……
text.completion: You've looted everything you could grab on your way up. Time to tally up your plunder and hide it before Akama catches up...

english.title: Plunder the Black Temple
english.objectives: Loot everything you can grab and reach the end of the Den of Mortal Delights.
english.description: While Akama and his men are dealing with the demons, there is nobody to stop you from stealing a relic or two...
english.completion: You collected everything you could carry. It's time to pull the fishing rods before Akama comes back.

text.title: Demonstrate Your Power
text.objectives: Slay the demons who are attacking Akama's men in the Halls of Anguish.
text.description: Akama and his men are under siege by the forces you unleashed in the Reliquary of Souls. $B$BDemonstrate your power to Akama by saving his men from the demonic forces!
text.end: Defeat the Demons before Akama's men are slain
text.completed: Return to Akama inside the Sanctuary of Shadows.

english.completed: Return to Akama inside the Sanctuary of Shadows.

objectiveDetails.description: Slay the Demons in the Halls of Anguish

text.title: The Spirit Trap
text.objectives: Collect 3 Spirit Traps.
text.description:
Within the ruins we have identified several powerful mogu artifacts. They trapped spirits within, probably to use them in some ritual or conjuration.

They are a type of device that we haven't identified and desperately need to study - they may reveal more of the secrets of the mogu's spirit binding techniques. 

Go, find us a few samples so that we may continue a proper study.
text.progress: Have you brought the traps?
text.completion: Ahh, yes. Hmm. Hand that over. Carefully.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: Ogudei's Lieutenants
text.objectives: Collect Meng-do's Essence and Gen-li's Essence in the Ruins of Ogudei.
text.description:
There are two extremely powerful mogu spirits that the Alliance unearthed in their ineptitude.

These are choice targets for us, $c. If you kill them and collect each of their essences, we could make great progress on decoding the history of this strange ruin.
text.progress: The essence isn't going to make itself, $R.
text.completion: What treasures! With any luck, the spirits will return and we will be able to sample their essence further.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 这是个谜
text.objectives: 使用奥术球体在敖骨打废墟中找出一个异形体。
text.description:
我们在这些矿场里侦测到了……若干异形体，似乎是某种奥术或灵魂体。它们一直在干扰我们，让我们无法查明这里缚灵仪式所使用的魔法类型。

虽然它们行踪诡异，但我们还是成功分离出了这些异形体的奥术信号，然后我们的一位法师把它的奥术信号附在了这颗球上。

带上这颗球。你离异形体越近，它发出的光就会越明亮。一旦你到达目的地，你可以使用这颗球把异形体吸引出来。
text.completion: Ahh, yes. I received word from one of our researchers that they are no longer troubled by that anomaly. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: It Is A Mystery
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Bauble to find an anomaly within the Ruins of Ogudei.
english.description:
We have detected several... anomalies in these mines, of an arcane or spiritual nature. They are disrupting our attempts to discern the nature of the magic used in the spirit binding rituals here.

They are quite elusive, but we've managed to isolate the arcane signature of one of these anomalies, and one of our mages has enchanted this bauble with its signature.

Take the bauble. It will begin to glow more brightly as you approach the anomaly. Once you reach it, you can use the bauble to draw it out.
english.completion: Ahh, yes. I received word from one of our researchers that they are no longer troubled by that anomaly. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: We're Not Monsters!
text.objectives: Liberate 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.
text.description:
The Reliquary may have had a bad name in the past, but we're not monsters. We simply hold different views about archaeology than the Explorer's League.

We do focus on performing acts of heroism from time to time. So go, liberate some of the pandaren slave spirits in the ruins.
text.completion: Ah, good work. As much as it may seem trivial in comparison to our larger research goals, it is important that we maintain appearances, $n.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 灾祸猛于鬼！
text.objectives: 击败12个缚魂魔古。
text.description:
你瞧，我们遇到了一件恶心事儿，要是不能把事态控制住的话，雄狮港的老托德曼非把我们踢出去不可。

帮个忙吧，拜托了！
text.completion: Alright! We'll be back up and runnin' in no time!
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Oi Ain't Afraid o' No Ghosts!
english.objectives: Kill 12 Spiritbound Mogu.
english.description:
Look. We got a nasty problem here, and ol' Troteman back at Lion's Landing's gonna throw us out of here if we don't get things under control.

Give us a hand, please!
english.completion: Alright! We'll be back up and runnin' in no time!
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 驱逐令
text.objectives: 在敖骨打废墟击败10名神圣遗物学会成员。
text.description:
该死的神圣遗物学会也混进废墟里来了。他们占据了地势较低的地区，并在那里搞起了他们那套装神弄鬼的把戏。

我要你去狠狠踢爆他们的屁股，把他们都赶走！
text.completion: Ha! That should send 'em runnin' back to Silvermoon with their tail 'tween their legs!
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Eviction Notice
english.objectives: Kill any 10 members of the Reliquary in the Ruins of Ogudei.
english.description:
The bloody Reliquary's snuck into the ruins. They've taken the lower section and are conducting all kinds of magical shenanigans down there.

It's time we gave 'em an eviction notice, in the form of your boot in their rear!
english.completion: Ha! That should send 'em runnin' back to Silvermoon with their tail 'tween their legs!
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败神圣遗物学会成员

text.title: Kick 'em While They're Down
text.objectives: Kill 12 Lion's Landing military units.
text.description:
The Alliance may think they have a stranglehold on the ruins, given that their base of operations is close.

We're going to disabuse them of that notion. Go take out some of their guards.
text.completion: Oh, what a fine day. Alliance fools defeated, and our research is moving ahead quite nicely.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: Echoes of Thunder
text.objectives: Find High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof at the Shrine of Two Moons. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
text.description: Ah, $n, we meet again. I have heard some wondrous news.$B$BHigh Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof of the tauren has arrived here on Pandaria.$B$BHe meets with Warchief Garrosh Hellscream and Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron now, at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.$B$BHe sent me a strange request - to send him a loyal champion of the Horde, capable of combat... and discretion.$B$BI can think of none better to send than you. Speak to Tak-Tak if you seek transport.
text.completion: Well met, $C. You were sent from Domination Point? Very well. We have much to discuss.
text.completed: Speak to High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof in The Imperial Mercantile at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: A Gathering Storm
text.objectives: Confront 6 Sha-Touched Grunts.
text.description: If General Nazgrim sent you, then I trust you are capable of discretion.$B$BWhen I arrived here, I found Garrosh... experimenting... with some ancient power that he found in the mountains to the north.$B$BHe believes that this "sha" can strengthen our soldiers.$B$BUnfortunately, so far the results have been quite the opposite.$B$BOur troops are erupting into random violence. Go and interrogate them. If they threaten you, be prepared to defend yourself.
text.completion: You bested my defenders? Finally, one who can control his hatred and violence!$B$BI need more men like you.
text.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 祥和钟杵
text.objectives: 去征服者陵墓找安度因。与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: $p！安度因王子不知怎么的又把他的警卫们给甩掉了。他对圣光的控制力正与日俱增。$b$b最后一次见到他的时候，他正前往昆莱山。他是在皇帝谷附近把我们的法师甩掉的。$b$b你能找找他吗？他坚持要去找那个所谓的能克制圣钟的东西。或许你可以在他控制你的心灵并让你一路手舞足蹈地跑回来之前，好好劝劝他。$B$B去和范妮谈谈，让她直接送你一程吧。
text.completion: I am glad you made it, my friend. I could really use your help with what is to come. My father would prefer I remain in the safe custody of his legion.$B$BBut if there is one thing Pandaria has taught me, it is a few people in the right place at the right time can make a bigger difference than the greatest of armies.
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Tomb of Conquerers in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Harmonic Mallet
english.objectives: Find Anduin at the Tomb of Conquerors. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: $p! Prince Anduin has somehow slipped his guards again. His control over the light is greatly increasing.$b$bHe was last seen heading to Kun-Lai Summit. He gave our mages the slip around the Valley of Emperors.$b$bCan you find him? He insists on searching for what he claims is a counter to the Divine Bell. Perhaps you can talk some sense into him before he seizes control of your mind and has you dance your way back here.$B$BTalk to Fennie for a ride into the mountains.

text.title: 昆莱探险队
text.objectives: 去加尔鲁什尔先锋营找大酋长贝恩·血蹄。可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 我这里又收到一个血蹄大酋长给你的口信。$B$B看来你给他留下了深刻的印象。$B$B他与酋长的先锋一起去了北边的昆莱山。他们在那里建立了一个营地——加尔鲁什尔先锋营，就在酒坛集的东边。$B$B你最好不要让他久等。你可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
text.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Baine Bloodhoof at Garrosh'ar Advance in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.objectives: Find Baine Bloodhoof at Garrosh'ar Advance. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: I have another message for you from High Chieftain Bloodhoof.$B$BIt seems you've made quite the impression on him.$B$BHe travels with the Warchief's vanguard into Kun-Lai Summit, to the north. They have set up an outpost, Garrosh'ar Advance, just east of One Keg.$B$BYou had best not keep him waiting. Speak to Tak-Tak for swift travel.
english.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Baine Bloodhoof at Garrosh'ar Advance in Kun-Lai Summit.

I believe this brew can coax some helpful information out of Shan Kien.$B$BI am needed here, so I have no choice but to ask you to find the ingredients for me.$B$BThe recipe can be found in a book near my other things, just behind me.

text.title: 昆莱探险队
text.objectives: 去土地精集市找康奈利。你可以与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 荣耀属于联盟，$c。虽然进展缓慢，但我们确实正在卡桑琅丛林逐步建立起对部落的优势。$B$B在守住这边战线的同时，我们还需要你去打响另一场战斗——直击敌人心脏的战斗。$B$B我们军情七处的密谍，特工康奈利传来消息说，一支部落先锋队正在向昆莱山北部山麓移动。$B$B我要你立即出发，到当地与特工康奈利取得联系，查出事情的真相。$B$B你可以去找那边的范妮，让她送你一程。
text.completion: <You do a doubletake when the Pandaren suddenly speaks with Connelly's voice.>$B$B'Bout time, laddie! I've been waitin' fer ya to show up.$B$BThese Pandaren are good people but can't mix a martini fer nothin'.
text.completed: Speak to Agent Connelly at the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Kun-Lai Expedition
english.objectives: Find Connelly at the Grummle Bazaar. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Glory to the Alliance, $c. We are making gains against the Horde in the Krasarang Wilds, albeit slowly.$B$BWhile we hold the front here, we need your help to fight a different battle - one that strikes at our enemy's heart.$B$BOur SI:7 informant, Agent Connelly, has sent word that a Horde vanguard is moving up into the northern reaches of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BGo without delay. Make contact with Agent Connelly in the field, and find out what is going on.$B$BSpeak to Fennie over there for a flight in.

text.title: De-Subjugation
text.objectives: Defeat 10 Kor'kron Overseers, 5 Kor'kron Subjugators, and Gul'tar the Subjugator.
text.description: The Kor'kron have been trained to be the finest, most loyal soldiers of the Warchief. Their presence here means that Garrosh fears an uprising.$b$bVol'jin and his people are as much a part of the Horde as any orc.$b$bWe must break this occupation and free the trolls. It pains me to say this, but you must eliminate enough of the Kor'kron so that the trolls can retake their city. Then meet me at Darkspear Hold so we might challenge their officer directly.
text.completion: The orcs have changed. My Horde has changed. Do I kill my fellow orcs until it is once again "my" Horde? Do I have any right to try force the Horde to be what it once was?$B$BThese are troubling times. But for now, I must see to Vol'jin's people.
text.completed: Speak to Thrall at Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles.

text.objectives: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.
text.description: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. The Alliance has landed on the shores with the full might of its navy. Your King aims to check Horde aggression in this new land.$b$bGarrosh Hellscream is propelling the Horde headfirst into battle, but King Varian Wrynn is a little more of a mystery to me. Do you have a moment? I'd like to talk to you about this leader of yours.
text.completion: I am curious to see how King Wrynn rises to the occasion.$B$BI am even more curious to see what YOU are capable of. Let's find out...

text.title: 王子的追求
text.objectives: 击败卡桑琅丛林南部海滩上的部落军队，直到你在黑王子阵营的声望达到崇敬。
text.description: 我的目标就是暂时终止这场代价高昂的战争。在我看来，联盟完全应该获胜。让我看看你在战场上的实力吧。$b$b我不是要你去面对那些抽象的敌人，例如煞魔，而是要你正面对抗你的敌人。$b$b你是否能凯旋归来呢？
text.completion: Marvelous! Even in the midst of the chaos of battle you've proven that an individual can have an impact. The Horde has learned that their actions in Pandaria will not be unopposed.$B$BI believe it is time for a more substantial challenge...
text.completed: Return to Wrathion in the Tavern in the Mists at the Veiled Stair.

english.title: The Prince's Pursuit
english.objectives: Kill Horde forces along the southern shores of Krasarang Wilds until you are Revered with the Black Prince.
english.description: My goal is an expedient end to this costly war. Prove to me that the Alliance deserves to win. Show me your prowess on the battlefield.$b$bYou are not fighting some abstract force like the sha: You are facing your enemy head-on, eye-to-eye.$b$bWill you triumph?
english.completion: Marvelous! Even in the midst of the chaos of battle you've proven that an individual can have an impact. The Horde has learned that their actions in Pandaria will not be unopposed.$B$BI believe it is time for a more substantial challenge...
english.completed: Return to Wrathion in the Tavern in the Mists at the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 前往皇帝谷！
text.objectives: 去皇帝谷找“来自银月城的朋友”。你可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description:
这封密封信函是寄给你的，里面是一份紧急命令，要求你立刻前往昆莱山的皇帝谷。

情况看来很严重。如果我是你的话，就绝不会耽搁时间。$B$B你可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
text.completion: Ah, good. You have come. $B$BAgain, I apologize for the cryptic note - but Garrosh is increasingly distrustful of us. I do not want this operation disturbed by hasty action on his part.
text.completed: Meet your "Friend from Silvermoon" at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: To the Valley!
english.objectives: Find your "Friend from Silvermoon" at the Valley of Emperors. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description:
This sealed communication was sent for you, along with urgent orders to travel to the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

This looks serious. I'd not delay if I were you.$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak for transportation.
english.completion: Ah, good. You have come. $B$BAgain, I apologize for the cryptic note - but Garrosh is increasingly distrustful of us. I do not want this operation disturbed by hasty action on his part.
english.completed: Meet your "Friend from Silvermoon" at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到“来自银月城的朋友”

text.title: A Kor'kron In Our Midst
text.objectives: Collect 1 Kor'kron Helmet, 1 Kor'kron Armor, and 1 Kor'kron Boots, then combine them into a Kor'kron Disguise.
text.description: Garrosh is hell-bent on finding that Divine Bell. I wouldn't be surprised if he tore Kun-Lai Summit apart to find that artifact.$B$BThe Warchief's called a gathering at Garrosh'ar Advance, just to our north.$B$BI need to stay here to monitor troop movements, so you'll have to infiltrate their camp and overhear their discussion.$B$BGo to Garrosh'ar Advance and steal some Kor'kron Armor from Reavers, Honor Guards, and Scouts.$B$BTake this radio earpiece. Don't contact me... I'll contact you.
text.progress: Just as you look at the assembled Kor'kron disguise, your radio earpiece crackles.
text.completion: <Agent Connelly's voice comes over the radio.>$B$BEy, you're good! I knew those Kor'kron wouldn't be a problem fer ya. Couldn't've done much better meself.

text.title: 扫清道路
text.objectives: 击败10个寇茹魔古。
text.description:
首先，如果我们要抓住那个首领，就得先削减他手下的数量。

小心点。这些魔古族非常危险——他们似乎拥有操纵煞能的手段，这是我们从未见过的。
text.completion: Good. We should be ready to make our move.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Clearing a Path
english.objectives: Kill 10 Korune Mogu.
english.description:
First thing's first. If we're going to take the leader captive, we'll need to thin the numbers of his agents.

Be careful. These mogu are particularly dangerous - they appear to be manipulating the sha in ways we haven't seen before.
english.completion: Good. We should be ready to make our move.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 寇茹的遗产
text.objectives: 在皇帝谷找到有关寇茹遗产的卷轴，并从寇茹魔古族身上收集封印的寇茹神器和寇茹指令。
text.description:
我可不想再派我的人去对付我们根本不了解的敌人了。

我要你去看看能不能在这里发现什么线索，找出这些“寇茹”魔古究竟是什么人。一旦有什么意外，这次行动就无法按计划进行了。
text.progress: Have you found anything on the mogu?
text.completion: Good. There's quite a bit to pore through here... $B$BI will have the Reliquary investigate these. Surely we can use them to discern more of the secrets of these Korune mogu.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Legacy of the Korune
english.objectives: Find the document Legacy of the Korune in the Valley of the Emperors, and collect the Sealed Korune Artifact and Korune Orders from Korune Mogu.
english.description:
I'm not prepared to throw away more of our people fighting against an enemy we don't know or understand. 

See if you can find any clues in the area as to who exactly these "Korune" mogu are. A contingency in case this operation doesn't go as planned.
english.progress: Have you found anything on the mogu?
english.completion: Good. There's quite a bit to pore through here... $B$BI will have the Reliquary investigate these. Surely we can use them to discern more of the secrets of these Korune mogu.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 最佳人选
text.objectives: 去暴风城的矿道地铁找比兹莫搏击俱乐部的卧底探员汤斯丽。
text.description: 要想搞明白加尔鲁什针对潘达利亚的计划，我们就需要帮助。$b$b我的脑子里就有一个人选，可这人不容易说服。$b$b特工康奈利觉得自己已经退休了，但军情七处可不是能让人随意进出的地方。这几个月来，我们的卧底一直在监视着他的一举一动。$b$b目前，他就在比兹莫搏击俱乐部里乔装成一名烂赌鬼，好像是有一笔旧账要收。$b$b去搏击俱乐部见见我们的卧底吧。
text.completion: Following Connelly has been interesting to say the least. The man is a master of disguise!$B$BTalking him into joining you won't be the hard part, $C. Figuring out which of these lively individuals is him will be next to impossble.

english.title: The Best Around
english.objectives: Report to undercover agent Townsley in Bizmo's Brawlpub in the Stormwind side of Deeprun Tram.
english.description: We're going to need help if we hope to figure out Garrosh's plans for Pandaria.$b$bI have someone specific in mind, but he will not be easy to convince.$b$bAgent Connelly considers himself retired, but one does not simply leave the SI: 7. We've had an undercover agent following his every move for months.$b$bCurrently, he is disguising himself as a high roller at Bizmo's Brawlpub. Something about settling an old debt.$b$bMeet with our undercover agent in the Brawler's Guild.
english.completion: Following Connelly has been interesting to say the least. The man is a master of disguise!$B$BTalking him into joining you won't be the hard part, $C. Figuring out which of these lively individuals is him will be next to impossble.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到比兹莫搏击俱乐部

text.title: 排查间谍
text.objectives: 将粉色旱獭、魔古鲜榨甜瓜汁和锈色利刃送给正确的顾客。
text.description: 现在，我可以告诉你哪个是康奈利，可这就太简单了！要想抓住间谍，你就得像间谍那样思考。$b$b你得先通过考验。$b$b间谍会关注到最小的细节。一些细枝末节往往就能透露出很多信息。$b$b我会让你去送一杯饮料，并告诉你接收者身上的一个小细节。然后就看你的了。$b$b仔细辨别出你应该把饮料送给谁。这里的人要是你把酒水给他送错了，他们可是要揍人的！
text.completion: You have a keen eye, $C! I think you are ready to meet Connelly.
text.completed: Speak with Barkeep Townsley in the Brawler's Guild

english.title: To Catch A Spy
english.objectives: Deliver the Pink Marmot, the Mogu Melon Twist, and the Rusty Dagger to the correct patron.
english.description: Now, I could tell you who Connelly is, but that would be too easy! To catch a spy you have to think like a spy.$b$bYou have to pass the test first!$b$bThe small things can say a lot about a person. It's all in the details.$b$bI'm going to give you a drink to deliver. I will give you a small detail about something the recipient is wearing. From there it will be up to you.$b$bBe careful who you pick to give drinks to. People here tend to get pretty hostile if you give them the wrong order!
english.completion: You have a keen eye, $C! I think you are ready to meet Connelly.
english.completed: Speak with Barkeep Townsley in the Brawler's Guild

text.title: 深入敌后
text.objectives: 去昆莱山找康奈利。与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 特工康奈利已经设法潜入了加尔鲁什在昆莱山的营地！他一直混在部落的战士当中监视他们的一举一动。$b$b他指名要你去帮他收集一些重要情报。$b$b他还送来一套伪装。那里的守卫肯定很森严。在靠近营地前，你一定要穿上它！$b$b他坚持认为你能够认出他来。还说你有一双善于发现细节的眼睛……$B$B去和范妮说一声，让她送你一程吧。
text.completion: You've arrived just in time. From the intel I've gathered, Garrosh is hot on the trail of some sort of ancient mogu artifact of power.$B$BIf we can figure out what he's after, we can stop him from getting it!$B$BWe have to act fast to gather as much information as possible.
text.completed: Speak to Connelly in Kun-Lai Summit at Fire Camp Bataar.

english.title: He's In Deep
english.objectives: Meet Connelly in Kun-Lai Summit. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Agent Connelly has managed to infiltrate Garrosh's camp in Kun-Lai! He's been following their every move.$b$bConnelly requested you specifically to assist him in gathering some vital intelligence.$b$bHe sent along a disguise for you. Make sure you put it on before approaching the camp! It will no doubt be heavily guarded.$b$bHe insists you will know him when you see him. Something about your keen eye for details...$B$BGo talk to Fennie over there for a drop-off.
english.completion: You've arrived just in time. From the intel I've gathered, Garrosh is hot on the trail of some sort of ancient mogu artifact of power.$B$BIf we can figure out what he's after, we can stop him from getting it!$B$BWe have to act fast to gather as much information as possible.
english.completed: Speak to Connelly in Kun-Lai Summit at Fire Camp Bataar.

text.title: Bugging Out
text.objectives: Plant the Cleverly Disguised Bugs in the large tent, near the small tents, and in the supplies.
text.description: I've managed to plant a few bugs around the camp, but there could always be more.$b$bI disguised the bugs to look like statues. They blend in perfectly with the other artifacts lying around.$b$bYour disguise should allow you to move freely around the camp. Just don't go near the dog and don't linger around Garrosh! Nero and Garrosh will see through your disguise.$b$bIf you get caught I can't help you. I can't compromise the mission!
text.completion: Well done! Everyone always underestimates the little guys and it is always a grave mistake!
text.completed: Return to Cousin Goottooth in Fire Camp Bataar.

text.title: 擒贼擒王
text.objectives: 前往昆莱山的暗影古陵，削弱并俘获单简。
text.description:
现在该我们行动了。快去暗影古陵削弱并抓住他。

我会留在这里，以防加尔鲁什赶到——我会尽量拖住他，好让我们在他愤怒地摧毁一切前拿到属于我们的战利品。

快去吧！
text.completion: We managed to capture our quarry. $B$BIn truth, though, I am not sure what our next move should be. I will contact the leaders of our allies and see if they have ideas - I don't know that our arcane talents are going to pry the secrets of our mogu captive.
text.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.
text.giverWindow: 寇茹魔古的首领。活捉他！

english.title: Trapping the Leader
english.objectives: Weaken and capture Shan Kien at the Tomb of Shadows in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
It is time to make our move. Go to the Tomb of Shadows, weaken him, and take him captive.

I will stay here in case Garrosh arrives. He must be delayed so that we can take our prize before he destroys it in his anger.

Hurry!
english.completion: We managed to capture our quarry. $B$BIn truth, though, I am not sure what our next move should be. I will contact the leaders of our allies and see if they have ideas - I don't know that our arcane talents are going to pry the secrets of our mogu captive.
english.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.giverWindow: The leader of the Korune. Take him alive!

text.title: 朝令夕改
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨击败血柄督军。建议你组队前往。
text.description: 我一直在密切监视一个兽人将军。由于在南贫瘠之地击退了联盟的先头部队，血柄督军获得了加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的赏识。他现在就呆在统御岗哨的堡垒里。$b$b我很怀疑联盟能否干掉他。可是……你以前就曾证明过我的判断有误。$b$b如果你想干掉他，一定要找几个朋友一起去。记得多带点人。
text.completion: <Wrathion grins.>$B$BYou were being tested, $C. I knew you were capable of great things by yourself.$B$BBut you have proven to me that you have the makings of a leader, cobbling together support among a group of strangers in the midst of a battlefield.$B$BThe Alliance is fortunate to have you.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: A Change of Command
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Bloodhilt at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds. You will need a group.
english.description: There's an orc general I've been keeping a close eye on. Warlord Bloodhilt curried a lot of favor with Garrosh Hellscream by beating back an Alliance advance in Southern Barrens. He's now entrenched within the fortress at Domination Point.$b$bI doubt the Alliance can take him out. But... you've proven me wrong before.$b$bIf you wish to finish him off, bring friends. Lots of friends.
english.completion: <Wrathion grins.>$B$BYou were being tested, $C. I knew you were capable of great things by yourself.$B$BBut you have proven to me that you have the makings of a leader, cobbling together support among a group of strangers in the midst of a battlefield.$B$BThe Alliance is fortunate to have you.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 雄狮怒吼
text.objectives: 赢得寇魔古寺和碎银矿脉的胜利。
text.description: 这是一场全球战争，$n。它不仅波及了潘达利亚，连卡利姆多和东部王国也同样战火频燃。你在有组织的战场上会表现如何呢？我很想亲眼看一看。$b$b我期待听到你从前线带回的报告。
text.completion: <Wrathion hungrily listens to tales of your exploits on the battlefield, his eyes gleaming bright red.>$B$BOhh... oh! Incredible! In the very eye of battle, one's true heart is revealed.$B$BYou do not disappoint, $n.$B$BNeither does your Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: The Lion Roars
english.objectives: Win battles at the Temple of Kotmogu and the Silvershard Mines.
english.description: This is a global war, $n. It has spilled onto Pandaria, and it has set hot spots across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms ablaze. How will you fare on an organized battlefront? I would like to see for myself.$b$bI look forward to hearing your report from the front lines.
english.completion: <Wrathion hungrily listens to tales of your exploits on the battlefield, his eyes gleaming bright red.>$B$BOhh... oh! Incredible! In the very eye of battle, one's true heart is revealed.$B$BYou do not disappoint, $n.$B$BNeither does your Alliance.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

objectiveDetails.description: 在寇魔古寺赢得一场胜利
在碎银矿脉赢得一场胜利

text.title: Call of the Packmaster
text.objectives: Speak with Wrathion.
text.description: $C, through your eyes I've been able to witness the fighting along the coast, and the epic course of battles around the world. You've been very patient... and most informative.$b$bI've also been keeping a close eye on your King. Would you be interested to hear what I've learned?
text.completion: <A strange device sits within an ornate silk-lined chest. It appears as though it can be fastened to your sha-touched weapon as an additional upgrade. The empty socket is disconcerting; you feel as though it is staring back at you. A single, hollow, judgmental eye...>
text.completed: Choose your reward from Wrathion's chest at the Tavern in the Mist.

text.title: The Ruins of Korune
text.objectives: Find Ishi at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
text.description: Garrosh sent a hundred riders to search the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit, to seek a mogu crypt matching the one you saw in Shan Kien's memory.$B$BOut of those, one found the resting place of the Divine Bell.$B$BBlademaster Ishi is leading an advance party to secure the bell now.$B$BGo and assist him. Defend that artifact from anyone who might stand in your way!$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak without delay. He can take you there.
text.completion: The Alliance beat us here. How could this happen?
text.completed: Speak to Ishi at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: The Divine Bell
text.objectives: Kill Sarannha Skyglaive.
text.description: If the Alliance thought they could steal the Divine Bell from us, they were wrong!$B$BEven now, we have them trapped in the crypts beneath us.$B$BDeath will be the price they pay for defying us.$B$BCome, $c. Let us show them the error of their ways.
text.completion: Darnassus, is it?$B$BThe Alliance believes they have won the day. Now, when their arrogance is at its greatest, is our opportunity to pluck the prize from their fingers.
text.completed: Speak to Ishi at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: The Ruins of Korune
text.objectives: Find Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
text.description: It's time for our boldest move yet, $n.$B$BSince you acquired intel on the location of the Divine Bell, we've amassed a top team to excavate the artifact without delay.$B$BCommander Sarannha Skyglaive leads the expedition into the northern-most reaches of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BJoin them at once, and use whatever skills you need to make the endeavor a success.$B$BGood luck, $c. I don't need to tell you how important this mission is to the Alliance.$B$BSpeak to Fennie. She'll get you there quickly.
text.completion: We blasted the doors open moments ago, $C. You arrived just in time to join us for the excavation.
text.completed: Speak to Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 圣钟
text.objectives: 击败织恐者阿瓦图并夺取圣钟。
text.description: 谁也不知道下面会有什么，所以我会亲自带领一队斥候下去进行初步勘察。$B$B如果你的情报准确，那寇茹魔古应该就把圣钟藏在我们脚下的墓室里。$B$B我有预感，如此宝贵的神器肯定不会无人看守。$B$B我正需要像你这样能力出众的$c来掩护我。你准备好之后，请告诉我一声。
text.completion: Fantastic work, $n. I could not even imagine the atrocity that Garrosh would commit if this bell were to fall into his hands.$B$BToday, we have secured a safe future for the Alliance. I will see to it that the bell makes it safely to Darnassus.$B$BI will extoll your deeds to the King.
text.completed: Speak to Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Divine Bell
english.objectives: Kill Dreadweaver Avartu and recover the Divine Bell.
english.description: There's no telling what lies below, so I will lead the initial scouting party myself.$B$BIf your report was correct, then the Korune mogu hid the Divine Bell in the rooms below our very feet.$B$BI have a feeling they would not have left such a precious artifact unguarded.$B$BI could use a capable $c such as yourself to watch my back. Let me know when you're ready.
english.completion: Fantastic work, $n. I could not even imagine the atrocity that Garrosh would commit if this bell were to fall into his hands.$B$BToday, we have secured a safe future for the Alliance. I will see to it that the bell makes it safely to Darnassus.$B$BI will extoll your deeds to the King.
english.completed: Speak to Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: He Won't Even Miss It
text.objectives: Create a distraction in the camp and steal the Weathered Journal.
text.description: I've noticed Garrosh and that Reliquary blood elf carrying around some sort of journal.$b$bThe journal is never more than a stone's throw away. It must be important!$b$bIf you can cause enough of a distraction, you may be able to swipe the journal off the table.$b$bThese yaks might just do the trick. Give one of 'em a tap and they'll do the rest.$b$bJust be ready to move fast!
text.progress: What did you find?
text.completion: Phew! That was a close one! I never doubted you for a minute though.$B$BNow let me take a look at that journal...
text.completed: Return to Cousin Goottooth in Fire Camp Bataar.

text.title: 圣钟鸣响
text.objectives: 去帝皇之域找马尔考罗克。你可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 你的努力终于得到了回报，$c。$B$B加尔鲁什酋长召集了部落最精锐的勇士前往昆莱山见证圣钟的鸣响。$B$B而你更将有机会参与其中。$B$B快去吧。新部落的黎明将从今天开始。$B$B去跟泰克泰克谈一谈，他会帮你安排行程的。
text.completion: I was wondering when you would arrive, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Malkorok at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Bell Speaks
english.objectives: Find Malkorok at Emperor's Reach. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: Your efforts have culminated in this moment, $c.$B$BWarchief Garrosh gathers the most elite champions of the Horde in Kun-Lai Summit to witness the ringing of the Divine Bell.$B$BYou have more than earned the right to participate.$B$BGo now. The dawn of the new Horde begins today.$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak. He should be able to secure your travel arrangements.
english.completion: I was wondering when you would arrive, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Malkorok at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 去帝皇之域找马尔考罗克

text.title: Breath of Darkest Shadow
text.objectives: Witness the ringing of the Divine Bell.
text.description: It is time, $n. We have traveled a long path to reach this moment.$B$BToday, our Warchief, Garrosh Hellscream, will change the course of our people's history forever.$B$BToday, we witness the birth of Garrosh's Horde!$B$BDo not let anything interfere with the ceremony!
text.completion: They may have destroyed the Divine Bell, but I have taken the life of the Alliance's prodigal son!$B$BIt is nothing less than my own father would have expected of me.$B$BThis victory may have come at a high cost, but it is of little consequence.$B$BI will find other ways to destroy my enemies, and bring glory to the Horde!
text.completed: Speak to Garrosh at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 圣钟鸣响
text.objectives: 去帝皇之域找安度因。与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 部落军队正在向昆莱山的帝皇之域大量集结。$B$B那里有一座古代魔古宫殿，而且显然是某种未知力量的源头。$B$B这只能说明一件事：加尔鲁什打算要使用圣钟了。而安度因……和祥和钟杵……都失踪了。$B$B我毫不怀疑，那个傻小子肯定亲身前往北方了。$B$B我没时间召集精锐部队去找他了。你必须去阻止安度因。$B$B范妮会送你过去的。
text.completion: $n! Just the $C I was hoping to see. You couldn't have arrived at a better time.
text.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Bell Speaks
english.objectives: Find Anduin at Emperor's Reach. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Horde forces are amassing in huge numbers at the Emperor's Reach, high up in the mountains of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BThe area is an ancient mogu palace, and certainly a source of untold power.$B$BThis can only mean one thing. Garrosh is going to use the Divine Bell, and Anduin... and the Harmonic Mallet... are both missing.$B$BI have no doubt that the fool boy went north by himself.$B$BI don't have time to gather an elite force to detain him. You must go and stop Anduin.$B$BFennie can take you.
english.completion: $n! Just the $C I was hoping to see. You couldn't have arrived at a better time.
english.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: Breath of Darkest Shadow
text.objectives: Defeat Ishi and destroy the Divine Bell.
text.description: Garrosh is right over there, and he's going to ring that bell at any moment.$B$BWe don't have time to wait for my father's army. This is our only chance to stop him!$B$BI'll attempt to appeal to his senses before resorting to using the Harmonic Mallet.$B$BCharge in whenever you're ready, $n. I'll be right behind you.
text.completion: <Anduin looks like a crumpled doll. He lays as still as a stone, and the only movement comes from the frigid air ruffling his fair, golden hair.>$B$B<You sit quietly for a while, until the cold settles into your bones. The bell is destroyed, but the silence is deafening.>$B$B<Out of the corner of your eye, you see the slightest flicker from the boy's hand. You lean in close. He breathes - but just barely! Anduin is alive!>
text.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Breath of Darkest Shadow
english.objectives: Defeat Ishi and destroy the Divine Bell.
english.description: Garrosh is right over there, and he's going to ring that bell at any moment.$B$BWe don't have time to wait for my father's army. This is our only chance to stop him!$B$BI'll attempt to appeal to his senses before resorting to using the Harmonic Mallet.$B$BCharge in whenever you're ready, $n. I'll be right behind you.
english.completion: <Anduin looks like a crumpled doll. He lays as still as a stone, and the only movement comes from the frigid air ruffling his fair, golden hair.>$B$B<You sit quietly for a while, until the cold settles into your bones. The bell is destroyed, but the silence is deafening.>$B$B<Out of the corner of your eye, you see the slightest flicker from the boy's hand. You lean in close. He breathes - but just barely! Anduin is alive!>
english.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 达拉然的局势
text.objectives: 与库姆萨尔谈一谈，让他送你去达拉然。
text.description: 暗夜精灵知道圣钟被偷了。我们对此早有预料。$b$b可是，他们还发现达拉然那群一直保持“中立”的夺日者也是这次事件的同谋。这样，我们就有麻烦了。$b$b我要你去一趟达拉然。你可以去跟库姆萨尔谈谈，让他送你一程。当你抵达之后，就去跟大法师罗曼斯汇合。
text.completion: Good... you've arrived. It's not a good day to be Horde in Dalaran.$B$BJaina's called for the exile of all the Sunreavers. You and I are going to save as many as we can - including Archmage Aethas Sunreaver himself - and then get out of here as fast as possible.
text.completed: Report to Grand Magister Rommath.

english.title: The Situation In Dalaran
english.objectives: Speak with Kromthar to obtain a ride to Dalaran.
english.description: The night elves learned that the Divine Bell was stolen. This much we anticipated.$b$bHowever, they've also found out that the "neutral" Sunreavers of Dalaran were complicit. Now, we've got a situation.$b$bI need you to go to Dalaran. Speak with Kromthar for a ride. You are to rendezvous with Grand Magister Rommath once you arrive.
english.completion: Good... you've arrived. It's not a good day to be Horde in Dalaran.$B$BJaina's called for the exile of all the Sunreavers. You and I are going to save as many as we can - including Archmage Aethas Sunreaver himself - and then get out of here as fast as possible.
english.completed: Report to Grand Magister Rommath.

text.title: It Starts in the Sewers
text.objectives: Evacuate 9 Sunreaver Citizens.
text.description: Compared to the rest of the city, this part of the sewers is relatively calm. This is good - we can extract more Sunreavers in peace than we can in war.$b$bFind as many citizens as you can. Tell them that it is not safe here, that they must leave the city at once.$b$bAnd try to stay clear of the Silver Covenant. We don't want to cause a scene if we can avoid it. Not yet, anyhow.
text.completion: Let's press on.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: Violence in the Arena
text.objectives: Slay 6 Silver Covenant Enforcers and 4 Silver Covenant Spellbows.
text.description: As I suspected, it gets worse up ahead. The Silver Covenant is outright attacking innocent Sunreavers!$b$bThis cannot stand. While our prime directive is to rescue Aethas Sunreaver, we must also protect as many blood elves as we can.$b$bI will continue to scout ahead. Fight well, $c!
text.completion: So much bloodshed! In a place of peace!$B$BJaina has gone too far this time.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.objectives: Slay Sorin Magehand.
text.description: Every Sunreaver Jaina expels from this city is a new blade that fights for the Horde. For US.$b$bI'm off to gather more strong elves. You've proven your hand in combat thus far - go take care of that creep in the black market.$b$bWhen you're done, we'll meet at the ramp and prepare to go aboveground.
text.completion: The first stage of our mission is complete. That was the easy part.$B$B<Rommath takes a deep, measured breath, then continues...>
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.objectives: Follow Grand Magister Rommath into the center of Dalaran.
text.description: If we're to survive up above ground, we're going to need a base of operations.$b$bI'm going to try to take the center of the city. It's risky, but hopefully Jaina and the Silver Covenant won't expect it.$b$bStay by my side now, $n.
text.completion: Now, let's move quickly.

text.title: The Silver Covenant's Stronghold
text.objectives: Slay Arcanist Rathaella.
text.description: I have it on good authority that Archmage Aethas Sunreaver is being held in the Silver Enclave, home of the Silver Covenant. Arcanist Rathaella holds him in captivity.$b$bMost Covenant agents are out slaughtering Sunreavers right now, which means our chance is ripe. Slay Rathaella, and spring Aethas from his prison.
text.completion: We will continue saving Sunreavers for a while longer. Aethas' location may become clearer as we press on.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: The Silver Covenant's Stronghold
english.objectives: Slay Arcanist Rathaella.
english.description: I have it on good authority that Archmage Aethas Sunreaver is being held in the Silver Enclave, home of the Silver Covenant. Arcanist Rathaella holds him in captivity.$b$bMost Covenant agents are out slaughtering Sunreavers right now, which means our chance is ripe. Slay Rathaella, and spring Aethas from his prison.

text.title: The Kirin Tor's True Colors
text.objectives: Slay Lieutenant Corwin and 10 of his troops.
text.description: Any pretense that the Kirin Tor might have had at being a "neutral" group can officially be discarded. I'm now hearing that Jaina's got Alliance troops stowed away near Antonidas Memorial.$b$bThe area's free of Sunreavers, but it still makes my blood boil to see such blatant favoritism from the Kirin Tor.$b$bGo visit the memorial, $n... and give those Alliance dogs a good kick on your way through.
text.completion: Thank you for that, $n.$B$BIt unsettles me to have to fight directly with the high elves of the Silver Covenant... but I never tire of slaying Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.completion: Well done, $n. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.objectives: Use the Tear of the Sin'dorei on Uda the Beast, High Arcanist Savor, Magister Hathorel, Magister Surdiel, and Magistrix Vesara.
text.description: There's still a number of significant Sunreavers who haven't been accounted for. Odds are that they're in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary, caught by surprise.$b$b<Rommath hands you an artifact, clearly made by blood elf hands.>$b$bThe place is crawling with Silver Covenant. text.completion: Excellent. They should be waiting for us in Silvermoon when we return.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.objectives: Slay Mage-Commander Zuros, then escape from Dalaran.
text.description: We've looked everywhere he's likely to be, except for one place: the Violet Citadel.$b$bFind out if Archmage Aethas is being held within the citadel, $n. We may get lucky. If not... at least we saved a number of lives today.
text.completion: Is this... $n? What's going on here?
text.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

text.title: A Return to Krasarang
text.objectives: Report to General Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
text.description: Wherever your loyalties might lie - with Rommath and I, with Garrosh, or elsewhere - one thing is true: your acts today were truly heroic.$b$bI can arrange for your transport back to Krasarang Wilds. Speak with me if you would like passage back to Pandaria, $n.
text.completion: <Nazgrim listens as you recount the day's events.>$B$BWe take the bell... and the Alliance takes Dalaran. That escalated quickly.$B$BWar is coming, $n. Be on your toes.

text.title: 达纳苏斯遭袭？
text.objectives: 去找雄狮港的谢默斯·金足，传送去达纳苏斯，到那以后与吉安娜谈一谈。
text.description: 你应该已经知道了，为了方便保管和研究，我们的暗夜精灵盟友将你夺回的圣钟运去了达纳苏斯。不久之前，他们派了几个高等精灵法师前来求援。具体情况不明——好像是有人偷袭了那座城市？$b$b我不知道那是怎么发生的，可吉安娜·普罗德摩尔已经赶到了现场。我想他们会需要一切可能的帮助。$b$b去跟那边的谢默斯·金足谈谈，快速传送去达纳苏斯，找到吉安娜！
text.completion: The Bell is gone...$B$BAt the scene of the crime, we found traces of arcane magic... I may be able to use my skills to track the thieves.
text.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

english.title: Darnassus Attacked?
english.objectives: Speak with Seamus Goldenkicks in Lion's Landing to be ported to Darnassus, then speak with Jaina once you arrive.
english.description: As you know, our night elven allies moved the Divine Bell you retrieved to Darnassus for safekeeping and study. Moments ago, they portaled some Highbourne mages over here to ask for backup. Details are hazy - some sort of stealth attack on the city?$b$bI don't know what to make of it, but Jaina Proudmoore is already on the scene and I suspect they need all the help they can get.$b$bSpeak to Seamus Goldenkicks over there for a quick portal to Darnassus. Find Jaina!
english.completion: The Bell is gone...$B$BAt the scene of the crime, we found traces of arcane magic... I may be able to use my skills to track the thieves.
english.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

text.title: Jaina's Resolution
text.objectives: Use the portal from Darnassus to Dalaran, then speak with Vereesa Windrunner on the other side.
text.description: For too long, I have toiled to mend fences between Alliance and Horde. Time and time again, I've given the Horde the benefit of the doubt - and time and time again, they stab me in the back.$b$bI refuse to be betrayed again! If the Horde intends to use the Kirin Tor as a weapon against the Alliance, then they have no place in Dalaran.$b$bCome with me, $n.
text.completion: I will instruct you from here on out.$B$BJaina will be going down into the city to enforce our new rules.
text.completed: Report to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.objectives: Slay 12 Sunreavers in the Dalaran Sewers.
text.description: Jaina's doing a good job taking care of Sunreavers above ground, but there's still plenty rooting around in the sewers.$b$bGo find those lying rats and exterminate them!
text.completion: It's nice to have those rats out of here for good. Well done, hero.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.objectives: Slay Inkmaster Aelon, Tolyria, Gearmage Astalon, and Sintharia Cinderweave.
text.description: Most shopkeepers in the Magus Commerce Exchange have sided with the Silver Covenant, but there remain a few holdouts that must be taken care of.$b$b<Vereesa shows you a list of names.>$b$bThey will not go easily.
text.completion: While I can't say I agree completely with Jaina's methods, I do understand her motives.$B$BSometimes, you have to fight back.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.title: Nowhere to Hide
text.objectives: Slay 16 Sunreavers in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary.
text.description: The Sunreaver's Sanctuary is still crawling with those Horde-loving Sunreavers.$b$bJaina will have sent the reasonable ones to the Violet Hold. The rest refuse to leave, raising their weapons against us.$b$bShow them the cost of their defiance. They now face the judgment of the Alliance, the Silver Covenant, and the Kirin Tor!
text.completion: This is a bloody day, $n, and this is bloody work.$B$BBut do not forget what the Sunreavers did to bring this on: They used neutral Kirin Tor resources to aid the Horde in their fight against the Alliance.$B$BDo not hesitate to believe that they would do the same to us, given the chance.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.objectives: Slay Magister Brasael.
text.description: I just saw one of the Sunreavers - Brasael, I think his name was - running off in the direction of the bank to the north. No doubt he's trying to gather whatever assets he can before he leaves.$b$bHead him off and make sure he doesn't steal any resources from our coffers. He relinquished whatever funds he left in the bank when he and his Sunreaver kind betrayed us.
text.completion: I suppose it wasn't enough for him to be a coward and a backstabber... he had to be a greedy thief as well.$B$BHmph. The Horde and the Sunreavers aren't all that different. They deserve one another.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.completion: Now, the Sunreavers have to answer to us. Jail or death - their fate is in their own hands.

text.title: What Had To Be Done
text.objectives: Speak with Vereesa Windrunner to travel to Lion's Landing, then speak with King Varian Wrynn.
text.description: Thank you for your aid today, $n. I will be handling the purge from here on out.$b$bJaina will soon be off to Lion's Landing, to speak with King Varian. She asked for your attendance.
text.completion: I can't fault you for following orders. In fact, I can't really fault Jaina for acting on her own behalf, for once.$B$BBut still... we aren't playing a game here. We are dealing with war, with people's lives, with the future of the Alliance itself.$B$BAt the very least, we now have the Kirin Tor on our side. Today will be remembered by all as a victory for the Alliance.

text.title: 烦而不乱
text.objectives: 去搏击俱乐部的贵宾室找到基尔特教授。
text.description: 好吧，我来告诉该怎么找康奈利。$b$b特工康奈利现在假扮成了烂赌鬼——基尔特教授。他大部分时间都呆在贵宾室里。据说他跟踪某位拳手而来，一个早就被人遗忘的叛徒。$b$b不幸的是，只有拥有邀请函的人才能进入贵宾室。而幸运的是，我正好就有一张。$b$b你走过那些保镖身边时，尽量不要引人注意。如果你被抓住了，千万别说邀请函是我给的。$b$b事实上，咱俩根本就没见过！
text.completion: So the SI: 7 needs a reminder in what the word retirement means?$B$BI suppose they wouldn't be comin' to me if the situation weren't dire.$B$BI'll help, but I'll need a few days to gather some intel.

english.title: Stirred, Not Shaken
english.objectives: Find Professor Kilt in the Boom Room in Bizmo's Brawlpub.
english.description: Alright, I'll tell you how to find Connelly.$b$bAgent Connelly is currently posing as the high roller, Professor Kilt. He spends most of his time in the Boom Room. Rumor has it he's after one of the fighters for some long forgotten betrayal.$b$bUnfortunately, the lounge is by invitation only. Lucky for you I just happen to have an invitation.$b$bTry not to look too obvious when you walk past the bouncers. If you get caught you didn't get this pass from me.$b$bIn fact you and I have never met!
english.completion: So the SI: 7 needs a reminder in what the word retirement means?$B$BI suppose they wouldn't be comin' to me if the situation weren't dire.$B$BI'll help, but I'll need a few days to gather some intel.

text.title: The Measure of a Leader
text.objectives: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.
text.description: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. Your Warchief aims to impress the Pandaren with the full might of the Horde's military. He will lay claim to the resources of this land, with or without Pandaren aid.$b$bI understand your leader's aims, but I really want to understand the Warchief himself. What drives him? text.title: The Prince's Pursuit
text.objectives: Kill Alliance forces along the southern shores of Krasarang Wilds until you are Revered with the Black Prince.
text.description: My goal is an expedient end to this costly war. Prove to me that the Horde deserves to win. Show me your prowess on the battlefield.$b$bYou are not fighting some abstract force like the sha: You are facing your enemy head-on, eye-to-eye.$b$bWill you triumph?

text.title: A Change of Command
text.objectives: Kill High Marshal Twinbraid at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds. You will need a group.
text.description: There's an Alliance dwarf I've been keeping a close eye on. High Marshal Twinbraid proved to be a nuisance in Southern Barrens when he struck back at the Horde after the loss of Bael Modan. He's now entrenched within the Alliance stronghold in Lion's Landing, helping to orchestrate the Krasarang counter-offensive.$b$bOnly a legendary group of Horde heroes could possibly defeat him.$b$bIf you wish to finish him off, bring friends. Lots of friends.
text.completion: <Wrathion grins.>$B$BYou were being tested, $C. I knew you were capable of great things by yourself.$B$BBut you have proven to me that you have the makings of a leader, cobbling together support among a group of strangers in the midst of a battlefield.$B$BThe Horde is fortunate to have you.

text.title: 迫在眉睫
text.objectives: 完成任务“迫在眉睫”。
text.description: 大宗师，我们的斥候发现一艘恶魔的指挥舰出现在地平线上，它的航向似乎与迷踪岛相冲突。$B$B我们应该进行部署，以备迎接最糟糕的情况——一场全力进攻。$B$B与此同时，让我们先派出勇士，试着转移军团战舰的注意力。

english.title: Impending Danger
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "Impending Danger."
english.description: Our scouts have sighted a fel command ship looming on the horizon, Grandmaster. It appears to be headed on a collision course with the Wandering Isle.$B$BWe should prepare our troops for the worst case situation - an all out attack.$B$BIn the meantime, let us send our champions ahead to try and divert the Legion ship's attention.

text.title: Dis-Assembly Required
text.objectives: Destroy the Jungle Shredders using the Re-Configured Remote and then collect 6 pieces of Scrap Metal.
text.description: Those shredders are becoming a problem down there, $c.$b$bWe've sent in the Mecha-Pounders, but it just isn't enough. They're getting damaged faster than we can repair 'em!$b$bI happened upon this strange remote while scouting. With a little bit of re-configurin' I think we can use it.$b$bTry usin' it on the Jungle Shredders. Hopefully it will destroy them and then you can bring me the scrap metal.
text.progress: So what did that remote do?
text.completion: Goblin construction leaves somethin' to be desired, but it'll have to do. Good work, $n!
text.completed: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: Ties with the Past
text.objectives: Recover the Spirit Essence of Varatus.
text.description: While I was in the Vale, I came across an ancient pandaren recipe for Memory Wine. I believe this brew can coax some helpful information out of Shan Kien.$B$BI am needed here, so I have no choice but to ask you to recover the essential ingredient for me. We need the spirit essence of a mogu that lived in the time of the memory we wish to see.$B$BYou should be able to find just such a spirit inside the Path of Conquerors, to the northeast.
text.progress: You never know what you will find in a book. Especially an ancient pandaren one.$B$BI'm eager to see how this Memory Wine works.
text.completion: Ah, very good. This is the last thing we needed.
text.completed: Return to Baine Bloodhoof at the Garrosh'ar Advance.

text.objectives: 去火箭岗哨找贝洛克·辉刃。
text.description: 我们在火箭岗哨的斥候报告说，一个名为敖骨打废墟的地方附近有新情况。$b$b我们需要收集相关情报，看看联盟在那里做什么。更重要的是，我们得知道他们发现了什么。我们不能留下情报的盲区。$b$b快去火箭岗哨找到贝洛克·辉刃，看看他知道些什么。
text.completion: We have a lot of work to do, $C. Who knows what has already been uncovered in Ogudei!

english.title: The Ruins of Ogudei
english.objectives: Report to Belloc Brightblade in Sparkrocket Outpost.
english.description: Our scouts at Sparkrocket Outpost have reported some new activity near an area called the Ruins of Ogudei.$b$bWe need to gather intelligence on what it is the Alliance are doing, and more importantly what it is they found. We cannot afford to have any unknowns.$b$bMeet up with Belloc Brightblade in Sparkrocket Outpost and find out what he knows.
english.completion: We have a lot of work to do, $C. Who knows what has already been uncovered in Ogudei!

text.title: 就是现在！
text.objectives: 去火箭岗哨找匿踪大师琪麟。
text.description: 决一死战的时候到了，$c！$b$b去火箭岗哨找匿踪大师琪麟。她会给你下命令的。$b$b我倒要看看，当部落全力攻击他们那个宝贝堡垒时，他们会如何应对！
text.completion: Now things can get interesting! I have a few plans for Lion's Landing...

english.title: The Time Is Now!
english.objectives: Report to Shademaster Kiryn in Sparkrocket Outpost.
english.description: Now we take the fight to them, $c!$b$bReport to Shademaster Kiryn in Sparkrocket Outpost. She will have your orders.$b$bNow we'll see how they handle the full might of the Horde rushing at their precious keep!
english.completion: Now things can get interesting! I have a few plans for Lion's Landing...

text.title: 捎個訊息
text.objectives: 到喀撒朗蠻荒的天火號找空軍上將羅傑斯。
text.description: 該讓部落的狗雜種見識一下聯盟的力量了!今天我們要直搗他們的家門。$b$b向天火號的上將羅傑斯報告，她會給你進一步的指示。$b$b$c，祝你好運。讓聯盟以你為傲!
text.completion: The battle is already underway, $C. Let's get you out there!

english.title: Send A Message
english.objectives: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: It's time we show these Horde mongrels the full strength of the Alliance! Today we bring the battle to their door.$b$bReport to Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. She will have further instructions.$b$bGood luck out there, $c. Do the Alliance proud!
english.completion: The battle is already underway, $C. Let's get you out there!

text.title: And Then There Were Goblins
text.objectives: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
text.description: We're fighting a war on all fronts, $c. Even Pandaria itself needs our protection.$b$bThe Bilgewater goblins are destroying land that doesn't belong to them. They must be stopped!$b$bReport to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. From her vantage point she should have a good idea of where their weak spots are.
text.completion: It's about time we dealt with this nuisance. Those Bilgewater runts need to be taught a lesson!

text.title: The Thunder King
text.objectives: Contact Wrathion on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
text.description: Are you aware of recent events in Kun-Lai Summit? The Zandalari have landed on the northern shores in great numbers and have set about renewing old alliances. To that end, they have resurrected The Thunder King.$b$bEven among the mogu, the name of the first emperor commands awe and fear. The Thunder King founded a vast empire of slavery and suffering... but also of power, riches, and splendor.$b$bWe will take the fight to him soon. Find me when your faction makes its move.
text.completion: The Sunreavers and the Kirin-Tor are mounting an assault on the Thunder King's base of operations! My new friend here and I were just discussing the ramifications of their attack.$B$BYou and I can stand to benefit from the situation, $n. I have a few ideas...

text.title: Tracking the Thieves
text.objectives: Help Jaina discover who took the Divine Bell, and where they took it. You may speak with Seamus Goldenkicks in Lion's Landing to be ported to Darnassus.
text.description:
We WILL get to the bottom of this.

$n, you're coming with me. We'll search every inch of this city if we have to, but we'll find out how they took the bell... and where.

I'm picking up traces of arcane magic here... we need to follow the trail!
text.completion: I've decided.$B$BCertain members of the Kirin-Tor have put their allegiance to the Horde above the order, and I will NOT tolerate it. This is nothing short of a betrayal.$B$B<Jaina's eyes flare with rage.>$B$BCome with me, $n. We're going to clean up Dalaran.
text.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

english.completion: I've decided.$B$BCertain members of the Kirin-Tor have put their allegiance to the Horde above the order, and I will NOT tolerate it. This is nothing short of a betrayal.$B$B<Jaina's eyes flare with rage.>$B$BCome with me, $n. We're going to clean up Dalaran.
english.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

objectiveDetails.description: Track the Thieves of the Bell

text.title: 云端翔龙骑士团
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的百木园和天荆教头谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，看来你已经光荣地获得了一头威严的云端翔龙。$B$B在你骑上这头强大的生物翱翔天际之前，你必须学会驾驭它的技巧。$B$B云端翔龙骑士团能够教你这种骑术。$B$B如果你希望追寻我们的道路，你应该去翡翠林的百木园和天荆教头谈一谈。$B$B祝你好运，$r。
text.completion: Ah, have you come to join the Order?
text.giverWindow: 只有少数人才能获得骑上云端翔龙的荣誉。

english.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
english.objectives: Speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
english.description: Ahhh, it seems you have found yourself the proud owner of a majestic cloud serpent.$B$BBefore you may fly the skies on this powerful creature, you must first earn the skill to ride it.$B$BThe Order of the Cloud Serpent can teach you the knowledge that you seek.$B$BIf you wish to follow our way, you should speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest.$B$BI wish you luck, $r.
english.completion: Ah, have you come to join the Order?
english.giverWindow: To ride a cloud serpent is a privilege given to few.

text.title: Sacrificial Prevention [PH]
text.objectives: Kill 5 Zandalari Priests.
text.description:
The Zandalari Priests in the town to the north prepare the bodies of our fallen allies for sacrifice.

The best way to prevent this from happening? Kill them. Kill them all.
text.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: Disarming Axe Throwers [PH]
text.objectives: Collect 6 Edged Throwing Axes.
text.description:
The Zandalari Edgetossers to the north are known for becoming fierce Pterodactyl riders and axe throwers. Even now, they train the Pterodactly Hatchlings to become ravenous beasts.

Please, dispatch of some of the Edgetossers and bring back some of their throwing axes so they cannot be used against us.

text.title: Urging on Hatchlings [PH]
text.objectives: Frighten 12 Pterodactyl Hatchlings.
text.description:
The Pterodactyl Hatchlings being trained by Zandalari to the north are not yet the violent and savage beasts they are to become.

I believe we should save these creatures before the trolls corrupt them. If you could just frighten them off, perhaps some of them will be spared an unfortunate fate.

text.title: Plundering Profferings [PH]
text.objectives: Collect 15 Plundered Profferings.
text.description:
While the Zandalari perform live sacrifices, they will not offend their gods by sacrificing a life without also sacrificing offerings of food, treasure, and other items of value.

Recover some of the offerings from cairns in the Troll Town to the north so we might delay their sacrifices further.

text.title: 勇气的试炼
text.objectives: 获取总共3000点勇气点数，达成“勇气的试炼”成就。
text.description: <毫无征兆地，拉希奥朝他的拇指上划了一道口子，并将这根手指贴上了你的额头。他的血液带有烧灼的触感，不过很快就渗入你的皮肤并消失了。>$b$b好了！我的眼睛会跟随你，$c。我在注视着你。$b$b那些熊猫人，和联盟一样崇尚“勇气”。在这片大陆上，你有很多种办法证明你的勇气。你可以去完成日常任务，也可以深入强大敌人的巢穴将他们击败。我会让你自己去选择你的事业。$b$b向我证明你的勇气吧，$n！
text.completion: <Wrathion nods slowly.>$B$BYes, $n. I saw your deeds, and I was most impressed.$B$BYou are truly an instrument of change.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: A Test of Valor
english.objectives: Gain the "A Test of Valor" Achievement by earning a total of 3000 Valor Points.
english.description: <Without warning Wrathion slices his thumb and presses it against your forehead. His blood burns to the touch, but rapidly disappears into your skin.>$b$bThere! My eye is upon you, $c. I am watching.$b$bThe Pandaren, like the Alliance, value the concept of "Valor." There are many ways to prove yourself valorous on this continent, from daily tasks to the defeat of heroic enemies within their lair. I will let you choose your own course.$b$bProve your bravery to me, $n!
english.completion: <Wrathion nods slowly.>$B$BYes, $n. I saw your deeds, and I was most impressed.$B$BYou are truly an instrument of change.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: A Spark of Life
text.objectives: Deliver the Thunder-Laced Egg to Yalia Sagewhisper on the Isle of Thunder.
text.description: The Thunder-Laced Egg burns your hand as you hold it. You recall that Yalia Sagewhisper of the Shado-Pan discussing the history of the Thundering Cloud Serpents, perhaps she will know what to do with it.

text.title: Bolstering the Defenses
text.objectives: Empower 6 Kirin Tor Perimeter Wards around Violet Rise.
text.description: This island is a dangerous place, $n. We have to worry about attacks from the Zandalari, mogu, saurok, and worst of all the Sunreavers.$b$bI had perimeter wards placed on the outskirts of our camp for additional protection. In their current state they will only injure an attacker, but I'm done with warnings!$b$bWith your help we can super-charge the wards into a more deadly defense system.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. Those perimeter wards should keep out all manner of filth.$B$BWith Violet Rise protected we can focus on more pressing matters.
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.title: The Creeping Carpet of Ihgaluk
text.objectives: Crush 75 Ihgaluk Roaches.
text.description: Ah, roaches! I once bought a pet roach in the Undercity.$b$bRoaches will soak up disease like a sponge, and then spread it as far as they can run. Which is pretty far.$b$bIhgaluk Crag is crawling with the things, and they carry Skumblade filth all over of this island. Crush as many of them as you can while you're there.
text.completion: Every little bit helps.
text.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 任其腐烂
text.objectives: 摧毁3堆恶臭肉堆。
text.description: 邪刃蜥蜴人并不会将他们打到的肉全吃光。他们会将大部分的肉堆在房子附近，任由其腐烂，以吸引害虫并散播病毒。$b$b我们不能让蜥蜴人将病毒散播到伊瓜鲁克峭壁以外的地方。快去处理掉那些剩余的肉类吧。
text.completion: Left standing, those piles of discarded food are the perfect breeding ground for disease.$B$BWere I still in the disease-spreading business, I'd consider using them myself.
text.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Left To Rot
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Fetid Meat Piles.
english.description: The Skumblade saurok do not eat all of the meat they hunt. They reserve large portions of it to rot in piles near their homes, attracting pests and spreading disease.$b$bWe can't have the saurok spreading their disease beyond the borders of Ihgaluk Crag. Dispose of any excess meat that you find.
english.completion: Left standing, those piles of discarded food are the perfect breeding ground for disease.$B$BWere I still in the disease-spreading business, I'd consider using them myself.
english.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: They All Fall Down
text.objectives: Kill 5 Spirit-Bound Sentries and then use the Resonance Crystal to capture the Zandalari Spirits trapped within.
text.description: The Zandalari do not tolerate weakness in their ranks, $c.$b$bThose that are deemed weak are often sacrificed in barbaric ceremonies. The victims' spirits are captured and entombed within the sentries you see guarding the grounds.$b$bI wish to study their essence. For this I will need your help.$b$bTake this resonance crystal and siphon the spirits from the sentry corpses.$b$b Do not allow them to escape!
text.completion: Excellent work, $C! This will aid my studies greatly, as well as advance our cause here.
text.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Power Play
text.objectives: Retrieve the Mask of the Dark Mystic and the Mask of the Spirit-Caller from Spiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul within Conqueror's Terrace.
text.description: The Zandalari have found a way to infuse items of great power with the essence of their loa. These items are often passed from one generation to another, each recipient adding to the item's power.$b$bTwo such items exist here. To be specific, two masks, worn by two brothers.$b$bSpiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul must be stopped and their masks destroyed.$b$bKill them and return their masks to me. I will make sure the masks are disposed of.
text.progress: Do you have the masks?
text.completion: Getting these masks was no easy task, $C. I am grateful for your service.
text.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow in the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: The Bloodletter
text.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
text.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BJust beyond our position, in the Court of Bone, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.
text.completion: I am glad to hear that this piece of filth is slain. You have done us all a great favor, $n.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 祭拜这团火焰
text.objectives: 祭拜恐惧废土的仲夏篝火。
text.description: 仲夏火焰节是敬拜元素的时刻。火焰元素会在我们所有人心中点燃激情。在许多时候，这种激情会喷发出来，演变成侵略性的行动。但在这个地方，我们将心中的激情变为虔诚的祭拜。$b$b我们会遵循传统，为火焰举行庆典。你愿意和我们一同敬拜火焰吗，$n？
text.completion: Honor the Dread Wastes flame.
text.end: 祭拜恐惧废土的仲夏篝火。

english.title: Honor the Flame
english.objectives: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Dread Wastes.
english.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?
english.completion: Honor the Dread Wastes flame.
english.end: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Dread Wastes.

english.end: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: Mission: The Secrets of Stormwind
text.description: Send undercover forces into the heart of enemy territory in an effort to learn of their plans.

english.title: Mission: The Secrets of Stormwind
english.description: Send undercover forces into the heart of enemy territory in an effort to learn of their plans.

text.title: 破碎的侍从官
text.objectives: 获得侍从官之肩、侍从官之颅、侍从官之杖、侍从官之发和侍从官之躯。
text.description: 你！过来帮帮我。$b$b在活着的时候，我是雷电之王陛下的侍从官。而我的忠诚，却只换来了这副岩石身躯，不得不永远看守着他的宝藏。$b$b有人亵渎了我神圣的躯体，并将碎片散落到岛上的各个地方。一想到要在没有躯体的情况下永远活下去，我就感到沮丧。$b$b去搜索一下这座岛，将我的身躯碎片带回来，我可以将陛下珍藏的一样宝贝赠送给你。
text.progress: I require ALL of my pieces. If so much as a pebble is missing, I shall consider forfeiting our agreement.
text.completion: Ah! To feel whole again! You have my gratitude, servant. Take this stone and use it wisely. Should you encounter his majesty the Thunder King in your travels, do not tell him where you received it, or you will be standing in a statue next to me for the remainder of eternity.
text.completed: "Speak" with the Statue of the Chamberlain in the the cave beneath the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Crumbled Chamberlain
english.objectives: Recover the Shoulder, Head, Staff, Hair and Torso of the Chamberlain.
english.description: You there! Assist me.$b$bIn life I was the Royal Chamberlain for his majesty, the Thunder King. For my dedication, I was condemned to this stone form, forever forced to watch over a portion of his wealth.$b$bSomeone has desecrated my glorious body and sent pieces of it across the island. The thought of spending an eternity as nothing more than a head depresses me.$b$bSearch the island, recover these pieces and I shall grant you one of his majesty's treasures.
english.progress: I require ALL of my pieces. If so much as a pebble is missing, I shall consider forfeiting our agreement.
english.completion: Ah! To feel whole again! You have my gratitude, servant. Take this stone and use it wisely. Should you encounter his majesty the Thunder King in your travels, do not tell him where you received it, or you will be standing in a statue next to me for the remainder of eternity.
english.completed: "Speak" with the Statue of the Chamberlain in the the cave beneath the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: A Wing to Fly On
text.objectives: Recover a Wild Ptrerrorwing Hatchling.
text.description: I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.$B$BWe need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.
text.progress: A great gloom looms over this island...
text.completion: Wonderful! I'll pass him off to our caretaker. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 蜥蜴人的皮
text.objectives: 前往伊瓜鲁克峭壁并消灭一名邪刃蜥蜴人。
text.description: 伊瓜鲁克峭壁是一个危险的地方。幸运的是，你还有夺日者的魔法支援。$b$b我可以把你变成蜥蜴人。$b$b我会先对你施放一半的幻术。然后，你要直接前往伊瓜鲁克峭壁，消灭其中一名邪刃蜥蜴人。等你到了之后，我会再联系你，并完成后一半的幻术。

english.title: Skin of the Saurok
english.objectives: Go to Ihgaluk Crag and slay a Skumblade saurok.
english.description: Ihgaluk Crag is a dangerous place. Luckily, you have the magic of the Sunreavers behind you.$b$bI can transform you into a saurok.$b$bI will perform the first half of the illusion on you now. Afterwards, you should go directly to Ihgaluk Crag and slay one of the Skumblade saurok. Once you have done this, I will contact you and complete the second half of the illusion.
english.turninWindow: I will transform you to look like a saurok.

text.title: The Bloodletter
text.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
text.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BTo the south, in the Court of Bones, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath at [Horde Hub] at the Isle of the Thunder King.
