text.objectives: Defeat Dippy & Doopy by purchasing their challenge card and challenging them in the Brawler's Guild.
text.description: Brawler's Guild vets will remember Dippy, the penguin. Dippy's not the most accomplished challenger in the Brawler's Guild, but he's no pushover, either!$b$bActually, come to think of it, he IS kind of a pushover...$b$bAnyway! The card you've earned gives you the right to challenge Dippy alongside his older, huger brother, Doopy. text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把尘封的旧机器人交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 机器人显得破损不堪。和布林顿4000一样，在它身上有几个插孔，以前可能镶有宝石，但现在早已不见踪影。$b$b在机器人遍布尘埃的身体后部有一块闪闪发亮的金属小牌，上面印有如下字样：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: What's that you have there, $C?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Last Year's Model
english.objectives: Return the Dusty Old Robot to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The robot is in bad shape. It was built with several sockets which, like the Blingtron 4000, presumably once carried gems, but are now empty.$b$bThe robot's otherwise dust-covered posterior region contains a small, shiny metal plaque, embossed with the words:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: What's that you have there, $C?
english.completion: Oh, so you're $gfound: found it; my treasure. It's perfect.$b$bAs a reward, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare call cards.

text.title: 布林顿3000
text.objectives: 购买布林顿3000的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
text.description: 布林顿系列一直销路不畅，直到4000型系列上市才得以改观。很少有人记得布林顿3000，可它确实凭借自身实力创造了真正的工程学奇迹！$b$b你解锁的这张挑战卡牌使你能够在搏击俱乐部中与布林顿3000对决。$b$b祝你好运！
text.completion: You've got a real knack for beating up robots, $n.
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Blingtron 3000
english.objectives: Defeat Blingtron 3000 by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The Blingtron line didn't really pick up until the 4000 series hit the vendor shelves. Few remember the Blingtron 3000, but it was a real engineering marvel in its own right!$b$bThe challenge card you've unlocked gives you the ability to fight Blingtron 3000 right here, in the Brawler's Guild.$b$bLucky you!
english.completion: У тебя, $n, настоящий талант к уничтожению роботов.
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.progress: What are you carrying, $C? Something of mine?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.description: 你赢得的这张挑战卡牌，使你可以与盲眼英雄对决，他是昔日的神秘战士。没人能超越他对利刃的驾驭力。任何人都做不到。$b$b幸运的是，他什么都看不见。祝你玩得愉快！

english.description: The challenge card you've earned allows you to fight the Blind Hero, a mysterious warrior from a bygone age. Nobody surpasses his skill with a blade. Nobody.$b$bLuckily, he can't see anything. Have fun!

text.title: 被布包住的石头
text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把被布包住的石头交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 这两样东西真是奇怪的组合。布把石块完全包住，如同把木浆裹在毯子里点燃，多此一举。与布相比，石头则只是一块普通的鹅卵石。$b$b当你对着光看时，布上现出了清晰的水印，有这样一行字：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: Good day, $R. Have you brought something for me?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Paper-Covered Rock
english.objectives: Return the Paper-Covered Rock to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: It's a strange combination of items. The paper envelops the rock completely, dwarfing it like a smothering blanket of wood pulp. text.title: 我们受训的目的
text.objectives: 通过搜寻战斗的功能，率领一支由25级宠物组成的战队击败10名玩家。
text.description: 你准备好让自己的宠物经受考验了吗？战斗宠物竞技场可不欢迎低等级的菜鸟，你最好拿出点真本事来，做好打硬仗的准备。如果你有三只训练有素的宠物，那就找有相似技能的训练师较量一下，向这个世界证明你的实力吧！你可以在宠物手册中查阅说明事项。
text.completion: I've heard stories about some of your matches circulating around, apparently they were quite a sight to behold! I think you've earned this reward. Congratulations, trainer, and keep up the good work.
text.completed: Return to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, Orgrimmar, or Stormwind.

english.description: Are you ready to put your pets to the test? The battle pet arena is no place for low-level rabbits, you'd better have a rocketbot in your pocket and be ready for action. If you've got three fully-experienced pets, find battles against trainers of similar skill and show the world what you've got. You can find the instructions in your Pet Journal.

text.description: Events are in motion, $n. We have one final task to complete before we are ready to move into the final act of my plan.$b$bMy agents tell me that King Wrynn has reassembled a naval fleet after his losses at Theramore, and Vol'jin is marching north across Durotar in open rebellion against the warchief.$b$bSpeak with me again as soon as they are ready to converge on the gates. text.objectives: 完成英雄难度的任意场景战役。
text.description: 我简直要无聊到发疯了——我一步都没离开过这地方！$b$b你看起来像是个见过点世面的冒险者。要是你能给我带来一个真正的英雄故事，我这肯定有你感兴趣的好东西。
text.completion: Congratulations, $n, you did it! Before I forget, here's the special surprise I promised -- I hope you like it.$B$BNow tell me all about the adventure. Did you face certain death? Meet any friends? I wish I had more friends like you.
text.completed: Return to Taijing the Cyclone in the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 产品订单：肯瑞托远征军I
text.objectives: 在日歌农场播种8颗爽脆胡萝卜种子。
text.description: <老愚简单扼要地记下了这份订单的细节。>$b$b联盟又送来了一份需求单。位于雷神岛的肯瑞托远征军需要一批爽脆胡萝卜。$b$b尽管部落和联盟的战争仍然让我感到如芒在背，但我不会让客户饿肚子的。

english.title: Work Order: Kirin Tor Offensive I
english.objectives: Plant 8 Juicycrunch Carrot Seeds on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: <Yoon keeps the details of this order short, but detailed.>$b$bAnother request has come through for the Alliance. The Kirin Tor Offensive, located out on the Isle of Thunder, has requested a bushel of juicycrunch carrots.$b$bThough this Horde and Alliance conflict still gets my fur in a bristle, I won't turn away a hungry stomach.

text.title: 产品订单：肯瑞托远征军II
text.objectives: 收获8个成熟的爽脆胡萝卜，并向肯瑞托远征军提供40份爽脆胡萝卜。
text.description: 等你的爽脆胡萝卜长到可以采摘时，你只要将它们打包，等待提取就好了。$b$b想想看，你种的爽脆胡萝卜能让多少在前线打仗的士兵免遭饥饿！
text.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
text.completion: Throw the juicycrunch carrots into the crate! A Kirin Tor Offensive representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
text.completed: Package the Juicycrunch Carrots in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

english.title: Work Order: Kirin Tor Offensive II
english.objectives: Harvest 8 Ripe Juicycrunch Carrot plants and provide 40 Juicycrunch Carrots for the Kirin Tor Offensive.
english.description: Once your juicycrunch carrots are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.$b$bJust think; your juicycrunch carrots will feed so many hungry soldiers on the front lines!
english.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
english.completion: Throw the juicycrunch carrots into the crate! A Kirin Tor Offensive representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
english.completed: Package the Juicycrunch Carrots in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

text.title: 罗洛之谜
text.objectives: 解开谜题。
text.description:
<牛皮纸显得非常古老，因年久而沾满污渍，上面有这样几行字：>$B$B永恒岛上四兄弟
膀大腰圆空蛮力
个中一位最矮者
踪迹引我去寻觅。
text.completion: <The dirt here looks overturned. Perhaps something is buried beneath.>
text.completed: Find the clue on Timeless Isle.

english.title: Rolo's Riddle
english.objectives: Solve the riddle.
english.description:
<The leather vellum is very old. Stained by age, it bears the following letters:>$B$BOn the isle of time are tall men four
Round and strong and nothing more
Of these brothers the shortest be
Where the trail leads to me.
english.completion: <The dirt here looks overturned. Perhaps something is buried beneath.>
english.completed: Find the clue on Timeless Isle.

text.title: 罗洛之谜
text.objectives: 解开谜题。
text.description:
<在土壤下面还埋着另一片脏兮兮的羊皮纸。>$B$B希望屹立处，神鹤敛双翼，
北行穿古门，双石身后觅。
text.completion: <Another pile of dirt! Could there be something buried here?>
text.completed: Find the clue on Timeless Isle.

english.title: Rolo's Riddle
english.objectives: Solve the riddle.
english.description:
<Another dirty scrap of parchment is buried beneath the soil.>$B$BSomewhere hope stands, wings held forth
From its feet turn to the north
Pass beyond an ancient gate
Behind a stone pair, I await.
english.completion: <Another pile of dirt! Could there be something buried here?>
english.completed: Find the clue on Timeless Isle.

text.title: 罗洛之谜
text.objectives: 解开谜题。
text.description:
财宝近在即，水帘高处踞，
接天林荫下，插翅方可遇。
text.completion: <The ancient chest has not been disturbed for a long time.>
text.completed: Find the treasure on Timeless Isle.

english.title: Rolo's Riddle
english.objectives: Solve the riddle.
english.description:
The final step, my treasure calls
Above the place where water falls
Beneath the shade on vantage high
No path to walk but air and sky.
english.completion: <The ancient chest has not been disturbed for a long time.>
english.completed: Find the treasure on Timeless Isle.

text.title: 要塞战役：先知岩
text.objectives: 到霜火岭的先知岩找到德拉卡和德雷克塔尔。
text.description: 德拉卡和德雷克塔尔正在前往先知岩。那是个神圣的地方，可是并不安全。可德拉卡坚称德雷克塔尔必须重建他与元素的联结。$b$b我能感觉到这片土地上的鬼魂变得焦躁不安。将要有事发生，这两个人肯定会需要帮助。$b$b拜托你了，$p，快去找他们，尽你所能提供帮助吧。他们的安全对我来说至关重要。
text.completion: You again? Not eaten by ogres or killed by Thunderlords yet? Ha!
text.completed: Speak with Draka at Farseer's Rock in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Farseer's Rock
english.objectives: Find Draka and Drek'Thar at Farseer's Rock in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: Draka and Drek'Thar are travelling to Farseer's Rock. It is a sacred place, not a safe one. But Draka insists that Drek'Thar must rebuild his connection to the elements.$b$bI can feel the spirits of this land are becoming restless. Something is about to happen, and I suspect these two will need all the help they can get.$b$bPlease, $p, go to them and lend what aid you can. I care for these two a great deal.
english.completion: Опять ты? Ну надо же, и все-то тебе нипочем – и Громоборцы, и огры. Ха!
english.completed: Speak with Draka at Farseer's Rock in Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到德拉卡和德雷克塔尔

text.title: 元素吞噬者
text.objectives: 在德雷克塔尔举行仪式时保护他。
text.description: 德雷克塔尔已经开始仪式了，仪式的力量非常强大，足以引起当地鬣蜥人的注意力。这些野兽对于元素魔法，就像苍蝇见了尸体一样饥渴。$b$b我很快就要忙不过来了。如果你愿意的话可以帮帮我们，但一定要确保德雷克塔尔完成他的仪式。
text.completion: I came seeking aid from the elements. I see now that we are the ones who must aid them.$B$BCome, $n, witness what I have witnessed.
text.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at Farseer's Rock in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Eaters of the Elements
english.objectives: Defend Drek'Thar as he performs his ritual.
english.description: Drek'Thar has already begun his ritual, and it is powerful enough to draw the attention of the local goren. Those beasts are drawn to elemental magic like flies to a corpse.$b$bI will have my hands full soon enough. Help us if you like but Drek'Thar must be allowed to finish his ritual.
english.completion: Мы пришли, чтобы просить помощи у стихий. Теперь я понимаю, что это мы должны помочь им.$b$bИдем, $p. Хочу, чтобы ты $gувидел:увидела; то же, что и я.
english.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at Farseer's Rock in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 胜者为王
text.objectives: 收集天空咏者斯塔格的图腾。
text.description: 我是戈隆追猎者洛卡什，我只为胜者效力。$b$b我对你的事迹有所耳闻，指挥官，也见识到了你和你的大军所到之处尸横遍野的场面。$b$b我已经对现在的氏族深感厌倦了。族人们软弱无能，很快就将一败涂地。$b$b我为你准备了这个挑战：进入北边的巨灵之殁，消灭天空咏者斯塔格。把她的图腾作为战利品交给我，我就会把你奉为新酋长。
text.progress: Strag always was a coward. She would hide behind her magic and position as a speaker for the dead.
text.completion: Strag was the puppet of the Iron Wolf. She would do nothing unless ordered to by him.$b$bThis made us weak, changing us from a force to be feared to a target.$b$bIf this is what the Thunderlord have become then I will have no part of them.
text.completed: Return to Gronnstalker Rokash to the south of Colossal's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.
text.giverWindow: 她代表铁狼挥斥方遒。

english.title: Only the Winner
english.objectives: Collect Sky-Singer Strag's Totem.
english.description: I am Gronnstalker Rokash, and I only serve the winning side.$b$bI have heard of some of your deeds, commander, and seen the corpses left in the wake of you and your forces.$b$bI have grown tired of my current clan. They are soft, weak, and losing.$b$bI offer you this challenge: enter Colossal's Fall to the north and slay Sky-Singer Strag. Claim her totem as a trophy and I will hail you as my new chieftain.
english.progress: Strag always was a coward. She would hide behind her magic and position as a speaker for the dead.
english.completion: Strag was the puppet of the Iron Wolf. She would do nothing unless ordered to by him.$b$bThis made us weak, changing us from a force to be feared to a target.$b$bIf this is what the Thunderlord have become then I will have no part of them.
english.completed: Return to Gronnstalker Rokash to the south of Colossal's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.
english.giverWindow: She commands on behalf of the Iron Wolf.

text.title: Scavengers of Flame
text.objectives: Rescue the Child of Fury at the Forge Gates.
text.description: I sense another child of the fury being consumed by the vile goren in a nearby nest.$b$bSearch the caves east of here for any signs of a goren nest. I suspect there will be quite alot of steam given the cold.$b$bI will try to locate the next child of the fury in your absence.
text.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Ice Forge in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Scavengers of Flame
english.objectives: Rescue the Child of Fury at the Forge Gates.
english.description: I sense another child of the fury being consumed by the vile goren in a nearby nest.$b$bSearch the caves east of here for any signs of a goren nest. I suspect there will be quite alot of steam given the cold.$b$bI will try to locate the next child of the fury in your absence.
english.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Ice Forge in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 在巨人的阴影下
text.objectives: 救出弗莱姆洛格和金德勒。
text.description: 鬣蜥人与玛戈隆正在摧残那些元素之灵，并像熔炼钢铁一样熔炼它们的精华。$b$b指挥官，拿上我的图腾，向东前往玛戈纳洛克。拜托了，快去找到并释放它们。$b$b德拉卡和我会前往霜火高地。你成功后就到那里与我们会合。
text.completion: You have done well, $C.$B$BWe will need the aid of these children when the time comes to rescue Exurotus.
text.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Ascent of Frostfire in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: In the Shadow of Giants
english.objectives: Rescue Flamrog and Kindler.
english.description: The goren and the magnaron are ravaging the element spirits and smelting their essence as one would smelt steel.$b$bCommander, take my totem, travel east to Magnarok. Please, find them, and free them.$b$bDraka and I will make our way to the Ascent of Frostfire. Meet us there if you are successful.
english.completion: Отлично, |3-6($c).$b$bКогда придет время спасать Экзурота, помощь детей нам пригодится.
english.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Ascent of Frostfire in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 高地
text.objectives: 将德雷克塔尔带到霜火之魂艾索洛托斯身边。
text.description: 我能听见有霜火之怒的声音从高地顶端传来。来吧，我们一起爬上这阶梯。$b$b千万要多加小心。这里的鬣蜥人很可能会被萨满祭司的气味吸引过来。$b$b要是我们走散了，回到阶梯底部重新集结。
text.completion: This is ancient magic, from a time before the orcs. It will not be easy to undo.
text.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Altar of Kron in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: The Ascent
english.objectives: Bring Drek'Thar to Exurotus, the Spirit of Frostfire.
english.description: I can feel the voice of the Fury at the top of the ascent. Come, let us climb these stairs together.$b$bBe on your guard. The goren of this area are likely to be drawn by the smell of a shaman.$b$bIf we get separated, fall back to the base of the stairs and regroup.
english.completion: Это древняя магия, она была здесь еще до пришествия орков. С ней нелегко будет справиться.
english.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Altar of Kron in Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 将德雷克塔尔带到原初之砧

text.title: 霜火之怒
text.objectives: 击败克鲁恩。
text.description: 当我开始举行释放艾索洛托斯的仪式时，肯定会把克鲁恩给引过来。$b$b通常情况下，要有一整支精悍的大军才有可能击败一个玛戈隆。这里只有我们三个人。$b$b在战场上寻找我的火焰图腾。我会尽量取得艾索洛托斯之赐。走到图腾附近，与霜火之怒融为一体吧。$b$b在艾索洛托斯之赐的帮助下杀死克鲁恩！Lok'tar ogar！
text.completion: With Kron defeated I can finish breaching the magic that holds Exurotus, but I may be too late. So much of the fury has already been expended and drained by the magnaron and goren.$B$BI fear we may have only bought this spirit a peaceful death.
text.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Altar of Kron.
text.giverWindow: 灭焰者

english.title: Fury of Frostfire
english.objectives: Defeat Kron.
english.description: The moment I begin the ritual to free Exurotus you can expect Kron to be drawn to us. $b$bIt would normally take an army of seasoned warriors to defeat a magnaron. We have only the three of us.$b$bLook for my fire totem upon the battlefield. I will try to gain what boons I can from Exurotus. Step near the totems and become one with the Fury.$b$bWith these boons, slay Kron! Lok'tar ogar!
english.completion: Крон повержен, и я наконец-то могу пробиться сквозь магию, которая сдерживает Экзурота. Но, возможно, что уже слишком поздно. Магнароны и горены вытянули из него слишком много силы.$b$BБоюсь, сейчас мы можем лишь дать этому духу спокойно умереть.
english.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Altar of Kron.
english.giverWindow: The Flame Breaker

text.title: 南部保卫战
text.objectives: 在岩牙岗哨与洛卡拉交谈。
text.description: 我们在东南边有个哨站，遭到了沿峡谷前往沃高尔的雷神军队的围困。$B$B我已经派援军去守卫哨站了，并向东推进到格罗姆加尔。我们要彻底将雷神氏族逐出我们的土地，把他们一路赶回那个散发着臭气的被他们称作家的地方。$B$B德拉卡的姐妹洛卡拉就在自告奋勇清理岩牙岗哨的兽人中间。
text.completion: $p! They told me you'd be heading this way. You are late to the party! We are just cleaning up now.
text.completed: 在岩牙岗哨与洛卡拉交谈。

english.title: Securing the South
english.objectives: Speak with Lokra at Stonefang Outpost.
english.description: We have an outpost to the southeast that was boxed in by Thunderlord forces as they marched through the canyons to Wor'gol.$B$BI have sent reinforcements to secure the outpost and press east to Grom'gar. We will push the Thunderlords out of our lands completely, and pursue them all the way back to that reeking corpse they call home.$B$BDraka's sister, Lokra, was among the orcs who volunteered to clean up Stonefang Outpost.
english.completion: $p! They told me you'd be heading this way. You are late to the party! We are just cleaning up now.
english.completed: Speak with Lokra at Stonefang Outpost.

text.title: 坚持到底
text.objectives: 在岩牙岗哨里与卡格·血怒谈一谈。
text.description: 包围圈被攻破了——他们小瞧了岩牙岗哨的韧性，我们如潮水般的刀塔援军也把他们打得措手不及。$B$B等我们清理完这里后，我们就会召集所有还能战斗的人，准备向格罗姆加尔进发。$B$B哨站队长卡格·血怒现在应该出来找我们了。你能把他带来吗？$B$B告诉他洛卡拉在等着他呢。他知道我多讨厌等人。
text.completion: You're back! But where is Karg?
text.completed: Return to Lokra outside of Stonefang Outpost.

english.title: They Who Held Fast
english.objectives: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Stonefang Outpost.
english.description: The siege has been broken - they underestimated the resilience of Stonefang, and our reinforcement wave from Bladespire caught them completely off-guard.$B$BOnce we finish cleaning up here, we rally anyone who can still fight and prepare to march for Grom'gar.$B$BThe outpost captain, Karg Bloodfury, should have come out to meet us by now. Can you get him out here?$B$BTell him Lokra is waiting. He knows how much I hate to be kept waiting.
english.completion: You're back! But where is Karg?
english.completed: Return to Lokra outside of Stonefang Outpost.

text.title: 深入骨渣锻炉
text.objectives: 在骨渣锻炉里寻找失踪的霜狼兽人。
text.description: 雷神氏族把囚犯带进了骨渣锻炉？$B$B那我们还在等什么？！我们得赶紧去追他们！$B$B你去找失踪的村民们——我和阿莎去找卡格。
text.completion: Thank you for finding the others. Karg and his captor are one step ahead of us, but they're limping.
text.completed: Speak with Lokra in the Boneslag.

english.title: Into the Boneslag
english.objectives: Search the Boneslag for the missing Frostwolf orcs.
english.description: The Thunderlords took prisoners into the Boneslag?$B$BWell what are we waiting for?! We have to go after them!$B$BYou look for the missing villagers - Asha and I will track Karg.
english.completion: Thank you for finding the others. Karg and his captor are one step ahead of us, but they're limping.
english.completed: Speak with Lokra in the Boneslag.

text.title: 移动靶子
text.objectives: 在冰风雪原赶上洛卡拉。
text.description: 抓卡格的人往东走了——可能夹着尾巴逃回了格罗姆加尔！$B$B他们以为自己能甩掉我，可我身边的阿莎却是四条腿的生物里跑得最快的。我们一定能在冰风雪原追上他们。
text.completion: <Lokra's gaze remains fixed on her dying frost wolf.>$B$BWe had them... We had them, Asha. You were so fast. So beautiful.$B$BI failed you, Asha. I am sorry.
text.completed: Find Lokra in the Icewind Drifts.

english.title: Moving Target
english.objectives: Catch up with Lokra in the Icewind Drifts.
english.description: Karg's captors are moving east - probably retreating to Grom'gar with their tails between their legs!$B$BThey think they outrun me, but Asha here is the fastest thing on four legs. We'll run them down in the Icewind Drifts.
english.completion: <Lokra's gaze remains fixed on her dying frost wolf.>$B$BWe had them... We had them, Asha. You were so fast. So beautiful.$B$BI failed you, Asha. I am sorry.
english.completed: Find Lokra in the Icewind Drifts.

objectiveDetails.description: 在冰风雪原找到洛卡拉

text.title: 生死相随
text.objectives: 在格罗姆加尔里找到卡格·血怒。
text.description: 阿莎死了，但死亡斩断不了我们之间的联结。即便是现在，她的灵魂还在催我继续前往格罗姆加尔。$B$B铁狼说感情会使我们变得软弱……爱会成为我们的弱点。$B$B他是错的。$B$B卡格就是我的力量，我对他而言也是一样。我一定会帮他挣脱锁链，携手让雷神氏族看看我们生死相随的力量。
text.completion: Help me out of these chains. We have work to do.
text.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

english.title: The Strength of Our Bonds
english.objectives: Find Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.
english.description: Asha has passed, but we share a bond that cannot be severed by death. Even now, her spirit urges me onward to Grom'gar.$B$BThe Iron Wolf claims our attachments make us weak... that love makes us vulnerable.$B$BHe is wrong.$B$BKarg is my strength, and I his. I will free him from his chains, and together we will show the Thunderlord clan the strength of our bonds.
english.completion: Help me out of these chains. We have work to do.
english.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

text.title: 纵射
text.objectives: 用黑石爆破炸药摧毁格罗姆加尔的5架钢铁部落火炮。
text.description: 如果我们现在离开，我的氏族对格罗姆加尔的最后突袭就会变成一场灾难。$B$B尽管我们战士的近战身手全都无可匹敌，但雷神氏族却准备了新型的远程武器——我们的军队如果硬闯冰风雪原的话肯定会遭到屠杀。$B$B可既然我们已经来了，那就赶在这些武器还没来得及开火前把它们摧毁。$B$B黑石兽人正在南边的工作间里帮助我们的敌人锻造这些“火炮”。要是我们能用他们自己的工具去破坏这些武器，格罗姆加尔就会对突袭的霜狼大军敞开大门了。
text.completion: See how their machines fail them! There is no better weapon than pure orc muscle!
text.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

english.title: Enfilade
english.objectives: Use Blackrock Blasting Powder to destroy 5 Iron Horde Cannons in Grom'gar.
english.description: If we leave now, my clan's final assault on Grom'gar will be a disaster.$B$BThough our warriors are unmatched in melee, the Thunderlords have new ranged weapons - our forces would be decimated as they cross the Icewind Drifts.$B$BBut WE are already here. We can overtake those weapons before they ever fire.$B$BBlackrock orcs help our enemies forge these "cannons" in the workshops on the south side. If we use their own tools to sabotage the weapons, we leave Grom'gar wide open to a Frostwolf raid.
english.completion: See how their machines fail them! There is no better weapon than pure orc muscle!
english.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

text.title: Into the Vale
text.objectives: Speak to Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.$B$BI wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.$B$BBut let us not speak of that now. Go visit Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons.$B$BShe should be able to settle you in.

english.title: Into the Vale
english.objectives: Speak to Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.$B$BI wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.$B$BBut let us not speak of that now. Go visit Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons.$B$BShe should be able to settle you in.

text.title: 铁狼
text.objectives: 进入格罗姆加尔的猎手大厅并击败铁狼。
text.description: 我的兄弟贾纳尔与我并肩作战。$B$B沃高尔、岩牙岗哨和你的要塞坚不可摧。$B$B我们的氏族空前团结，雷神氏族也已经落荒而逃。万事都已俱备。是时候面对这所谓的“铁狼”了。
text.completion: Thank you for protecting my family, $p.
text.completed: Speak with Thrall in the Hunter's Hall in Grom'gar.
text.giverWindow: 雷神氏族督军

english.title: The Iron Wolf
english.objectives: Enter the Hunter's Hall in Grom'gar and defeat the Iron Wolf.
english.description: My brother Ga'nar stands beside me.$B$BWor'gol, Stonefang, and your garrison hold strong.$B$BOur clan is united, and the Thunderlord are already on the run. We are ready. The time has come to face this "Iron Wolf."
english.completion: Thank you for protecting my family, $p.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall in the Hunter's Hall in Grom'gar.
english.giverWindow: Warlord of the Thunderlord Clan

text.title: Task: Stonefang Outpost Fires
text.objectives: Pick up snowballs from Snow Mounds and throw them at burning structures in Stonefang Outpost.

english.title: Task: Stonefang Outpost Fires
english.objectives: Pick up snowballs from Snow Mounds and throw them at burning structures in Stonefang Outpost.

text.title: 烈焰与雷霆
text.objectives: 在骨渣锻炉里检查攻城军需品和厚钢板。
text.description: 铁狼……带来了武器……$B$B<咳嗽>$B$B……烈焰与雷霆的武器。$B$B我们的战士们从没见过这样的武器。我们没有做好准备。$B$B<喘息>我们必须学会……战胜……
text.completion: <Thunderlord apprentices toil under the watchful eye of Blackrock orcs.$B$BUsing lava pools as natural forges, they craft components for a type of weapon never before seen by the Frostwolves: cannons.>

english.title: Of Fire and Thunder
english.objectives: Examine the Siege Munitions and Heavy Plating in The Boneslag.
english.description: The Iron Wolf... brought weapons...$B$B<cough>$B$B...weapons of fire and thunder.$B$BOur warriors have never seen such weapons. We were not ready.$B$B<wheeze> We must learn... to overcome...
english.completion: <Thunderlord apprentices toil under the watchful eye of Blackrock orcs.$B$BUsing lava pools as natural forges, they craft components for a type of weapon never before seen by the Frostwolves: cannons.>

text.objectives: Slay 6 Thunderlord Giantslayers or Thunderlord Gronnstalkers around Kron'mar.

english.title: Thunderlord War-Gronn
english.objectives: Slay 6 Thunderlord Giantslayers or Thunderlord Gronnstalkers around Kron'mar.

text.title: 失传已久的汤面秘诀
text.objectives: 在永恒岛的老酒湾里寻找古老铭牌的主人。
text.description: 你在碎石中找到了一块古老的铭牌碎片。你拭去上面的尘埃，勉强辨认出了几个因风化而变得模糊难识的熊猫人文字，分别是“汤面”和“林”。$B$B抬眼望去，有座小桥被埋在你身边的乱石堆里，这块铭牌应该是从当年位于桥上的某个设施上掉下来的。在桥上摆摊开设小吃店，听起来像是临时生意，所以店主可能就住在附近。$B$B也许能在岛上的村子里找到线索？
text.completion: Well, hello there. I am Lin Chao-Wei.$B$BHave you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup?

english.title: Noodle Secrets Long Forgotten
english.objectives: Search the village, Old Pi'jiu, on the Timeless Isle, for the owner of the old sign fragment.
english.description: Searching amidst the rubble, you find the fragment of an old sign. Wiping away the dust, you can make out the well-weathered pandaren characters for "Noodles" and "Lin."$B$BLooking above, you suspect that the establishment this sign belonged to was situated on the bridge, which now lies in rubble about you. An eatery placed on a bridge sounds very temporary, so its owner would likely live nearby.$B$BPerhaps there is a clue to be found in the village here on the island?
english.completion: Well, hello there. I am Lin Chao-Wei.$B$BHave you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup?

text.title: NC S1 Q2
text.description: Well hello there. I am Lin, Chao-Wei. Have you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup? I'm afraid you're all out of luck. My father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient to his secret ingredient noodle soup. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that went to the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Perhaps you can find it there?

english.title: NC S1 Q2
english.description: Well hello there. I am Lin, Chao-Wei. Have you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup? I'm afraid you're all out of luck. My father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient to his secret ingredient noodle soup. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that went to the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Perhaps you can find it there?

text.title: 秘密配方流失之谜
text.objectives: 击败疑之煞。
text.description: 如果你来这里是为了品尝我们家族最出名的汤面，那你恐怕得败兴而归了。$B$B我父亲还没来得及把他的秘密配方传授给我就过世了。不过我倒是听他说起过，他把配方写下来交给了一位在青龙寺学习的朋友。$B$B也许你可以去那找找？
text.completion: You recognize the name, Lin, on the scroll. A few characters down you see the character for "Recipe."$B$BThis must be it!$B$BYour only worry is that the sha energies that manifested themselves in the tales of the pandaren may have corrupted the scroll as well.$B$BThere is only one way to find out....
text.completed: Search for the Lin Famiy Scroll in the Temple of the Jade Serpent's Heart of Jade.

english.title: The Lost Secret of the Secret Ingredient
english.objectives: Defeat the Sha of Doubt.
english.description: If you've come here to try my family's famous noodle soup, I'm afraid you're out of luck.$B$BMy father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that studied at the Temple of the Jade Serpent.$B$BPerhaps you can find it there?
english.completion: You recognize the name, Lin, on the scroll. A few characters down you see the character for "Recipe."$B$BThis must be it!$B$BYour only worry is that the sha energies that manifested themselves in the tales of the pandaren may have corrupted the scroll as well.$B$BThere is only one way to find out....
english.completed: Search for the Lin Famiy Scroll in the Temple of the Jade Serpent's Heart of Jade.

text.title: 就此失传？
text.objectives: 在四风谷的半山市集与孙行·铁掌谈一谈。
text.description: <既然已经拿到了林家古老的汤面配方，你决定出发前往半山市集。>$B$B<如果说在潘达利亚有人知道如何破译这个卷轴的话，那一定非孙行·铁掌莫属。>
text.completion: Hello, $n. What is it you have there?

english.title: Secrets Lost, Forever?
english.objectives: Speak with Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: <With the ancient Lin family noodle soup recipe in hand, you decide to set out for the Halfhill Market.>$B$B<If anyone in Pandaria knows how to decipher this scroll, it's Sungshin Ironpaw.>
english.completion: Hello, $n. What is it you have there?

text.title: 接与运
text.objectives: 在帝皇粮仓使用粮食袋接住20袋被谷仓破坏者扔下来的谷物。$B$B如果你骑上坐骑或受到伤害，你手中的谷物都会洒落在地。
text.description: 天哪！爷爷曾经给我讲过大名鼎鼎的林家汤面馆的故事。$B$B据说这个卷轴已经被扭曲了，但我想我们一定能合力解开这谜题！$B$B首先，我们需要用到大量谷物来制作面条。$B$B前往粮仓，用这个袋子接住一些谷物。等你接好以后，把它丢到我停放在粮仓的货车上。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n! With all this grain I think we're ready to start.$B$BFor now I think you should try making noodle soup. Try using this recipe I've written down for you. It'll make for excellent practice.
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Catch and Carry
english.objectives: Use the Grain Catching Sack to catch 20 Sacks of Grain being thrown down by the Granary Vandals at the Imperial Granary.$B$BYou will drop all your carried grain if you mount or get hurt.
english.description: Oh my! Grandpa used to tell me stories of the famous Lin family noodle shop.$B$BIt is sad that the scroll has been warped, but I think we can work together to solve the riddle!$B$BTo start, we're going to need lots of grain to make noodles.$B$BHead down to the granary and catch some grain with this sack. After you've caught some, drop it off at the wagon I've placed at the granary.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n! With all this grain I think we're ready to start.$B$BFor now I think you should try making noodle soup. Try using this recipe I've written down for you. It'll make for excellent practice.
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 那是真正的计量单位吗？
text.objectives: 制造汤面餐车并在风暴烈酒酿造厂里从被杀死的酒灵身上收集20捧酒。
text.description: 干得好，$n。看来你已经准备好继续探索林家秘制汤面的秘密了。$B$B据我所知，林总是用风暴烈酒来制作汤底。$B$B我想你接下来应该制造属于你自己的汤面餐车，然后前往风暴烈酒酿造厂收集几捧酒回来。
text.progress: I'm glad it's you and not me. I'm not much of a drinker, myself.
text.completion: Well done, $n. With this we can make a truly unique soup broth.$B$BI've managed to get some updated schematics for your noodle cart. With this broth, you're definitely going to want to upgrade your operation.$B$BNext up: finding the secret ingredient of the Lin secret ingredient noodle soup!
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Is That A Real Measurement?
english.objectives: Create a Noodle Cart Kit and collect 20 Sloshes of Brew from slain alementals in the Stormstout Brewery.
english.description: Well done, $n. I can see you're ready to continue exploring the mysteries of Lin's secret ingredient soup.$B$BFrom what I can tell, Lin used Stormstout brew for his soup broth.$B$BI think the next steps for you are to create a Noodle Cart of your own and to head to the Stormstout Brewery to collect some sloshes of brew.
english.progress: I'm glad it's you and not me. I'm not much of a drinker, myself.
english.completion: Well done, $n. With this we can make a truly unique soup broth.$B$BI've managed to get some updated schematics for your noodle cart. With this broth, you're definitely going to want to upgrade your operation.$B$BNext up: finding the secret ingredient of the Lin secret ingredient noodle soup!
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 这些可不是肥美的山羊肉排
text.objectives: 制造什锦汤面餐车并收集50块肥美的龟肉排。
text.description: 我真是太激动了，$n。我们几乎已经掌握汤面的所有成分了！$B$B我们这儿有许许多多的蔬菜和调料，但当年在林家手里还有某些外来肉品，已经在潘达利亚消失一段时间了。我们需要一些优质肥美的鲜肉。$B$B爷爷曾经告诉过我，在永恒岛的海岸边生活着古老的海龟。寿命那么长的动物，骨头上一定会长着些肥美的肉吧。$B$B制造什锦汤面餐车，再收集一些肥美的龟肉排，然后我们再继续。
text.progress: I can just taste the soup now!
text.completion: Ooh, these will do nicely, $n.$B$BNow for the final step: the Lin secret ingredient soup's secret ingredient.$B$BThat's a mouthful!
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: These Aren't Your Fatty Goatsteaks
english.objectives: Create a Deluxe Noodle Cart Kit and collect 50 Fatty Turtle Steaks.
english.description: I'm so excited, $n. We've nearly mastered all the ingredients for noodle soup!$B$BWe have plenty of vegetables and spices here, but the Lin family had access to exotic meats not seen in Pandaria for some time. We need some nice, fatty meats.$B$BGrandpa used to tell me of ancient turtles living off the shores of the Timeless Isle. Something that lives that long has to have some nice fatty meat on its bones.$B$BCreate a deluxe noodle cart and gather some fatty turtle steaks and we'll continue.
english.progress: I can just taste the soup now!
english.completion: Ooh, these will do nicely, $n.$B$BNow for the final step: the Lin secret ingredient soup's secret ingredient.$B$BThat's a mouthful!
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 秘密配方就是……
text.objectives: 排队并完成寻找秘密配方场景战役。
text.description: 要想做好这个，最好的办法就是亲自动手实验。$B$B我已经安排潘达利亚各处的商人、学者和农民前来试吃你的汤面。要是你能为他们每个人奉上对他们胃口的汤面，那我们一定能取得最好的结果！$B$B是时候找到秘密配方了！
text.completion: Well done, $n. All those people came by to taste your noodle soup and YOU made them so happy!$B$BDon't you see? The secret ingredient is in you!$B$BNow go out there and make the world happy with this latest noodle cart!
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: The Secret Ingredient Is...
english.objectives: Queue for and complete the Finding the Secret Ingredient scenario.
english.description: The best way to go about doing this is through hands-on experience.$B$BI've arranged for merchants, scholars, and farmers from all over Pandaria to come for a taste test of your soups. We'll get the best results if you can match them to the soups they prefer.$B$BIt's time to find the secret ingredient!
english.completion: Well done, $n. All those people came by to taste your noodle soup and YOU made them so happy!$B$BDon't you see? The secret ingredient is in you!$B$BNow go out there and make the world happy with this latest noodle cart!
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

objectiveDetails.description: 到孙行·铁掌处排队进行首次面档上工

text.title: To Karabor!
text.objectives: Speak with Chronalis, then fly into Karabor.
text.description: Draenor will not be a friendly place for someone like you. There are far too many orcs here, and I know your kind has a history with the orcs.$b$bNo, if you're looking for a friendly face here on Draenor, you'll need to find the draenei.$b$bHop on my back. I will take you to the draenei temple of Karabor.

english.title: To Karabor!
english.objectives: Speak with Chronalis, then fly into Karabor.
english.description: Draenor will not be a friendly place for someone like you. There are far too many orcs here, and I know your kind has a history with the orcs.$b$bNo, if you're looking for a friendly face here on Draenor, you'll need to find the draenei.$b$bHop on my back. I will take you to the draenei temple of Karabor.

text.title: Collect Karabor Axes
text.objectives: Collect $1oa Karabor Weapons.
text.description: Some of our bravest champions have fallen today.$b$bTo make matters worse the Iron Horde has started using our own weapons against us. $b$bThe idea of my people being slain with the weapons forged by our ancestors makes me sick.$b$b$n, could you please retrieve these weapons and bring them back to me?
text.completed: Return to Akclana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Collect Karabor Axes
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Karabor Weapons.
english.description: Some of our bravest champions have fallen today.$b$bTo make matters worse the Iron Horde has started using our own weapons against us. $b$bThe idea of my people being slain with the weapons forged by our ancestors makes me sick.$b$b$n, could you please retrieve these weapons and bring them back to me?
english.completed: Return to Akclana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 卡拉波的命运
text.objectives: 喝下洞察药剂，并见证卡拉波的命运。
text.description: 关于未来的千百条线索交织在一起，相互缠绕又展开，仿佛每时每刻都在变幻成为一幅幅颜色图案迥然不同的织锦画。$B$B我必须理清思绪。我必须把精力集中在将会变成现实的那一种可能性上。$B$B等你准备好分享我看到的画面时，就把药剂喝下去。$B$B当你眼前出现画面后，提高警惕。那跟我们现实中经历的一切一样危险而致命。
text.completion: I have seen enough. Ner'zhul must be stopped.
text.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Moonwillow Peak.

english.title: The Fate of Karabor
english.objectives: Drink the Clarity Elixir and witness the fate of Karabor.
english.description: Threads of the future weave together, winding and unwinding, creating tapestries that change in form and color from one moment to the next.$B$BI must have clarity. I must focus on the ONE strand that will become reality.$B$BWhen you are ready to share in my vision, drink the elixir.$B$BWhen the vision begins, be on your guard. The events of the vision are as deadly as anything we experience in this reality.
english.completion: I have seen enough. Ner'zhul must be stopped.
english.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Moonwillow Peak.

text.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
text.objectives: Kill Zugunk Poisonfiend
text.description: Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.$b$bHe has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.
text.completed: Return to Aklana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
english.objectives: Kill Zugunk Poisonfiend
english.description: Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.$b$bHe has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.
english.completed: Return to Aklana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 抓住他的眼睛
text.objectives: 抓住全视之眼。
text.description: 我需要找个可靠的人来完成必须完成的事。你是为数不多的可信者之一。$B$B我的侦测法术对那片树林和里面的兽人村庄古尔瓦不起作用。我们得穿透那层屏障才行。我想我知道该怎么办。$B$B在树林里有一股邪恶气息。有个恶魔监视者就藏在林中的洞穴里，它的目光可以洞察一切。$B$B我想让你和守望者去把它抓来。
text.completion: As soon as we have enough blessed water from the priestess's moonwell, we'll break the demon's will and use it as a proxy to see into Gul'var.$B$BThat way, they won't know it's us scrying upon them.$B$BBut first, we need to weaken their shrouding magic.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

english.title: Catching His Eye
english.objectives: Capture the All-Seeing Eye.
english.description: For what must be done, I need someone I can trust. You're one of those few.$B$BThe woods and the orc village, Gul'var, are protected from my scrying magic. We need to pierce that veil. I think I know a way.$B$BThere's a fel presence within the woods. A demonic watcher is there, hidden in a cave from which it casts its all-seeing gaze.$B$BI would like for you and the warden to capture it.
english.completion: As soon as we have enough blessed water from the priestess's moonwell, we'll break the demon's will and use it as a proxy to see into Gul'var.$B$BThat way, they won't know it's us scrying upon them.$B$BBut first, we need to weaken their shrouding magic.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

text.title: 召唤灵魂碎片
text.objectives: 收集库戈斯的碎片、戈尔加的碎片和哈格拉的碎片。
text.description: 能搞清塔隆戈尔和古加尔的阴谋当然不错，但更重要的是要阻止古尔丹。$B$B他的一些信徒能召唤出小恶魔。要想做到这一点，这些初阶术士就必须用到一种灵魂碎片。这种邪恶的水晶可以联通扭曲虚空，强行将恶魔召唤出来。$B$B古尔丹既是兽人又是恶魔。如果我们能收集到一些更为强力的碎片并把它们拼在一起，也许就能把他抓住。
text.progress: Do you have the shards, $n?
text.completion: Now all that's left to do is to fashion them together into something strong enough to ensnare Gul'dan.$B$BLuckily, we can do that right here.
text.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Khadgar at Gul'var.

english.title: Soul Shards of Summoning
english.objectives: Collect Kurgoth's Shard, Grogal's Shard, and Hagra's Shard.
english.description: It's good to know what Teron'gor and Cho'gall are up to. It's more important that we stop Gul'dan.$B$BSome of his disciples can summon minor demons. To do this, these lesser warlocks must use a soul shard. The foul crystal creates a connection to the Twisting Nether, pulling a demon through against its will.$B$BGul'dan's as much demon as he is orc. If we can gather some of the more potent shards, we can combine them into something that just might capture him.
english.progress: Ты $gпринес:принесла; осколки, $n?
english.completion: Now all that's left to do is to fashion them together into something strong enough to ensnare Gul'dan.$B$BLuckily, we can do that right here.
english.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Khadgar at Gul'var.

text.objectives: Kill Warsong Ragemongers near the Temple of Katabor in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.description: The Warsong Ragemongers are attacking the temple!
text.completed: Return to Captain Quest Giver at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Task: Warsong Riot
english.objectives: Kill Warsong Ragemongers near the Temple of Katabor in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: The Warsong Ragemongers are attacking the temple!
english.completed: Return to Captain Quest Giver at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 想想孩子们！
text.objectives: 救出拉斯塔克、阿莱娜和哈卡玛。
text.description: 当影月兽人攻击茂林幽谷时，一切都乱了套。$B$B我们有许多人逃走了，可还有三个孩子下落不明。$B$B我相信他们仍然留在村子里。$B$B求你救救他们吧！
text.completion: I am glad to hear that the children are safe. They will remember your heroic deeds for their entire lives.
text.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Teluuna Observatory.

english.title: Think of the Children!
english.objectives: Save Rastaak, Ariaana, and Hakaam.
english.description: When the Shadowmoon attacked Arbor Glen, everything was thrown into chaos.$B$BMany of us escaped, but there are still three children missing.$B$BI believe they are still back in the village.$B$BPlease save them!
english.completion: I am glad to hear that the children are safe. They will remember your heroic deeds for their entire lives.
english.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Teluuna Observatory.

text.title: The Call of War
text.objectives: Deliver Kaati's Letter to Faran at Teluuna Observatory.
text.description: If you are reading this letter, it likely means that I am dead. Please deliver this to my son, Faran, at Teluuna Observatory.$B$B$BDearest Faran and Elsa,$B$BI have fallen in the line of duty while defending the Temple of Karabor.$B$BPlease know that I love you both with all of my heart. My spirit will watch over you for the rest of your days. Be strong, love one another, and live this life to the best of your ability.$B$BI am so proud of you both.$B$BLove,$B$BYour Mother

text.title: 深入暮光
text.objectives: 到暮光林地与先知维伦谈一谈。
text.description: 我族人的安全是最重要的。$B$B耐奥祖很有可能把囚犯带到了他在西南边的据点沙兹古尔。$B$B我不希望对他发起进攻，但他恐怕会逼我动手。$B$B到暮光林地找我吧，$n。然后我们会尽全力救出那些囚犯。
text.completion: Thank you for coming, $n. There is much to be done.

english.title: Into Twilight
english.objectives: Speak to Prophet Velen at Twilight Glade.
english.description: The safety of my people is of the utmost priority.$B$BIt is likely that Ner'zhul has taken the prisoners to Shaz'gul, his stronghold to the southwest.$B$BI do not wish to use aggression against him, but he may force my hand.$B$BMeet me at Twilight Glade, $n. Then, we shall try our best to recover the prisoners.
english.completion: Thank you for coming, $n. There is much to be done.

text.title: The Memory of Fire
text.objectives: Use the Dancing Ember at the ring of fire.
text.description: <The obsidian chip is hot to the touch, but strangely, can be held with no fear of being burned.>$B$BOn its surface is etched a picture - a rectangular stone with a hole cut through the middle, surrounded by a ring of flames.$B$BThere is just such a stone in the fields to the north.
text.completed: Return to Starmancer Heidii at The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Memory of Fire
english.objectives: Use the Dancing Ember at the ring of fire.
english.description: <The obsidian chip is hot to the touch, but strangely, can be held with no fear of being burned.>$B$BOn its surface is etched a picture - a rectangular stone with a hole cut through the middle, surrounded by a ring of flames.$B$BThere is just such a stone in the fields to the north.
english.completed: Return to Starmancer Heidii at The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 英雄的礼遇
text.objectives: 在安波里村与萨玛拉谈一谈。
text.description: 先知维伦让我带你在影月谷里走走。$B$B我们第一站先去安波里村，我的姐妹萨玛拉正等着我们呢。自从钢铁部落把我带到塔纳安丛林后，我就再也没有见过她。$B$B那座村庄只是位于卡拉波神殿和沙塔斯之间的多个贸易村之一。$B$B沿路向东走，前往安波里村吧。我会与你同行的，朋友。
text.completion: Thank you, stranger! The Prophet spoke of new allies arriving on our shores.$B$BI hear it is thanks to you that my sister is safe.$B$BI owe you a great debt, friend.

english.title: A Hero's Welcome
english.objectives: Speak to Samaara at Embaari Village.
english.description: Prophet Velen has asked me to show you around Shadowmoon Valley.$B$BWe will go first to Embaari Village, where my sister Samaara is waiting for us. I have not seen her since the Iron Horde took me to Tanaan.$B$BThe village is just one of many trading villages between the Temple of Karabor and Shattrath.$B$BFollow the road east and make your way to Embaari Village. I will accompany you, my friend.
english.completion: Thank you, stranger! The Prophet spoke of new allies arriving on our shores.$B$BI hear it is thanks to you that my sister is safe.$B$BI owe you a great debt, friend.

objectiveDetails.description: 在安波里村找到萨玛拉

text.title: 洞察药剂
text.objectives: 收集6份沼泽荧光虫粉尘，3颗肿胀的心和1朵烁星花。
text.description: 我看见了关于未来的一千个片段，穿梭在一片混沌不清的残影间。$B$B我根本无法集中能量看清真正的结局——那个最有可能实现的未来。$B$B我需要一块神谕石来汇聚我的力量，还要一种特殊的药剂来平静我的思绪。$B$B要想制作这种药剂，我要用到下列材料：河畔沼泽荧光虫身上的翼尘、巨大多头蛇新鲜的心脏和一种罕见的烁星百合。$B$B等任务完成后，到月柳山来见我吧。
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: My trust in you is well placed, young $c.$B$BThis task would have been troublesome for many of my students, and yet you finished it with ease.
text.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Moonwillow Peak.

english.title: The Clarity Elixir
english.objectives: Collect 6 Swamplighter Dust, 3 Engorged Hearts, and 1 Starflower.
english.description: I see a thousand glimpses of the future, swimming in a chaotic blur.$B$BIt is possible to focus my energies to see the true eventuality - the future most likely to come to pass.$B$BI will need an oracle stone to focus my power, and a special elixir to still my mind.$B$BTo make the elixir, I will need the following ingredients: wing dust from Swamplighters along the river, fresh hearts from a monstrously-sized hydra, and a rare star lily.$B$BMeet me at Moonwillow Peak when this task is done.
english.progress: Yeah?
english.completion: My trust in you is well placed, young $c.$B$BThis task would have been troublesome for many of my students, and yet you finished it with ease.
english.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Moonwillow Peak.

text.title: 老婆婆的疗方
text.objectives: 收集6瓶蟾蜍涎。
text.description: 噢天哪，如此年轻而富有活力的$G小伙子:小姑娘;！你的步伐轻盈，眼中神采奕奕！$B$B等你到了我这个年纪，剩下的就只有痛苦与不适了。$B$B幸好，我手里有制作缓解关节疼痛药膏的配方。我只需要用到沼泽里鼓腹蛙皮肤上的软泥。$B$B你能发发善心帮帮我这个老女人吗？
text.progress: It's all downhill from here, dearie.
text.completion: Oh thank you child, thank you, thank you.$B$BThe nights in the swamp are cold. It means a lot to this old woman to have some comfort from her aching bones.
text.completed: Return to Old Loola at Twilight Glade.

english.title: A Grandmother's Remedy
english.objectives: Collect 6 Vials of Toad Juice.
english.description: Oh my, such a vigorous young $Glad:lass;! Such a spring in your step, and such a sparkle in your eye!$B$BWhen you get to my age, it's all aches and pains.$B$BLuckily, I have a recipe for an unguent that would soothe my joints. I just need the ooze from the skin of belly toads in the swamp.$B$BWould you be a dear and help an old woman out?
english.progress: Отсюда до болота все время под горочку, $Gвнучек:внучка;.
english.completion: Oh thank you child, thank you, thank you.$B$BThe nights in the swamp are cold. It means a lot to this old woman to have some comfort from her aching bones.
english.completed: Return to Old Loola at Twilight Glade.

text.title: 蔽目的黑暗
text.objectives: 把私语平原北部、东部、西部和南部部族之石上的文字摹拓下来。
text.description: 在经过多年的研究之后，我对影月兽人仍然感到知之甚少。$B$B在西南边立着几块石碑，上面详细写着兽人的历史。$B$B我无法靠近这些石碑看个清楚，但也许你能做到。$B$B如果你能把那些石碑上的文字摹拓下来，我就会给你不菲的奖励。
text.completion: Oh my, I see, I see! These writings will give me much insight into the Shadowmoon clan's culture.$B$BThank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Lorekeeper Heidii at The Burial Fields.

english.title: The Dark that Blinds Us
english.objectives: Take chalk rubbings of the northern, eastern, western, and southern Tribal Stones in the Whispering Fields.
english.description: After years of research, there is still so much I do not understand about the Shadowmoon.$B$BTo the southwest are stone monuments detailing the orcs' history.$B$BI'm not able to get close enough to examine the stones, but perhaps you can.$B$BIf you could take a chalk rubbing of the words written on those stones, and I will reward you handsomely.
english.completion: Oh my, I see, I see! These writings will give me much insight into the Shadowmoon clan's culture.$B$BThank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Lorekeeper Heidii at The Burial Fields.

text.title: The Demons Among Us - Alliance
text.objectives: Speak to Ginni Gingerlips to craft a Shadowmoon orc disguise.
text.description: Now that we have the cloth and leather, we can craft a fitting disguise for our infiltration mission.$B$BGo speak to Ginni Gingerlips. She has proven herself quite capable in the realm of... errr... garment design.

english.objectives: Speak to Ginni Gingerlips to craft a Shadowmoon orc disguise.

text.title: 卧底
text.objectives: 在暮光林地与赛勒尼交谈以获得兽人伪装，然后在沙兹古尔的关键位置放置炸药。$B$B如果你失去了伪装，可以使用赛勒尼的幻影护符来重新获得兽人的样貌。
text.description: 伊瑞尔率领我的游侠们到影月村去寻找囚犯了。$B$B他们的任务无比凶险，所以我要派你去执行一项应急任务。$B$B赛勒尼精通一种幻象法术，可以让你安全潜入沙兹古尔。去找她谈谈，把自己伪装起来。$B$B然后，把这些炸药放在军需官的仓库、主建筑和仪式祭坛附近。$B$B万一发生意外情况，可以引爆炸药来分散敌人的注意力。
text.completion: You made it, $n! Boy, am I glad to see you.
text.completed: Speak to Yrel at Shaz'gul.

english.title: Going Undercover
english.objectives: Speak to Sylene at Twilight Glade to gain an orc illusion, then plant explosives at key locations in Shaz'gul.$B$BIf you lose your disguise, use Sylene's Amulet of Illusion to regain an orc appearance.
english.description: Yrel leads my rangers on a search for the prisoners at the Shadowmoon village.$B$BTheir work is extremely dangerous, so I need you to carry out a contingency mission.$B$BSylene has mastered an illusion spell which will allow you to infiltrate Shaz'gul safely. Speak to her to disguise yourself.$B$BThen, plant explosives at the quartermaster's depot, the main lodge, and the ritual altar.$B$BIn case anything goes wrong, set them off to create a distraction.
english.completion: You made it, $n! Boy, am I glad to see you.
english.completed: Speak to Yrel at Shaz'gul.

objectiveDetails.description: 从赛勒尼处取得兽人伪装
在主建筑附近放置炸药
在补给室附近放置炸药
在酋长的座椅附近放置炸药

text.title: 逃离沙兹古尔
text.objectives: 帮助伊瑞尔逃离沙兹古尔。
text.description: 我失败了，$n……$B$B我的战队被一支野外巡逻队发现了。我们英勇奋战，但还是触发了警报。游侠们逼我藏了起来，然后自己向敌人投降了。$B$B他们听从我的指挥，却献出了生命……这么做的意义何在？我……我不知道该怎么办了，$n。$B$B我们得离开这儿，可怎么离开呢？
text.completion: I could never have done it without you, $n. Your words unlocked something within me which I have not felt before.$B$BCall it what you wish - resolve, conviction, faith. I will not soon forget this, $c.
text.completed: Speak to Yrel at Twilight Glade.

english.title: Escape From Shaz'gul
english.objectives: Help Yrel escape from Shaz'gul.
english.description: I've failed, $n...$B$BMy squadron was caught by a wandering patrol. We fought fiercely, but the alarm had been raised. The rangari forced me into hiding before surrendering themselves to the enemy.$B$BThey were under MY command, and they gave their lives... for what? I... I'm not sure what to do, $n.$B$BWe need to get out of here, but how?
english.completion: I could never have done it without you, $n. Your words unlocked something within me which I have not felt before.$B$BCall it what you wish - resolve, conviction, faith. I will not soon forget this, $c.
english.completed: Speak to Yrel at Twilight Glade.

objectiveDetails.description: 与伊瑞尔一同逃离沙兹古尔

text.title: 先祖的记忆
text.objectives: 在流亡者高地下方的洞穴中找到先祖图腾。
text.description: 我相信你应该知道你夺取的那些生命意味着什么。$B$B在我帮你找到耐奥祖之前，你必须理解他加入钢铁部落的原因。$B$B在这座村庄底下有个洞穴，那里有一件被我们称为先祖图腾的圣物。上面刻有自影月氏族创建以来每位成员的名字。$B$B洞穴入口就在正南方。我会在那等你。
text.completion: We will find new traditions. My people will become something... new.
text.completed: Speak to Rulkan at Exile's Rise.

english.title: Ancestor's Memory
english.objectives: Find the Ancestor's Totem in the cave beneath Exile's Rise.
english.description: I believe that you should know the price of the lives you take.$B$BSo before I will help you find Ner'zhul, you must understand why he joined the Iron Horde.$B$BIn a cave beneath this village is an artifact that we call the Ancestral Totem. On it is carved the names of every Shadowmoon clan member since its founding.$B$BThe opening of the cave lies directly south. I will meet you there.
english.completion: We will find new traditions. My people will become something... new.
english.completed: Speak to Rulkan at Exile's Rise.

text.title: 准备进攻
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个影月暗法师或影月灵爪战士。
text.description: 我们进不去这些大门，但你可以，$c。$B$B你的任务至关重要，而且影月兽人只要一看见你就会狠下杀手。对他们也不要手软。
text.completion: The Shadowmoon are not simple opponents. Your fighting skill is truly comparable to none.
text.completed: Return to Prophet Velen outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

english.title: On the Offensive
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadowmoon Darkcasters or Shadowmoon Voidclaws.
english.description: We cannot enter these gates, but you can, $c.$B$BYour mission is critical, and the Shadowmoon will kill you on sight. Do not hesitate to return the favor.
english.completion: The Shadowmoon are not simple opponents. Your fighting skill is truly comparable to none.
english.completed: Return to Prophet Velen outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

text.title: 肉食满仓
text.objectives: 收集1000块生雷象肉排。
text.description: 你好啊指挥官，在这遇见你真是太好了！$B$B要塞有好多张嘴等着吃饭呢，每天还源源不断有人前来造访。$B$B我们需要大量大量的肉来填饱大家伙的肚子。$B$B你愿意帮我们一把吗？多个人帮忙，效率肯定会高很多。
text.progress: Have ya seen tha size a these beasts?
text.completion: Brilliant, just brilliant! Ay've never seen such a haul in my entire life!$B$BGet tha wagons ready. We're eatin' well tonight!
text.completed: Return to Traevar Gunnermark at the Hills of Valuun.

english.title: The Big Haul
english.objectives: Collect 1000 Raw Elekk Steaks.
english.description: Ey commander, fancy runnin' inta ya out here!$B$BTha garrison's got plenty a hungry mouths ta feed, with more folks comin' by every day.$B$BWe're really gonna need a big haul o' meat ta keep everyone happy.$B$BWouldya care ta lend us a hand? It'll be faster work with an extra pair a hands.
english.progress: Have ya seen tha size a these beasts?
english.completion: Brilliant, just brilliant! Ay've never seen such a haul in my entire life!$B$BGet tha wagons ready. We're eatin' well tonight!
english.completed: Return to Traevar Gunnermark at the Hills of Valuun.

text.title: Fallen From the Stars
text.objectives: Collect 1 Pristine Starflower.
text.description: The final ingredient is a rare flower that grows only in the heart of the Nightmarsh.$B$BThis flower feeds only on starlight, and dies when it falls under shadow.$B$BIf you can find such a flower, bring it to me. Only its essence will help me gain the clarity I need.
text.completed: Return to [] at Twilight Glade in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: Meet Me Back at the Inn
text.objectives: Meet Wrathion upstairs at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
text.description: I'm certain you're eager to test out your new cloak. Let's put it to use.$b$bMeet me back inside the inn! A new development has come to my attention that we'll want to take advantage of.
text.completion: Are you ready for your next adventure?

text.title: A Timeless Discovery
text.objectives: Travel to the Timeless Isle southeast of the Jade Forest and speak with Wrathion.
text.description: Pandaria. Just when I think I've gotten its mysteries figured out, I discover something new.$b$bIt's called "The Timeless Isle." Once hidden in the mists, it appears and disappears seemingly of its own will. I've heard that time has no meaning there, that the sun neither rises nor sets.$b$bWe can take advantage of this anomaly, $n! If I could time-lock your cloak, the power it could contain would be... immense.$b$bOur path is clear. Fly southeast of the Jade Forest and meet me at the Timeless Isle!
text.completion: You're here! How long have I been waiting for you?$B$B<Wrathion appears momentarily confused.>$B$BI feel like I just arrived... but maybe I've been here for weeks... This island plays with one's head.$B$BKairoz has been trying to explain it to me, but sometimes I think bronze dragons speak in riddles.

text.title: Secrets of the Timeless Isle
text.objectives: Collect $1oa Timeless Coins from creatures and events on the Timeless Isle.
text.description: There is a currency minted only on this island - "timeless coins." They are immune to the island's temporal distortions... I would like to figure out why.$b$bGather some for me! Venture into the jungles of this forgotten paradise. Destroy the mysterious foes who lurk in this timeless place, discover hidden caches of treasure, and explore forgotten treasure hoards - whatever it takes. I will be waiting!
text.progress: <Wrathion tents his fingers together.>$B$BMy coins...?
text.completion: Wonderful, these are exactly what I need.$B$B<Wrathion holds one of the coins up, admiring it in the glow of the unmoving sun.>$B$BI will deconstruct their mysterious power, and use their timelessness to enhance your cloak. You will be most pleased with the result.
text.completed: Bring the coins to Wrathion on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: The Emperor's Way
text.objectives: Defeat Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen and Niuzao, the four August Celestials of Pandaria.
text.description: Recently, the August Celestials of Pandaria presented you with a challenge - and you triumphed.$b$bBut can you defeat them in combat? They are testing the mettle of all of Pandaria's heroes.$b$bThis challenge is not impossible, but you'll need to follow the advice of the last Pandaren Emperor and tackle it with unwavering inner strength. You'll also need a small army, so find a group of people you trust.$b$bDefeat the four celestials here in the Celestial Court, and our journey is almost complete...
text.completion: An impressive display of martial skill, $C! You have truly walked the path of the emperor, and demonstrated the very traits pandaren value most.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: A Pandaren Legend
text.objectives: Meet Wrathion within the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: I have learned so much in this timeless place, friend. Between the wisdom of the celestials and the curious power of these timeless artifacts, I know now how to safely augment your cloak with my own considerable power.$b$bI need a sacred place to complete my final incantations. Quickly! Meet me in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, within the Seat of Knowledge above the Mogu'shan Palace.$b$bToday, your legend begins!
text.completion: Step forward, my champion.$B$BThis is your hour.
text.completed: Meet Wrathion within the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Judgment of the Black Prince
text.objectives: Complete the Siege of Orgrimmar and defeat Garrosh Hellscream.
text.description: Now. To the final stage of my plan. Time to fulfil your grand purpose.$b$bUsing your newfound powers, it is time to bring this war to its conclusion. Destroy Garrosh Hellscream. Your people demand it, and future generations will sing your praises as the harbinger for the glorious new world we shall build together.$b$bI have no reward to offer you. I have already done everything in my power to ensure that you succeed. You are on your own.$b$bEnd Hellscream's reign.
text.completion: <Wrathion is FURIOUS. News of Hellscream's defeat and King Wrynn's gesture of peace must've already reached the black dragon's ears.>
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 糟糕的预感，更糟的结果
text.objectives: 击败林大顾的鬼魂。
text.description: <当你打开卷轴时，你意识到自己最坏的担心变成了现实——煞能已经腐化了林的配方。>$B$B<你唯一的选择就是击败释放的煞能，希望能够将卷轴抢救出来。>
text.giverWindow: 击败林大顾的鬼魂！

english.title: Bad Feeling, Worse Result
english.objectives: Defeat the Ghost of Lin Da-Gu.
english.description: <As you open the scroll, you realize your worst fears have come true: the sha energies have corrupted the Lin recipe.>$B$B<Your only choice is to defeat the released energies in the hope that the scroll can be saved.>
english.giverWindow: Defeat the Ghost of Lin Da-Gu!

text.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
text.objectives: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies
text.description: A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.$B$BIt might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.
text.completed: Return to Akclana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 悬赏：扭曲的古树
text.objectives: 从扭曲的古树上收集腐化的木材。
text.description: 诅咒林地中的古树已经遭到了恶魔法术的腐化。既然要消灭它们，我们不如好好利用它们的资源。浪费毕竟是可耻的。$B$B注意：这些林地巨木可不好对付。在与这些扭曲古树交手前，请叫上几位你最信任的朋友一同前往。$B$B——巴隆斯·阿历克斯顿
text.progress: Have you read the bounty I posted concerning the twisted ancients in the Cursed Woods?
text.completion: Unfortunate that the ancient guardians of the woods fell to such corruption.$B$BAt least now, its long nightmare has ended. Not to mention its sacrifice is our gain.
text.giverWindow: 收集一根腐化的木材作为证明。

english.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
english.objectives: Collect Corrupted Lumber from a Twisted Ancient.
english.description: The ancients of the Cursed Woods have been corrupted by demonic magic. Since they need to be destroyed, we might as well make use of their resources. Waste not, want not.$B$BBeware: these woodland behemoths are no easy targets. Gather trusted friends before you engage these twisted ancients.$B$B-- Baros Alexston
english.progress: Have you read the bounty I posted concerning the twisted ancients in the Cursed Woods?
english.completion: Unfortunate that the ancient guardians of the woods fell to such corruption.$B$BAt least now, its long nightmare has ended. Not to mention its sacrifice is our gain.
english.giverWindow: Collect corrupted lumber as proof.

text.title: 不祥之兆
text.objectives: 收服全视之眼。
text.description: 既然女祭司月牙已经制造出了圣水，现在是时候对付那恶魔了。$B$B拿上圣水和艾露恩的经文。$B$B通过两者的力量，你就能迫使恶魔向我们展示那群兽人在古尔瓦里干的勾当。
text.completion: Gul'dan is there! We must move quickly to capture him.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

english.title: Ominous Portents
english.objectives: Compel the All-Seeing Eye.
english.description: Now that Priestess Moonfang has created the blessed water, it is time to deal with the demon.$B$BTake the water and the scripture of Elune.$B$BThrough the power of each, you will compel the demon to show us what the orcs are up to at Gul'var.
english.completion: Gul'dan is there! We must move quickly to capture him.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

text.title: 影月之井
text.objectives: 收集一大块月岩。
text.description: 大法师要我准备这口月亮井。一旦完成，我就能净化井水，用它来对抗恶魔。$B$B现在还剩下一件事。$B$B德拉诺的一块月亮碎片掉进了树林另一侧附近的池塘里。用它将月亮井奉献给艾露恩再合适不过了。$B$B你愿意把它给我带回来吗，$n？
text.progress: With that chunk of fallen rock, I'll be able to complete the dedication of the moonwell.
text.completion: Thank you, $n. The White Lady will be pleased.$B$BNow, I shall go about the business of preparing the moonwell water for use in the archmage's plan.$B$BBut first, I wonder if you'd be willing to help me again. The warden brought back very disturbing stories about the creatures in the woods.
text.completed: Return to Delas Moonfang at Starfall Outpost.

english.title: Shadowmoonwell
english.objectives: Collect a Chunk of Lunar Rock.
english.description: The archmage has asked me to prepare this moonwell. Once it is completed, I'll be able to sanctify its water for use against the demon.$B$BOnly one thing remains.$B$BA piece of one of Draenor's moons has fallen into a nearby pool on the far side of the woods. Such a thing is perfect for use in the dedication of the moonwell to Elune.$B$BWill you bring it back for me, $n?
english.progress: Этот обломок необходим для освящения лунного колодца.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. The White Lady will be pleased.$B$BNow, I shall go about the business of preparing the moonwell water for use in the archmage's plan.$B$BBut first, I wonder if you'd be willing to help me again. The warden brought back very disturbing stories about the creatures in the woods.
english.completed: Return to Delas Moonfang at Starfall Outpost.

text.title: 熔铸灵魂陷阱
text.objectives: 熔铸古尔丹的灵魂陷阱。
text.description: 克罗斯尼斯的烈焰之心就在熔炉里。灵魂碎片也在我们手上了。$B$B现在要做的就是把火烧旺，将所有这些邪恶的材料拼合起来，制成一个抓捕古尔丹的陷阱。
text.progress: With the soul shards combined, we will trap Gul'dan and put an end to the Shadow Council on Draenor.
text.completion: You've forged the soul trap. There's no time to waste, $n.$B$BWe must capture Gul'dan.
text.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Khadgar at Gul'var.

english.title: Forging the Soul Trap
english.objectives: Forge Gul'dan's Soul Trap.
english.description: The fiery heart of Krosnis is in the forge. We have the soul shards.$B$BNow all that is left to do is to stoke the fires and combine all of these foul components into a trap for Gul'dan.
english.progress: Соединив осколки души, мы поймаем Гул'дана в ловушку и положим конец дренорскому Совету Теней.
english.completion: You've forged the soul trap. There's no time to waste, $n.$B$BWe must capture Gul'dan.
english.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Khadgar at Gul'var.

objectiveDetails.description: 熔铸古尔丹的灵魂陷阱

text.title: 隐匿石
text.objectives: 摧毁中部、北部和南部隐匿石。
text.description: 很久以前，影月氏族的萨满祭司在树林里竖起了三块石头。他们对着那些石头举行神圣的仪式，以祈求护佑林中的野兽与树木。$B$B现在，有人用邪恶魔法玷污了那些石头。正是这股邪力笼罩住了古尔瓦。$B$B在我们用抓来的恶魔安全地窥视暗影议会的村庄前，必须摧毁那些石头。
text.completion: Now that the veil has been lifted from the woods, we can make use of the demon.$B$BWe will convince it to turn its eye upon Gul'var and show us what the Shadow Council is planning.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

english.title: Shrouding Stones
english.objectives: Destroy the Central, Northern, and Southern Shrouding Stones.
english.description: Long ago, the shaman of the Shadowmoon clan erected three stones in the woods. There, they performed their sacred rituals, blessing the beasts and the trees.$B$BNow, someone has placed a fel magic upon those stones. This corruption is what shrouds the village of Gul'var.$B$BBefore we can use the captured demon to safely peer into the Shadow Council's village, we must bring down those stones.
english.completion: Now that the veil has been lifted from the woods, we can make use of the demon.$B$BWe will convince it to turn its eye upon Gul'var and show us what the Shadow Council is planning.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

text.title: 捕捉暗影
text.objectives: 对古尔丹使用古尔丹的灵魂陷阱。
text.description: 古尔丹就在西边山上的暗影高地。但你必须抓紧时间，$n。我们听说他正要动身前往塔拉多和霜火岭。$B$B灵魂陷阱的用法很简单。你只要瞄准之后发射就能困住古尔丹了。水晶会自动完成剩下的事。$B$B等你抓住他后，回坠星岗哨找我吧。$B$B祝你好运。
text.completion: Unfortunate, but not surprising. At least we were able to defeat one of the inner council members.$B$BAll is not lost, $n. We know what the Shadow Council is up to and where they're heading.$B$BWe'll regroup in Talador. Together, we'll put an end to Teron'gor and his plans for Auchindoun.$B$BDid you hear that?
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

english.title: To Catch a Shadow
english.objectives: Use Gul'dan's Soul Trap on Gul'dan.
english.description: Gul'dan is on the Shadow Rise just up the hill to the west. But, you must hurry, $n. We know that he's about to leave for Talador and Frostfire Ridge.$B$BThe use of the soul trap is straightforward. Simply point and shoot to ensnare Gul'dan. The crystal will take care of the rest.$B$BI'll see you back at Starfall Outpost when you have him.$B$BGood luck.
english.completion: Unfortunate, but not surprising. At least we were able to defeat one of the inner council members.$B$BAll is not lost, $n. We know what the Shadow Council is up to and where they're heading.$B$BWe'll regroup in Talador. Together, we'll put an end to Teron'gor and his plans for Auchindoun.$B$BDid you hear that?
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.

text.title: 奴役与对抗
text.objectives: 从污煤矿洞营地里救出5位霜狼奴隶。
text.description: 我们夺取了他们的大本营，但还有一部分我的族人被关押在污煤矿洞。$b$b我们眼下没有足够的人手去解决这件事，但你看起来像是能独自应付几个食人魔的样子。$b$b我想请你去解放那里的霜狼奴隶，顺便留意一下穆维里克。
text.completion: Who are you, outsider? I saw you freeing some of my kin...
text.completed: Find Mulverick in the Sootstained Mining Camp

english.title: Slavery and Strife
english.objectives: Free 5 Frostwolf Slaves from the Sootstained Mining Camp.
english.description: We have their citadel, but they still have some of my people enslaved at the Sootstained Mines.$b$bWe have no one to spare, but you seem more than capable of handling a few ogres on your own.$b$bI ask that you release any enslaved Frostwolves you find there, and keep an eye out for Mulverick.
english.completion: Who are you, outsider? I saw you freeing some of my kin...
english.completed: Find Mulverick in the Sootstained Mining Camp

text.title: 林中的诅咒
text.objectives: 在诅咒林地里消灭$1oa个被邪能诅咒的生物。
text.description: 科达娜告诉我，妨碍卡德加侦察兽人村庄的那股邪恶能量同时也诅咒了林中的生物。$B$B这可不行。$B$B如果我们是在艾泽拉斯，花上一点时间，我也许能找到治愈它们的办法。但我们现在不在艾泽拉斯，也没那么多时间。$B$B眼下最好的办法就是速战速决地结束它们的痛苦，不要再让这些可怜的生物忍受恶魔能量的折磨。
text.completion: Grim business. I wish that it could have gone differently.$B$BThank you for your dedication, $n. Be comforted in the fact that Elune understands.
text.completed: Return to Delas Moonfang at Starfall Outpost.

english.title: A Curse Upon the Woods
english.objectives: Kill $1oa fel-cursed creatures in the Cursed Woods.
english.description: Cordana tells me that the creatures of the woods are cursed by the same fel energies keeping Khadgar from scrying into the orc village.$B$BThis will not do.$B$BIf we were on Azeroth, I could find a cure in a reasonable timeframe. However, we are not, nor do we have the luxury of time.$B$BBetter to put a swift end to their suffering rather than allow these poor creatures to linger with demonic energy.
english.completion: Grim business. I wish that it could have gone differently.$B$BThank you for your dedication, $n. Be comforted in the fact that Elune understands.
english.completed: Return to Delas Moonfang at Starfall Outpost.

text.title: 体面的离别
text.objectives: 焚烧阵亡的霜狼先锋的尸体。
text.description: 食人魔的人数远在我们之上，*咳嗽*可我们也让他们为自己的恶行付出了血的代价。$b$b即便如此，我还是只得把那些牺牲了的兄弟姐妹丢在了战场上。他们理应体面的死去，没道理让那些肮脏的食人魔渣滓亵渎他们的尸体。$b$b给，拿上这个火把，*咳嗽*替我完成剩下的事：到西边焚烧我亡故的兄弟姐妹们的尸体吧。
text.completion: You bring honor to the clan by giving my family a proper burial, $n.
text.completed: Return to Urukag by Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: A Proper Parting
english.objectives: Burn the corpses of dead Frostwolf Outriders.
english.description: The ogres outnumbered us, *cough* but we made them pay for their deeds in blood.$b$bEven so, I was forced to abandon my fallen brothers and sisters on the battlefield. They deserve better than to have their corpses despoiled by the ogre filth.$b$bHere, take this torch *cough* and do what I could not: burn the corpses of my fallen brothers and sisters to the west.
english.completion: Устроив погребение должным образом, ты $gвосстановил:восстановила; честь клана, $n.

text.objectives: 击败古特拉·狼噬。
text.description: 雪足帮我来到了这里，好让我攻击他们的首领古特拉，可我已经失血过多。我就快不行了。$b$b你有力量帮我为死去的兄弟姐妹们复仇，并消灭古特拉·狼噬吗？$b$b那怪物就在肃霜丘陵最高的塔里。
text.completion: Wolfchew is defeated? *cough* Glorious.

english.objectives: Slay Guttra Wolfchew.
english.description: Snowpaw was able to help me to here so that I might strike against their leader, Guttra, but I have lost too much blood. My time is near.$b$bDo you have the strength to help me avenge my fallen brothers and sisters and kill Guttra Wolfchew?$b$bThe monster resides in the tallest tower of Grimfrost.
english.completion: The wolf is dead? *(coughing): Fine.

text.title: 战火徽记
text.objectives: 收集$1oa枚次级好运护符。
text.description: 你好啊，$n。我有幸为你送上一个难得的好机会。经过几个世纪的摸索，我们找到了一种可以改变运势的方法。只要拥有战火徽记，在追击加尔鲁什的过程中，神器就会更为频繁地落入你的手里。
text.progress: May these charms bring you great luck, $n.
text.completion: May the stars smile upon you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Elder Liao in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.objectives: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
english.description: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Warforged Seal, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently as you pursue Garrosh.
english.progress: May these charms bring you great luck, $n.
english.completion: Пусть звезды улыбаются тебе, $n.

text.description: 在永恒岛上举行着一场特殊的比赛，为的是考验参赛者的领导力。那些证明自己价值的人，将有机会和一种美德的化身成为朋友——它们是天神的后裔。$b$b每当你打赢一次，我就会颁发给你一枚仪式硬币。等你拥有了足够多的硬币时再来找我吧，我们将进一步讨论下你的奖励。

text.title: 战火为何而燃？
text.objectives: 游学者周卓想与你在锦绣谷谈一谈。
text.description: 噢，我的朋友，今天你和你的同伴终结了自有史以来就始终困扰潘达利亚的邪煞。你们的壮举，甚至令泰坦和他们的魔古仆从都望尘莫及——你们竟然摧毁了亚煞极最后的气息。$b$b来吧，你愿意到锦绣谷与我会合吗？有些事情我希望你能亲眼见证。
text.completion: Our precious Vale of Eternal Blossoms. So much destruction and violence. But... I sense a glimmer of hope.

text.title: 永恒之疑
text.objectives: 正确回答一个由伊夫琳娜提出的有关艾泽拉斯历史的问题。
text.description: 命运、定数、因果循环。这样的词汇暗示着时间之流的无懈可击。$B$B但愿真是这样。直到今天，艾泽拉斯的许多住民仍然渴望改变过去。然而正如我们的经历可以塑造我们一样，它们也能塑造我们身边的世界。$B$B想想这些千丝万缕的线是如何织成了我们今天的现实世界。一旦割断足够多的线，因果必将化为虚无，我们的世界也会分崩瓦解。事实上，哪怕只将一根线剪短，都会引发灾难性的结局，前提是线要剪对。
text.completion: This is the great burden of the Historian - should Azeroth's timeways come under attack, we must reconstruct history exactly as it happened, or the consequences could be dire. As we spread our stories and knowledge, so do we create a stronger future for us all.
text.completed: Return to Senior Historian Evelyna on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: A Timeless Question
english.objectives: Correctly answer one of Evelyna's questions about the history of Azeroth.
english.description: Destiny. Fate. Karma. Words like these imply that the timeways are unassailable.$B$BWould that were the case. To this day, many of Azeroth's inhabitants yearn to change the past. Yet just as our experiences shape us, they also shape the world around us.$B$BConsider how those threads have woven the fabric of today's reality. Cut enough threads, and causation inevitably fails, unraveling that fabric. Indeed, cutting even a single thread short can result in disaster, provided it is the right thread.
english.completion: This is the great burden of the Historian - should Azeroth's timeways come under attack, we must reconstruct history exactly as it happened, or the consequences could be dire. As we spread our stories and knowledge, so do we create a stronger future for us all.
english.completed: Return to Senior Historian Evelyna on the Timeless Isle.
