text.title: 那一抹青铜色……
text.objectives: 在锦绣谷的闻道之座外面与克罗米交谈。
text.description: 当你调查山谷的毁灭情况时，你注意到了一抹亮眼的青铜色。除非你是眼花了——有个身材矮小的侏儒正在魔古山宫殿上方的平台上试图吸引你的注意力，就在闻道之座外面。$b$b你应该去看看她意欲何为。
text.completion: <The tiny gnome's eyes reflect the light with a copper sheen. She is not what she seems.>$B$B$n! I have been waiting for you. The bronze dragonflight has need of your services.
text.completed: 到锦绣谷的闻道之座外面与克罗米交谈。

english.title: A Flash of Bronze...
english.objectives: Speak with Chromie outside of the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: As you survey the devastation of the vale, a flash of bronze catches your eye. Unless you're mistaken, a tiny gnome is trying to catch your attention from the balcony above Mogu'shan Palace, just outside of the Seat of Knowledge.$b$bYou should see what she wants.
english.completion: < The eyes of the gnome woman reflect light with a copper glow. She's not who she seems.$b$b$n! I've been waiting for you for a long time. The bronze dragons need your help again.
english.completed: Speak with Chromie outside of the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 永恒岛之旅
text.objectives: 到位于翡翠林沿海的永恒岛上与观察者劳拉交谈。
text.description: 青铜龙军团发现了一个极不寻常的熊猫人现象，$c。在远离翡翠林海岸线的地方，一座迷失在时光中的岛屿冲破了迷雾！$b$b那里危险得很，也许是整个潘达利亚最为危机四伏的地方。可我们决心解开这座岛屿的谜团。$b$b来，拿着这个计时器。只需轻轻一按，你就将飞驰到岛上。站稳脚跟后就去和观察者劳拉谈谈吧。她会带你去找我们的首席侦查员。
text.completion: I see Chronormu has made good on her promise! You are right on time.
text.completed: 到翡翠林沿岸的永恒岛与观察者劳拉交谈。

english.title: Journey to the Timeless Isle
english.objectives: Speak with Watcher Lara on the Timeless Isle, off the coast of the Jade Forest.
english.description: The bronze dragonflight has discovered a most unusual pandaren phenomenon, $c. Emerging from the mists, far off the coast of the Jade Forest - an island that was lost in time!$b$bIt is a dangerous place, perhaps the most perilous in all of Pandaria. But we are determined to unravel its mysteries.$b$bHere, take this timepiece. A single click will whisk you to the island. Get yourself established, and speak with Watcher Lara. She will guide you to our chief investigator.
english.completion: I see Chronormu has made good on her promise! You are right on time.
english.completed: Speak with Watcher Lara on the Timeless Isle, off the coast of the Jade Forest.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 到白虎寺与试炼教头罗敦交谈，然后进入试炼场。
text.description: 喂！你叫$n是吧？你好啊。我是泰晶。$b$b<泰晶上下打量了你一番。>$b$b你看起来很强壮。我在山谷里见过你几面，但还从来没看到过你战斗的样子。我在想……你会不会是个绣花枕头？$b$b要是你愿意证明自己的话，就去昆莱山的白虎寺与试炼教头罗敦谈一谈吧。他会考验你的实力。
text.completion: Welcome to the Proving Grounds, $C. I am Trial Master Rotun.$B$BHere, you may test your skill at performing several different combat roles: dealing damage, absorbing damage, and healing. I shall administer and judge these trials.$B$B$B$BAre you ready to begin?
text.completed: Report to Trial Master Rotun within the Proving Grounds.

english.title: Proving Grounds
english.objectives: Speak with Trial Master Rotun at the Temple of the White Tiger, then enter the Proving Grounds.
english.description: You there! It's $n, right? Greetings. I'm Taijing.$b$b<Taijing sizes you up.>$b$bYou look strong. I've seen you a few times here in the Vale, but I've never seen you fight before. I wonder... are you as strong as you seem?$b$bIf you're interested in proving yourself, speak with Trial Master Rotun at the Temple of the White Tiger, in Kun-Lai. He will put you to the test.
english.completion: Welcome to the Proving Grounds, $C. I am Trial Master Rotun.$B$BHere, you may test your skill at performing several different combat roles: dealing damage, absorbing damage, and healing. I shall administer and judge these trials.$B$B$B$BAre you ready to begin?
english.completed: Report to Trial Master Rotun within the Proving Grounds.

text.title: 正义之师
text.objectives: 在圣光之路上消灭所有兽人，护送你的要塞军队前往卡拉波神殿。
text.description: 钢铁部落席卷了卡拉波。如果我们不赶快行动的话，就要失去这座城市了。$b$b大主教阿卡玛和我们最后的军队都被困在里面，可你的要塞军队仍在神殿外，等你下达命令。$B$B来跟我一起飞行吧。我们到战场上去跟你的军队会合。在纳鲁的庇护下，我们将背水一战，收复失地！
text.completion: Now, to destroy these orcs once and for all.
text.completed: Report to Vindicator Maraad at the Temple of Karabor.

english.title: The Righteous March
english.objectives: Escort your garrison forces to the Temple of Karabor by slaying all the orcs in the Path of Light.
english.description: The Iron Horde have overtaken Karabor. If we don't act now, we will lose the city.$b$bExarch Akama and the last of our forces are trapped within the city, but your garrison forces are still outside the temple, awaiting your orders.$B$BCome and fly with me. We will meet your forces on the field. With the naaru by our side, we will make one last charge to retake the city!
english.completion: Now, to destroy these orcs once and for all.
english.completed: Report to Vindicator Maraad at the Temple of Karabor.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送你的要塞军队前往卡拉波

text.title: 守卫卡拉波
text.objectives: 消灭卡拉波的钢铁部落。
text.description: 保卫卡拉波，抵御钢铁部落的袭击。$B$B炽燃者阿诺克就在北边庭院的尽头。他看守着通往卡拉波后面港口的入口，钢铁部落的主力大军就等在那里。$B$B等我们解决掉他之后，就得去对付钢铁部落的首领指挥官沃尔卡了。
text.completion: We did it, $n. Without your heroic efforts, the Temple of Karabor would have been lost to the Iron Horde.$B$BProphet Velen would be proud of us.
text.completed: Return to Yrel at Embaari Village.

english.title: The Defense of Karabor
english.objectives: Destroy the Iron Horde in Karabor.
english.description: Defend Karabor from the Iron Horde.$B$BAt the end of the northern courtyard is Arnokk the Burner. He guards the entrance to the harbor behind Karabor, where the main Iron Horde army is waiting.$B$BOnce we've taken care of him, we'll need to deal with the Iron Horde leader, Commander Vorka.
english.completion: We did it, $n. Without your heroic efforts, the Temple of Karabor would have been lost to the Iron Horde.$B$BProphet Velen would be proud of us.
english.completed: Return to Yrel at Embaari Village.

They are so not good friends.$b$bI know where more friends are! You need friends? My friends take my things. I need things back before I can be chief. text.title: 往昔的暗示
text.objectives: 从织雾者艾莉处购买一本陈旧的日志。
text.description: 这个地方还有许多谜团尚未被解开，但它并不愿意主动吐露自己的秘密。$b$b我们上次交谈时你提到的某件事情引起了我的兴趣。如果我没记错的话，你说织雾者艾莉随身带着一本陈旧的日志？这也许能解答我们的许多问题，但说不定只会为我们带来更多疑问。我想一切都取决于那位将发生在这诡异之地的一切记录下来的冒险者是否勤奋了。$b$b取得陈旧的日志，然后带回来交给我，我们将一同钻研里面的秘密。
text.progress: Ah, you have returned. Do you have the journal?
text.completion: Ah, you have it! Excellent!$B$BA cursory glance indicates that my presumptions were not far-fetched. Though the pages are worn and waterlogged, most of the entries are still legible. It appears that our friend, explorer Harrington, was quite verbose in cataloguing the creatures and treasures he found on his journey through the island.$B$BWell, are you simply going to stand there? This tome is a veritable trove of mysteries, and we have barely scratched the surface! Adventure awaits!
